records.query: Apple 最近有什麼跟 Siri 有關的法律訴訟或和解消息？
records.answer:
Apple 最近就 Siri 的 AI 功能達成了一項 2.5 億美元的集體訴訟和解協議，符合資格的 iPhone 用戶每部裝置最高可獲得 95 美元的賠償。以下是根據參考資料的詳細說明：

## 和解金額與背景

原告方尋求一筆 2.5 億美元的和解金，以解決 Apple 在 Siri 人工智慧功能方面誤導消費者的指控 [AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2]。這起集體訴訟在加州北區聯邦法院提起，代表美國消費者主張 Apple 透過行銷不存在的「Enhanced Siri features」（增強版 Siri 功能），誘使消費者基於虛假廣告購買 iPhone [AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2]。若獲法官批准，這將成為 Apple 歷來最大規模的和解案之一 [AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2]。

## 賠償金額與受影響人數

符合資格的消費者最初每部裝置將獲得 25 美元，根據提交的索賠數量及其他因素，最終賠償金額可能增加或減少，但不會超過每部裝置 95 美元 [AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2]。約有 3,700 萬名 iPhone 用戶符合資格 [AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2]。

## 適用範圍

和解涵蓋在 2024 年 6 月 10 日至 2025 年 3 月 29 日期間購買 iPhone 16 型號、iPhone 15 Pro 或 iPhone 15 Pro Max 的消費者 [AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2]。

## Apple 的回應

Apple 發言人透過電子郵件向 CBS News 表示：「Apple 已達成和解以解決與兩項額外功能可用性相關的索賠。我們解決此事是為了專注於我們最擅長的工作——為用戶提供最具創新性的產品和服務。」[AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2]

## 相關背景

Apple 在 2024 年 WWDC 上展示了 AI 增強版 Siri 和 Apple Intelligence，但相關功能經歷了兩年的延遲 [AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0]。直到 2026 年 6 月的 WWDC，Apple 才推出重新設計的 Siri AI（將以 beta 形式於今年稍晚推出），部分功能依賴 Apple 與 Google 於 1 月簽訂的協議，使用 Google 的 Gemini 模型來驅動改進後的 Siri [AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0]。訴訟中指控的「Enhanced Siri features」延遲，正是促成這起集體訴訟的原因 [AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2]。

iPhone owners could receive up to $95 under a proposed $250 million settlement resolving claims that Apple misled customers about Siri's artificial intelligence features, according to a recent court filing. The class-action lawsuit, filed in federal court in the Northern District of California on behalf of U.S. consumers, claims that Apple deceived customers by marketing "Enhanced Siri features" that did not yet exist, leading them to buy iPhones based on false advertising. The plaintiffs are seeking a $250 million settlement payment, according to a recent court filing. If approved by a judge, it could rank among the largest settlements involving Apple. "Apple has reached a settlement to resolve claims related to the availability of two additional features," an Apple spokesperson said in an email to CBS News. "We resolved this matter to stay focused on doing what we do best, delivering the most innovative products and services to our users."
Clarkson Law Firm, a public interest law firm that filed the original lawsuit against Apple, said in a statement on Wednesday that the settlement would provide "timely relief to tens of millions of consumers nationwide."
Here's what to know about the recent settlement. Am I eligible? The settlement covers people who purchased an iPhone 16 model, iPhone 15 Pro or iPhone 15 Pro Max between June 10, 2024, and March 29, 2025. Approximately 37 million iPhone owners are eligible, according to the court filing. Customers will be notified by either email or mail if they can file a claim. An online social media campaign will also provide information about the settlement website and who is eligible, according to the court filing. How much money could I get? Eligible customers will initially receive $25 per device. Depending on how many claims are submitted and other determining factors, the final payment may increase or decrease, but it will not exceed $95 per device, according to the court filing
How do I file a claim? Claim filing details are not released yet. Clarkson Law Firm said on its
website
that a settlement website with more details will be available in "a few weeks."
According to the court filing, the website "will include all necessary information to learn about the settlement" and a number consumers can call with questions. Edited by

records.query: Apple 在最近的 WWDC 上關於 Siri 有什麼新消息？
records.answer:
Apple 在 2026 年 WWDC 上正式發表了 reinvented Siri（稱為 Siri AI），將以 beta 形式於今年秋季在美國率先推出英文版，其 AI 能力部分仰賴 Google 的 Gemini 模型技術 [AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0] [AAPL_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #2]。

以下是具體要點：

**1. Siri AI 的功能升級**
Siri AI 設計目的是將 Siri 從「glorified kitchen timer」轉變為「digital helper for the AI age」，能夠從用戶的應用程式中提取上下文資訊，例如用戶可以詢問姊妹透過簡訊推薦的 podcast 名稱，Siri AI 能直接呈現而無需開啟其他應用程式或服務 [AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0]。Siri AI 將更注重語音聽寫（voice dictation）和回答問題等功能 [AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0]。此外，新的 Siri app 可集中管理用戶的各種對話，整體更強調個人化（personal）、安全性（security）和隱私（privacy）[AAPL_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #2]。

**2. 與 Google 的合作**
Apple 於一月與 Google 簽署協議，使用 Google 的 Gemini 模型來驅動改進後的 Siri，這為 Apple 提供了推進 Siri AI 所需的高性能 AI 模型，因為 Apple 自身的模型表現未達預期 [AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0]。不過，Apple 軟體工程資深副總裁 Craig Federighi 特別澄清，Siri AI 並非 Google Gemini 助理的重新品牌版本——Apple 不使用 Google 部署給客戶的任何模型（包括 Gemini Flash-Lite、Gemini Flash、Gemini Pro 及 Gemini Image models），也不使用 Google 的基礎設施或 Google Search 來進行世界知識的 grounding [AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0]。

**3. 推出時程與限制**
Siri AI 的構想最早於 WWDC 2024 展示，經過兩年延遲後，現在看起來已準備就緒，但將以 beta 形式於今年秋季推出，並非完整版（full launch）[AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0] [AAPL_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #2]。初期將先在美國以英文推出 [AAPL_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #2]。

**4. Apple Intelligence 的擴展**
除了 Siri AI，Apple 也宣布其 AI 平台 Apple Intelligence 將在 Safari 瀏覽器以及 Password 和 Messages 應用程式中發揮作用，其他發布內容還包括 iOS 的視覺升級和家長控制功能 [AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0]。

**5. 分析師觀點**
Deep Asset Management 的 Gene Munster 在 6 月 6 日（WWDC 前）預期，Apple 將在 WWDC 上展示重新設計的 Siri 功能，並預期 Apple 會將 Siri 定位為與 ChatGPT、Grok 和 Gemini 競爭的產品，同時搭載由 Google 驅動的 Search 或 Ask Prompt 功能 [AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0]。

最近分析師對 Apple 股票的利多看法主要集中在高毛利 Services 業務的創紀錄成長、iPhone 17 帶動的強勁動能，以及無與倫比的現金生成與資本回報能力。

以下是各項利多要點：

**1. Services 業務創歷史新高，推動獲利結構轉型**
Apple 的 Services 營收在 FY2026 第二季年增 16%，達到 310 億美元的歷史新高，Services 毛利率更高達 74.2% [AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #0]。這項高毛利業務的持續擴張正在改變 Apple 的獲利結構，使其從依賴週期性硬體銷售轉向更可預測、高品質的經常性收入，這為其溢價估值提供了正當性 [AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #0]。整體而言，Apple 的 TTM 毛利率達到 47.9%，較 FY2024 的 46.2% 和 FY2019 的 38.2% 顯著提升，營業利益率則達到 32.6% [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。

**2. iPhone 17 週期帶來強勁成長動能**
iPhone 17 週期帶來了 23% 的成長，結合高毛利 Services 的動能，為股價提供了有力支撐 [AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #2]。Wearables（穿戴裝置）也恢復成長，受惠於新健康功能和改善的電池續航力 [AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #1]。

**3. 龐大裝機量與生態系統鎖定效應**
Apple 的活躍裝置安裝基數已超過 25 億台，為 Services 變現提供了龐大且持續成長的基礎 [AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #0]。該公司正在成功提高 Services 的定價，展現了生態系統內的定價能力 [AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #1]。文章作者也指出，Apple 擁有龐大的安裝基數、生態系統鎖定效應，以及不斷成長的高毛利收入來源，並將其視為全球最具韌性和獲利能力的企業之一 [AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #1]。

**4. 現金生成能力與資本回報**
Apple 在 TTM 基礎上產生了 1,292 億美元的自由現金流，輕鬆覆蓋 FY2026 上半年 77 億美元的股息和 370 億美元的股票回購 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。其資產負債表被形容為「堡壘級」，持有 1,466 億美元的現金和有價證券，而定期債務僅 827 億美元，淨現金部位為正且持續增長 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。Apple 的現金生成能力處於獨一無二的地位，TTM 來自營運的現金流達 1,402 億美元，而最接近的同業 Dell 僅為 112 億美元 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。文章作者預期，在強勁現金生成、持續股票回購與紀律性資本配置的支撐下，Apple 仍是具吸引力的長期投資 [AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #1]。

**5. Apple Intelligence 帶來長期成長前景**
文章作者預期，隨著 Apple Intelligence 功能在各裝置間普及，將推動多年度的升級週期、改善變現能力，並擴大經常性收入 [AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #1]。

**6. 估值與基本面對比**
Apple 目前股價位於 296 美元（市場價格），而 Trefis 估值模型給出的公允價值為 268 美元，暗示約 9.38% 的下行空間 [AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #0]。儘管如此，Apple 的多項基本面指標遠優於 S&P 中位數：LTM 營收成長率 12.8%（S&P 中位數 7.4%）、LTM 營業利益率 32.6%（S&P 中位數 18.4%）、LTM 現金流利潤率 31.1%（S&P 中位數 21.3%），且負債權益比僅 2.0%（S&P 中位數 21.5%）[AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #1]。Apple 的股票目前處於「趨勢強度」前 10% 的分位，顯示強勁的動能 [AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #1]。

**7. Services 內容與廣告營收重新加速**
投資人對 Services 板塊中內容與廣告營收重新加速的證據反應正面，該板塊實現了雙位數成長 [AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #1]。

stock is at an interesting point right now. It has strong momentum, and if you bet on it, you are betting on a company with strong margin, good cash flow, low-debt capital structure, and good tailwinds. But is that enough? Why Bet On AAPL Now? The primary driver for equity appreciation is the ongoing mix shift toward the high-margin services business. By monetizing its growing installed base of over 2.5 billion active devices, Apple is transforming its earnings profile from one dependent on cyclical hardware sales to a more predictable, high-quality, recurring revenue stream, which justifies a premium valuation. Services revenue grew 16% YoY in Q2 FY2026 to an all-time record high of $31 billion. The installed base of active devices now exceeds 2.5 billion, providing a large and growing base for monetization. Services Gross Margin stood at 74.2%.

[AAPL] TTM gross margin reached 47.9%, up from 46.2% in FY 2024 and 38.2% back in FY 2019, driven by the rising Services mix. Operating margin now sits at 32.6%, and the company throws off $129.2 billion in free cash flow on a TTM basis. That FCF easily covers the $7.7 billion in dividends and $37.0 billion in buybacks Apple executed in the first half of FY 2026. The balance sheet is fortress-grade. Source: Seeking Alpha
Here’s where the premium gets harder to defend. Apple’s 12.8% YoY revenue growth trails SNDK’s 82.8% surge, WDC’s 32.0%, and STX’s 28.9%. Forward revenue growth of 9.6% is the weakest in the group except WDC. Yet Apple’s three-year revenue CAGR of 5.4% beats WDC and SNDK, both of whom posted negative numbers over that stretch. The hardware peers are riding an AI-driven storage upcycle. Apple is the steadier compounder. Profitability
Source: Seeking Alpha
This is Apple’s home turf. Apple’s 47.9% gross margin trails only SNDK’s 56.0%. EBITDA margin of 35.4% beats every peer except SNDK. Levered FCF margin of 22.4% leads the group. Return on common equity of 141.5% dwarfs everyone except STX, which benefits from a tiny equity base. Most striking: Apple generated $140.2 billion in cash from operations on a TTM basis. The next closest, Dell, did $11.2 billion. Continued…
Our Opinion 7/10
Apple’s quarter was a genuine surprise to the upside, and the company’s cash generation remains in a league of its own. The dividend hike and fresh $100 billion buyback give investors a tangible return floor. But the stock isn’t cheap. At 33.5x forward earnings with sub-10% forward revenue growth, you’re paying a quality premium that leaves little room for an iPhone stumble or a tariff escalation. For long-term holders, Apple stays a core position.

[AAPL] Wearables also returned to growth, helped by new health features and improved battery life. records.query: NVIDIA 最近跟 IREN 之間有什麼合作的新聞？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 最近與 IREN 簽訂了一項為期五年的 AI Cloud 合約，金額達 34 億美元，同時 NVIDIA 也對 IREN 進行了最高 21 億美元的戰略投資，雙方合作部署最多 5 GW 的 NVIDIA AI 基礎設施 [NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1][NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0]。

以下是雙方合作的具體細節：

**一、34 億美元 AI Cloud 合約**

IREN 與 NVIDIA 簽訂了一項為期五年、價值 34 億美元的 AI Cloud 合約，合約內容涉及氣冷式 Blackwell GPU，部署預計在 Childress 現有數據中心內約 60 MW 的空間進行，目標是在 2027 年初開始逐步放量 [NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0]。IREN 執行長表示，該合約是雙方更廣泛戰略合作夥伴關係的第一步 [NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1]。與此合約相關的約 7 億美元年經常性收入（ARR）已計入 IREN 的合約 ARR 中 [NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2]。

**二、NVIDIA 21 億美元投資安排**

NVIDIA 向 IREN 提供了為期五年、以每股 70 美元認購最多 3,000 萬股普通股的權利 [NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0]。若全額行使，該權利將代表最高 21 億美元的潛在投資，但須受監管限制等條件約束 [NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0]。這項 21 億美元的投資結構設計為：其投資權利僅在 IREN 園區部署 NVIDIA GPU 基礎設施時才逐步歸屬，且只有在部署達到 600,000 顆 GPU 時才會完全歸屬 [NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2]。

**三、5 GW 戰略合作與部署計畫**

IREN 與 NVIDIA 正在合作支援 IREN 全球平台（包括 DGX 環境和 MGX AI 工廠參考架構）上最多 5 GW 的「NVIDIA HGX 對齊 AI 基礎設施」部署 [NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1]。未來的部署將以 IREN 位於德州、容量達 2 GW 的 Sweetwater 校區為中心 [NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0]。在 Childress 廠區，IREN 正在進行 NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 安裝，作為 300 MW 液冷部署計畫的一部分 [NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2]。

IREN Limited (NASDAQ:

The stock rose 27% to $72.28 after closing at $56.85, before pulling back to $69.45 at press time, still up more than 21%. The rally followed IREN’s disclosure of a five-gigawatt strategic partnership with Nvidia tied to the deployment of AI infrastructure across its global data center pipeline. Under the agreement, IREN issued Nvidia a five-year right to purchase up to 30 million ordinary shares at $70 per share. If fully exercised, the right would represent up to $2.1 billion of potential investment, subject to conditions including regulatory limits. The partnership is expected to focus on Nvidia-aligned DSX AI factory infrastructure, with future deployments centred around IREN’s two-gigawatt Sweetwater campus in Texas. IREN also announced a separate five-year, $3.4 billion AI Cloud contract with Nvidia for air-cooled Blackwell GPUs, with deployment expected within 60 megawatts of existing data centers at Childress and a targeted ramp beginning in early 2027. The update pushes IREN further away from the pure bitcoin-mining identity it carried when it operated as Iris Energy.

May 18 (Reuters) - Anthropic said on Monday it is revising its earlier position to allow users of its Mythos cybersecurity model ‌to share information about cyber threats with others who may be exposed ‌to similar vulnerabilities. Mythos, announced on April 7, is being deployed as part of Anthropic's "Project Glasswing," a controlled ​initiative under which select organizations, including major tech firms such as Amazon,
Microsoft
,
Nvidia
and
Apple
, are permitted to use the unreleased Claude Mythos Preview model for defensive cybersecurity purposes. Mythos' capabilities to code at a high level have given it a potentially ‌unprecedented ability to identify cybersecurity ⁠vulnerabilities and devise ways to exploit them, according to experts. Last week, Anthropic began telling partners that they are generally permitted to disclose ⁠their involvement in Glasswing and, at their own discretion, share findings, best practices, tools or code developed through the program. "We fully support our partners sharing findings with each ​other and ​companies outside of Glasswing to triage vulnerabilities," ​an Anthropic spokesperson said in a ‌statement. "While there was never a specific Glasswing NDA, confidentiality protections were something partners asked for at the outset and were built into agreements partners signed."
The protections were included in agreements with participating companies under which the model is provided, after partners sought assurances before sharing sensitive findings and expressed concern about being targeted by ‌attackers. "As the program has matured, we've adapted them ​to ensure key information can be shared broadly - ​including outside the program - for maximum ​defensive impact," the spokesperson added.

[MSFT] Microsoft Relationship Seen as Complementary
Asked about investor concerns over Microsoft concentration, Jiang said AvePoint has operated in the Microsoft ecosystem for more than 20 years but does not depend on Microsoft as a reseller. He said Microsoft does not resell AvePoint’s products, and AvePoint helps customers complete “last mile” adoption of workloads such as Purview, E5 and Copilot. Jiang said AvePoint is also active in the Google, Salesforce and AWS ecosystems as customers become increasingly multi-cloud. He said AvePoint is complementary to hyperscalers because it helps customers manage different license types and workloads across multiple platforms. On Microsoft 365 backup, Jiang said Microsoft Office Cloud has roughly 400 million to 500 million user seats, while AvePoint covers “tens of millions” of seats and is not yet at 100 million. He said the company still sees room for growth, while also incorporating Microsoft’s Backup Express snapshot capability into its own backup stack. Jiang said many customers use a mix of license levels, noting that E5 penetration remains below 20% and Copilot penetration is about 5%, according to his comments. He said AvePoint helps customers maximize existing investments rather than pushing them toward the highest-cost licenses. Multi-Cloud Expansion and SaaS Model
Jiang said AvePoint expects non-Microsoft revenue to rise to more than 30% of its mix as the company pursues its goal of reaching $1 billion in annual recurring revenue. He said non-Microsoft revenue is currently less than 10%. He said the company already has product coverage across ecosystems including Google, Salesforce, Atlassian, ServiceNow and AWS, but go-to-market development takes time because each ecosystem has different partners and channels. Jiang also highlighted AvePoint’s SaaS-heavy model. He said 88% of revenue is recurring and that AvePoint runs on hyperscaler infrastructure across GCP, Azure, AWS and U.S. government data centers. He said hyperscaler contracts help shield AvePoint from hardware supply-chain shocks and pricing volatility. “We are a true SaaS company that’s asset light,” Jiang said. Control Suite and AgentPulse

He said AvePoint competes across areas that had previously been separate, including migration, backup, governance and data security posture management. Jiang also discussed AvePoint AgentPulse, which he said became generally available in the first quarter after a preview late last year. He said AgentPulse helps customers discover AI agents running across cloud environments such as Gemini and Copilot, control what systems and data they can access, monitor token consumption and shut agents down when needed. Jiang said AgentPulse is monetized through AvePoint’s “best” Control bundle and is helping increase Control deal sizes. 2. **Meta 的 AI 投資正廣泛應用於其產品生態系統中。** 這些 AI 投資支持了應用程式中的內容排序系統、推薦相關內容的發現引擎、廣告客戶觸達客戶的工具、新生成式 AI 體驗的開發，以及提升產品開發效率的各項工具 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。此外，Meta AI 作為一款助手已可在其各項應用程式、獨立應用程式、AI 眼鏡及網頁上使用 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

3. **Meta 的資本支出大幅增長，反映其對基礎設施的積極投資。** 在現金流量表上，Meta 購置物業與設備的支出從 2024 年全年的 37,256 百萬美元大幅增加至 2025 年全年的 69,691 百萬美元 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #2]。截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日的九個月期間，此項支出為 48,308 百萬美元，高於 2024 年同期的 22,831 百萬美元 [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #2]。同時，截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日，其物業與設備淨值達到 160,270 百萬美元，相比 2024 年 12 月 31 日的 121,346 百萬美元顯著上升 [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #1]。

4. **Meta 預期 AI 計畫將需要持續增加基礎設施與人員的投資，若長期投資不成功，其業務與財務表現可能會受損。** 該公司已對 AI 計畫（包括生成式 AI 和超級智慧）進行了重大投資，並預期將繼續增加這些投資 [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #61]。Meta 也在開發和訓練其 AI 模型方面進行了大量投資，並預期將繼續增加這些投資 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #188]。然而，這些 AI 計畫也伴隨風險，包括可能面臨有害內容、不準確資訊、智慧財產權侵權等問題，以及來自其他開發類似或更優越 AI 技術公司的激烈競爭 [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #61]。

5. **Meta 的 Reality Labs 投資對短期利潤造成壓力，但公司持續推進新平台佈局。** Reality Labs 的投資在 2025 年使整體營業利潤減少了約 191.9 億美元，Meta 預期 2026 年 Reality Labs 的營業虧損將與 2025 年保持相似 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #188]。儘管如此，Meta 仍持續增加對包括 VR、Horizon 和穿戴式裝置在內的新平台與技術的投資 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #188]。

[META 10-K period 2025] Item 1.Business 

Overview

Our mission is to build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible. Our products enable people to connect and share through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality (VR) headsets, and AI glasses. We are innovating in artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to build transformative experiences and capabilities across our Family of Apps and new platforms, and to advance our vision to deliver personal superintelligence for everyone. We build technology that helps people connect and share, find and build communities, and grow businesses. We also help people discover and learn about what is going on in the world around them, enable people to share their experiences, ideas, photos, videos, and other content with audiences ranging from their closest family members and friends to the public at large, and stay connected everywhere by accessing our products. Meta is moving our offerings beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next computing platform. Our vision does not center on any single product, but rather an entire ecosystem of experiences, devices, and new technologies powered by AI. While the metaverse is in the very early stages of its development, we believe it will become the next computing platform and the future of social interaction. Across our work, we are innovating to build new experiences that help make our platform more social, useful, and immersive. Our AI investments support initiatives across our products and services, helping power the systems that rank content in our apps, our discovery engine that recommends relevant content, the tools advertisers use to reach customers, the development of new generative AI experiences, and the tools that make our product development more efficient and productive. We are also working to develop the next generation of AI models and advance our vision to build superintelligence, which we define as AI that surpasses human intelligence. Although it is inherently difficult to predict when superintelligence may be achieved, we are investing now because we believe this has the potential to begin a new era of individual empowerment, where people can direct superintelligence towards what they value in their own lives. Family of Apps Products

•Facebook. Facebook helps give people the power to build community and bring the world closer together. It's a place for people to share life's moments and discuss what's happening, nurture and build relationships, discover and connect to people with shared interests, and create economic opportunity. They can do this through Feed, Reels, Stories, Groups, Marketplace, and more. •Instagram. Instagram brings people closer to the people and things they love. Instagram Feed, Stories, Reels, Live, and messaging are places where people and creators can connect and express themselves through photos, video, and private messaging, and discover and shop from their favorite businesses. •Messenger. Messenger is a simple yet powerful messaging application for people to connect with friends, family, communities, and businesses across platforms and devices through text, audio, and video calls. •Meta AI. Meta AI is an assistant that's available across our apps, as a stand-alone app, on our AI glasses, and on the web. It's designed to help people learn, get things done, create content, and connect with others to make the most of every moment.

We are also continuing to increase our investments in new platforms and technologies, including as part of our VR, Horizon, and wearables efforts. To the Stockholders and the Board of Directors of Meta Platforms, Inc. Opinion on the Financial Statements

We have audited the accompanying consolidated balance sheets of Meta Platforms, Inc. (the Company) as of December 31, 2025 and 2024, the related consolidated statements of income, comprehensive income, stockholders' equity and cash flows for each of the three years in the period ended December 31, 2025, and the related notes (collectively referred to as the "consolidated financial statements"). In our opinion, the consolidated financial statements present fairly, in all material respects, the financial position of the Company at December 31, 2025 and 2024, and the results of its operations and its cash flows for each of the three years in the period ended December 31, 2025, in conformity with U.S. generally accepted accounting principles. We also have audited, in accordance with the standards of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (United States) (PCAOB), the Company's internal control over financial reporting as of December 31, 2025, based on criteria established in Internal Control–Integrated Framework issued by the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission (2013 framework), and our report dated January 28, 2026 expressed an unqualified opinion thereon. Basis for Opinion

These financial statements are the responsibility of the Company's management. Our responsibility is to express an opinion on the Company's financial statements based on our audits. We are a public accounting firm registered with the PCAOB and are required to be independent with respect to the Company in accordance with the U.S. federal securities laws and the applicable rules and regulations of the Securities and Exchange Commission and the PCAOB. We conducted our audits in accordance with the standards of the PCAOB. Those standards require that we plan and perform the audit to obtain reasonable assurance about whether the financial statements are free of material misstatement, whether due to error or fraud. Our audits included performing procedures to assess the risks of material misstatement of the financial statements, whether due to error or fraud, and performing procedures that respond to those risks. Such procedures included examining, on a test basis, evidence regarding the amounts and disclosures in the financial statements. Our audits also included evaluating the accounting principles used and significant estimates made by management, as well as evaluating the overall presentation of the financial statements. We believe that our audits provide a reasonable basis for our opinion. Critical Audit Matters

[META 10-Q period 202509] We may not be successful in our artificial intelligence initiatives, which could adversely affect our business, reputation, or financial results. We have made significant investments in AI initiatives, including generative AI and superintelligence, to, among other things, recommend relevant content across our products, enhance our advertising tools, develop new products, and develop new features for existing products, and expect to continue to increase these investments. In particular, we expect our AI initiatives will require increased investment in infrastructure and headcount. If our investments are not successful longer-term, our business and financial performance could be harmed. There are significant risks involved in developing and deploying AI and there can be no assurance that the usage of AI will enhance our products or services or be beneficial to our business, including our efficiency or profitability. For example, our AI-related efforts, particularly those related to generative AI and superintelligence, subject us to risks related to harmful or illegal content, accuracy, misinformation and deepfakes (including related to elections), bias, discrimination, toxicity, consumer protection, products liability, intellectual property infringement or misappropriation, defamation, data privacy, cybersecurity, and sanctions and export controls, among others. It is also uncertain how various laws related to online services, intermediary liability, and other issues will apply to content generated by AI. In addition, we are subject to the risks of new or enhanced governmental or regulatory scrutiny, litigation, or other legal liability, ethical concerns, negative consumer perceptions as to automation and AI, activities that threaten people's safety or well-being on- or offline, including with respect to younger users, or other complications that could adversely affect our business, reputation, or financial results. records.query: 亞馬遜最近在歐洲有什麼大型投資的新聞？
records.answer:
亞馬遜在2026年6月宣佈計劃在歐洲投資超過100億歐元，以擴張和強化其歐洲營運 [AMZN_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。

以下是該投資計劃的具體細節：

**物流現代化與機器人部署**
亞馬遜計劃現代化其處於電商帝國核心的履約設施，部分計劃涉及部署能夠在整個設施中運作並回應員工對話式文字提示的下一代機器人 [AMZN_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。公司計劃在2027年上半年在歐洲部署其自主 Proteus 機器人，並擴展其與員工一同處理貨箱放置的 STARK 機器人系統 [AMZN_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。

**就業與人才培訓**
儘管公司以機器人現代化設施，它同時計劃在此擴張行動中創造25,000個新工作機會 [AMZN_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。此外，亞馬遜透過 Career Choice 計劃承諾投入10億美元用於員工教育與培訓，涵蓋網路安全與軟體開發等高成長領域 [AMZN_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。

**超快配送服務擴展**
亞馬遜也計劃在年底前於曼徹斯特和伯明罕推出 Amazon Now 超快配送服務，此前該服務已於倫敦推出 [AMZN_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。

records.query: 最近有什麼跟 Tesla 或 Elon Musk 相關、影響 Tesla 關注度的新聞？
records.answer:
最近影響 Tesla 關注度的新聞主要集中在兩個方面：一是 SpaceX 即將上市的消息搶走了市場焦點，使 Tesla 股價表現相對平淡；二是 Tesla 即將發布財報，投資人密切關注 Optimus 機器人和自動駕駛（robotaxi）這兩大關鍵驅動力。

**SpaceX IPO 轉移市場注意力**

SpaceX 預計於 6 月 12 日（週五）在 Nasdaq 上市，股票代號為 SPCX，目標 IPO 定價為每股 135 美元 [TSLA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。由於 SpaceX 上市的消息引發大量市場炒作，Tesla 的關注度因此被邊緣化——評論指出「Tesla's kind of taken a back seat with all the hype on SpaceX right now」，Tesla 股價近期也沒有太多令人興奮的表現 [TSLA_News_20260721_01.txt, chunk #0]。

**Tesla 財報與兩大關注重點**

Tesla 本週將發布財報，投資人將聚焦兩個關鍵議題：Optimus 機器人與自動駕駛（robo taxi）[TSLA_News_20260721_01.txt, chunk #2]。市場雖然仍將 Tesla 視為一家電動車製造商，但真正推動其前景的是 robotaxi 和機器人業務 [TSLA_News_20260721_01.txt, chunk #2]。不過，就在幾週前 Tesla 發布了優於預期的交付數據，令市場感到意外 [TSLA_News_20260721_01.txt, chunk #1]，這讓分析師認為 Tesla 在財報中帶來正面驚喜的可能性不低 [TSLA_News_20260721_01.txt, chunk #0]。

**Elon Musk 的領導風格與願景**

在 SpaceX 上市前夕，早期 Tesla 顧問 Scott Painter 分享了對 Musk 領導風格的第一手觀察，稱他為「big idea 之王」[TSLA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #1]。Painter 描述 Musk 會與團隊通宵達旦組裝 Model X，親自示範並確保工程品質 [TSLA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #1]。Musk 的思維格局極為宏大，從人類成為多行星物種到言論自由等文明級問題都在他的思考範圍內，這使他成為「真正獨一無二的人物」[TSLA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #3]。此外，市場也流傳 Elon 的下一個大動作可能是合併（merger），雖然尚未正式確認，但已被市場討論多年 [TSLA_News_20260721_01.txt, chunk #0]。

records.query: 最近科技巨頭（Magnificent Seven）的股價有什麼值得注意的消息？
records.answer:

- TD Cowen 於 6 月 4 日重申對 Microsoft 的 Buy 評級，並設定 540 美元目標價，看好該公司推出七款自建 AI 模型、聚焦微調與成本優化的新策略 [MSFT_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。
- Microsoft 已將大量 GPU 產能分配給內部研發團隊，顯示其減少對外部前沿 AI 實驗室依賴的決心；同時在 Build 2026 大會上展示 AI 平台進展，並計畫協助用戶部署 AI 代理 [MSFT_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。
- 當日 MSFT 股價下跌 1.77% [MSFT_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。

**Meta Platforms（META）**
- Morgan Stanley 分析師 Brian Nowak 於 6 月 6 日重申 Meta 為大型科技股中的首選，目標價 775 美元，認為市場低估了 Meta 在大規模 AI 支出下不斷擴大的競爭護城河 [META_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。
- Meta 預計 2027 至 2028 年資本支出達 3,800 億美元，分析師預期這些投資可為 2028 年每股盈餘增加 1 至 3 美元 [META_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。
- Meta AI 搜尋工具若維持 10 億用戶且僅將每日查詢的 10% 變現，預計可創造超過 100 億美元的年收入；公司也已開始推出分層訂閱方案以追求高利潤營收來源 [META_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。
- 當日 META 股價下跌 0.45% [META_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。

**Alphabet/Google（GOOGL）**
- Alphabet 計畫透過公開發行普通股與 6.25% 強制轉換優先證券募集約 347.5 億美元，另規劃 400 億美元的市場股票發行計畫，以及與 Berkshire Hathaway 的 100 億美元私募配售，總計約 847.5 億美元的資金募集，Moody's 於 6 月 5 日評定此舉對信用評級有利 [GOOGL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0]。

- 當日 GOOG 股價上漲 0.92% [GOOGL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0]。

- Apple 營收成長方面，過去 12 個月（LTM）成長 12.8%，3 年平均年營收成長 5.6% [AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #1]。

NVIDIA 的營收成長極為強勁，最新 12 個月（TTM）營收達約 2,535 億美元，年成長率約 85.2% [NVDA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #0]。與此同時，NVIDIA 與 IREN 簽訂了為期五年、價值 34 億美元的 AI 雲端合約，並透過最高 21 億美元的股權投資綁定 GPU 部署進度，反映出 NVIDIA 正從單純的晶片供應商，進一步深入參與大規模 AI 資料中心的建設與部署節奏 [NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0] [NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1]。

以下從財報數據與資料中心布局兩個層面進一步說明：

**1. 營收與獲利成長速度**

- NVIDIA 的 12 個月滾動營收從約 2,159.4 億美元成長至約 2,534.9 億美元，年成長率約 85.2% [NVDA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #0] [NVDA_Fundamentals_20260508.txt, chunk #0]。淨利約 1,596.1 億美元，淨利率約 63% [NVDA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #0]。
- 在 10-Q 中，NVIDIA 指出 Data Center networking 營收較 2025 會計年度前九個月同期成長 105%，主要受 NVLink compute fabric（用於 GB200 與 GB300 系統）、XDR InfiniBand 產品成長，以及乙太網路在 AI 解決方案中的採用所帶動 [NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #53]。
- 同一期間，第三季與前九個月的繪圖（Graphics）營收年增則由 Blackwell 架構的銷售推動 [NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #53]。

**2. 客戶集中度**

- 10-Q 指出，在第三季（fiscal year 2026 的第三季），四個直接客戶的銷售額各超過總營收的 10%，分別為 22%、15%、13% 與 11%，均歸屬於 Compute & Networking 部門 [NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #53]。來源僅列出四個客戶的個別比例，並未提供合計數字。

**3. 與 IREN 的 AI 雲端合作案及資料中心布局進展**

- **大規模 AI 雲端合約**：NVIDIA 與 IREN 簽訂了五年期、34 億美元的 AI 雲端合約，採用氣冷式 Blackwell GPU，部署預計位於 IREN 的 Childress 現有資料中心內 60 MW 的空間，目標自 2027 年初開始放量 [NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0] [NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1]。
- **股權投資與部署掛鉤**：NVIDIA 獲得 IREN 發行的五年期認購權，可購買最多 3,000 萬股普通股、每股 70 美元，若全數行使相當於最高 21 億美元的潛在投資 [NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0]。此投資的權利僅在 NVIDIA GPU 基礎設施部署於 IREN 園區時才逐步歸屬（vest），且「只有在部署 60 萬顆 GPU 後才完全歸屬」 [NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1]。
- **5 GW 戰略合作框架**：雙方的戰略合作涵蓋最高 5 GW 的「NVIDIA HGX 對齊 AI 基礎設施」，包括 DGX 環境與 MGX AI 工廠參考架構，未來部署以 IREN 位於德州、容量 2 GW 的 Sweetwater 園區為中心 [NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1] [NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0]。
- **IREN 的擴建目標**：IREN 的建置目標為 2026 年達到 480 MW 與約 15 萬顆 GPU，2027 年擴增至 1,210 MW（另有 730 MW 在建），由 300 MW 的液冷 Childress 專案領銜 [NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1]。IREN 已將其合約年經常性收入（ARR）提升至 31 億美元，並重申 2026 年底達 37 億美元 ARR 的目標 [NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1]。

**4. 技術平台與生態系統**

- NVIDIA 的 10-K 描述了自 Blackwell 架構起，其資料中心級產品採取「極端協同設計」（extreme co-design），將晶片、網路、系統、軟體與演算法整體架構與最佳化，使數十萬顆 GPU 可互連為一台巨型電腦 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。在 2026 會計年度，NVIDIA 推出並擴大了 Blackwell Ultra 平台，針對 agentic、reasoning 及 physical AI 進行最佳化，較 Hopper 世代大幅提升 token 吞吐量並降低每 token 成本 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]。
- IREN 的財報電話會議中亦提到，IREN 已開始為 Microsoft 進行 Horizon One GPU 的部署與調試 [NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1]。來源僅提及 IREN 為 Microsoft 部署 GPU，並未進一步說明此舉代表 NVIDIA 與 Microsoft 之間的合作模式或資料中心布局策略。

The stock rose 27% to $72.28 after closing at $56.85, before pulling back to $69.45 at press time, still up more than 21%. The rally followed IREN’s disclosure of a five-gigawatt strategic partnership with Nvidia tied to the deployment of AI infrastructure across its global data center pipeline. Under the agreement, IREN issued Nvidia a five-year right to purchase up to 30 million ordinary shares at $70 per share. If fully exercised, the right would represent up to $2.1 billion of potential investment, subject to conditions including regulatory limits. The partnership is expected to focus on Nvidia-aligned DSX AI factory infrastructure, with future deployments centred around IREN’s two-gigawatt Sweetwater campus in Texas. IREN also announced a separate five-year, $3.4 billion AI Cloud contract with Nvidia for air-cooled Blackwell GPUs, with deployment expected within 60 megawatts of existing data centers at Childress and a targeted ramp beginning in early 2027. The update pushes IREN further away from the pure bitcoin-mining identity it carried when it operated as Iris Energy.

records.query: NVIDIA 目前的毛利率表現如何？加上新聞中黃仁勳對中國市場開放 AI 晶片銷售的最新談話，這對公司未來營收有何潛在影響？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 目前的毛利率約為 71.1%，表現極為強勁，而黃仁勳預期中國市場將「隨時間推移」逐步開放對高階 AI 晶片的採購，但短期內中國客戶尚無明顯採購跡象，且北京正加速本土晶片發展以挑戰美國的主導地位，這意味著中國市場對 NVIDIA 未來營收的貢獻存在不確定性。

**毛利率表現：**

NVIDIA 的毛利率為 71.068%（約 71.1%），營業利益率為 65.024%，淨利率為 55.603% [NVDA_Fundamentals_20260519.txt, chunk #0]。以絕對金額來看，截至 2026 會計年度（截至 2026 年 1 月 25 日），全年總營收為 2,159.38 億美元，毛利為 1,534.63 億美元，營業利益為 1,303.87 億美元，淨利為 1,200.67 億美元 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #160]。相較 2025 會計年度毛利 978.58 億美元與 2024 會計年度毛利 443.01 億美元，毛利率持續維持在高檔 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #160]。

**黃仁勳對中國市場的最新談話：**

NVIDIA 執行長黃仁勳預期中國最終將開放其市場，允許可用於訓練和運行人工智慧系統的高階美國晶片銷售 [NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #0]。他在接受彭博電視台訪問時表示，H200 晶片已獲得許可銷往中國（"H200s are licensed to sell to China"）[NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #0]。然而，目前沒有跡象顯示中國科技公司正在購買這些晶片，因為北京正加速國內晶片發展，以挑戰美國在這個關鍵領域的主導地位 [NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #0]。黃仁勳上週隨美國總統川普前往中國，會見了中國國家主席習近平，但並未與北京高層官員討論 H200 模型的銷售事宜 [NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #0]。

**對未來營收的潛在影響：**

從營收數據來看，NVIDIA 來自中國（含香港）的營收在 2026 會計年度為 196.77 億美元，低於 2025 會計年度的 250.48 億美元 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #210]。在 2026 會計年度第三季度（截至 2025 年 10 月 26 日），中國營收為 29.73 億美元，較 2025 會計年度同期的 81.42 億美元大幅下降 [NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #42]。同期總營收分別為 570.06 億美元與 350.82 億美元 [NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #42]。

NVIDIA 在 10-K 中揭露多項可能影響未來毛利率與財務表現的風險因素，包括政府行動或政策變化（如出口管制、關稅）、競爭技術與競爭對手產品發布、客戶與合作夥伴能否及時取得資料中心容量與電力等 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #61]。出口管制已對 NVIDIA 服務海外市場的能力造成影響，並可能使提供替代產品的競爭對手受益 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #93]。此外，中國反壟斷監管機構於 2025 年 9 月 15 日發布初步調查結果，認定 NVIDIA 遵守美國出口管制而向中國市場提供降規產品的做法，對中國客戶構成不公平歧視，因此違反了中國批准 NVIDIA 收購 Mellanox 的條款 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #93]。若監管機構認定 NVIDIA 未履行 Mellanox 收購條款或違反中國法律，NVIDIA 可能面臨財務處罰、業務經營限制或對其網路業務、產品與服務的限制，這些都可能對其業務、經營成果與財務狀況造成重大不利影響 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #93]。

總結而言，NVIDIA 目前毛利率維持在約 71% 的高水準 [NVDA_Fundamentals_20260519.txt, chunk #0]，但中國市場的開放時程與實際採購意願仍存在不確定性，加上出口管制與中國反壟斷調查等風險，中國市場對 NVIDIA 未來營收的貢獻仍需持續觀察。

Nvidia boss Jensen Huang expects China to eventually open its market to high-end US chips that can train and run artificial intelligence systems. But he did not discuss sales of the powerful H200 model with top officials in Beijing, the businessman told Bloomberg Television in an interview broadcast Monday. Huang travelled to the country last week with US President Donald Trump, who met Chinese President Xi Jinping. The superpowers are in a fierce race for AI supremacy, and the H200 chip had until recently been barred from sale in China by Washington over national security concerns. However, there is no sign that Chinese tech companies are buying them, as Beijing ramps up domestic chip development in a bid to challenge US dominance in the key sector. records.query: Apple 目前的獲利能力數字（毛利率、淨利率）為何？加上新聞中 Evercore ISI 最新調升的目標價與評等，市場如何綜合看待這家公司？
records.answer:
Apple 目前獲利能力極強，TTM（過去十二個月）毛利率達 47.9%，營業利益率 32.6%，而分析機構 Evercore ISI 將目標價從 330 美元調升至 365 美元並維持「優於大盤（Outperform）」評等，市場綜合看法是：Apple 是一台現金製造機，但估值偏貴、成長性在同儕中相對溫和，屬於穩健型的高品質複利標的。

**獲利能力數字**

- **毛利率**：Apple 的 TTM 毛利率為 47.9%，高於 FY2024 的 46.2% 和 FY2019 的 38.2%，主要受 Services 營收佔比上升推動 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。就 FY2025（截至 2025 年 9 月 27 日）全年而言，總毛利率為 46.9%，其中 Products 毛利率 36.8%、Services 毛利率 75.4% [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #156]。在 FY2026 第一季度（截至 2025 年 12 月 27 日），總毛利率進一步提升至 48.2%，Products 毛利率升至 40.7%，Services 毛利率升至 76.5% [AAPL_10Q_202512.html, chunk #54]。
- **營業利益率**：TTM 營業利益率為 32.6% [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。FY2025 全年營業利益為 1,330.5 億美元，淨利為 1,120.1 億美元 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #2]。以 FY2025 淨利 1,120.1 億美元除以總營收 4,161.61 億美元計算，淨利率約 26.9% [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #2]。
- **EBITDA 利率**：35.4%，在同儕中僅次於 SNDK 的 56.0% [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。
- **自由現金流**：TTM 自由現金流 1,292 億美元，槓桿自由現金流利率 22.4% 領先同儕；現金流來自營運的 TTM 金額達 1,402 億美元 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。

**Evercore ISI 目標價與評等**

- Evercore ISI 於 5 月 14 日將 Apple 目標價從 330 美元調升至 365 美元，維持「優於大盤（Outperform）」評等，並點出 iPhone 高溢價與摺疊手機等正面因素 [AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #0]。

**市場綜合看法**

- **估值偏高**：Apple 的遠期本益比為 33.5 倍，高於多數同儕（Dell 22.2 倍、SNDK 24.2 倍、WDC 29.7 倍）；價格/現金流量比為 30.7 倍，遠高於 Dell 的 14.4 倍 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。
- **成長性溫和**：Apple 的 12.8% 年營收成長率落後 SNDK 的 82.8%、WDC 的 32.0% 和 STX 的 28.9%；遠期營收成長率僅 9.6%，是該組別中除 WDC 外最弱的 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。但三年營收 CAGR 為 5.4%，優於 WDC 和 SNDK 的負值 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。
- **資產負債表穩健**：Apple 持有 1,466 億美元現金與有價證券，對應 827 億美元長期債務，淨現金部位為正且持續增長 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。FY2026 上半年執行了 77 億美元股息與 370 億美元回購 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。
- **AI 與產品動能**：Apple 在 WWDC 推出 Siri AI 與 Apple Intelligence 平台，應用於 Safari、Password 和 Messages 等應用 [AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #0]。RiverPark Large Growth Fund 指出，iPhone 17 銷售優於預期、Services 動能強勁，且裝置端 AI 功能的早期採用率超出內部預期，尤其在北美與歐洲的 Pro 機型附掛率維持高檔 [AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #0]。
- **風險**：Apple 自身警告未來毛利率將面臨波動與下行壓力，且關稅成本已對 Products 毛利率造成部分抵銷 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #156]。在 33.5 倍遠期本益比與低於 10% 的遠期營收成長下，留給 iPhone 銷售失誤或關稅升級的空間很小 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。

[AAPL] TTM gross margin reached 47.9%, up from 46.2% in FY 2024 and 38.2% back in FY 2019, driven by the rising Services mix. Operating margin now sits at 32.6%, and the company throws off $129.2 billion in free cash flow on a TTM basis. That FCF easily covers the $7.7 billion in dividends and $37.0 billion in buybacks Apple executed in the first half of FY 2026. The balance sheet is fortress-grade. Apple holds $146.6 billion in cash and marketable securities against $82.7 billion in term debt. Net cash position is positive and growing. Valuation
Source: Seeking Alpha
Apple trades at a premium to nearly every peer on this list, with the exception of
Seagate Technology (STX)
. On forward P/E, Apple sits at 33.5x versus
Sandisk (SNDK)
at 24.2x,
Western Digital (WDC)
at 29.7x, and
Dell Technologies (DELL)
at just 22.2x. Price-to-cash-flow tells a similar story. Apple commands 30.7x, well above Dell’s 14.4x but cheaper than WDC and STX. The market is paying up for Apple’s Services mix, capital returns, and brand moat. Whether that’s justified is the central question. Growth
Source: Seeking Alpha
Here’s where the premium gets harder to defend. Apple’s 12.8% YoY revenue growth trails SNDK’s 82.8% surge, WDC’s 32.0%, and STX’s 28.9%. Forward revenue growth of 9.6% is the weakest in the group except WDC. Yet Apple’s three-year revenue CAGR of 5.4% beats WDC and SNDK, both of whom posted negative numbers over that stretch. The hardware peers are riding an AI-driven storage upcycle. Apple is the steadier compounder. Profitability
Source: Seeking Alpha
This is Apple’s home turf. Apple’s 47.9% gross margin trails only SNDK’s 56.0%. EBITDA margin of 35.4% beats every peer except SNDK. Levered FCF margin of 22.4% leads the group. Return on common equity of 141.5% dwarfs everyone except STX, which benefits from a tiny equity base. Most striking: Apple generated $140.2 billion in cash from operations on a TTM basis. The next closest, Dell, did $11.2 billion. Continued…
Our Opinion 7/10
Apple’s quarter was a genuine surprise to the upside, and the company’s cash generation remains in a league of its own. The dividend hike and fresh $100 billion buyback give investors a tangible return floor. But the stock isn’t cheap. At 33.5x forward earnings with sub-10% forward revenue growth, you’re paying a quality premium that leaves little room for an iPhone stumble or a tariff escalation. For long-term holders, Apple stays a core position.

Search volume from financial pros spiked, with Apple drawing nearly 21,000 searches in the past month, per our TrackStar data, more than its next four hardware peers combined. So is the run sustainable, or did Apple just front-load demand ahead of more tariff drama? Apple’s Business
Apple needs no introduction, but the company’s transformation does. What was once a hardware story is now a hybrid: $80.2 billion in product sales last quarter alongside $31.0 billion in high-margin services. The installed base of active devices hit another all-time high across every product category and every geography. Apple sells iPhones, Macs, iPads, wearables, and a growing suite of subscription services to roughly a billion paying users globally. Apple segments its business into the following areas:
iPhone (51% of total revenues)
– Flagship smartphone line, recently expanded with the iPhone 17 lineup and a new iPhone 17e
Services (28% of total revenues)
– App Store, advertising, iCloud, Apple Music, Apple TV+, and payment services
Mac (8% of total revenues)
– Laptops and desktops, including the newly launched MacBook Neo
Wearables, Home & Accessories (7% of total revenues)
– AirPods, Apple Watch, Vision Pro, and accessories
iPad (6% of total revenues)
– Tablet lineup, recently refreshed with the M4-powered iPad Air
iPhone revenue jumped 22% to $57.0 billion, the standout of the quarter. Services climbed 16% to a record $31.0 billion, propelled by advertising, App Store, and cloud. Greater China rebounded sharply, with renminbi strength adding fuel. Tim Cook called demand for the iPhone 17 lineup “extraordinary.”
On the strategic front, Apple is going all-in on AI infrastructure. R&D spending jumped 34% year-over-year to $11.4 billion last quarter, citing higher infrastructure costs. Tariff overhang remains real but manageable. A February Supreme Court ruling struck down certain tariffs, and Apple is applying for refunds. The company also flagged that semiconductor, NAND, and DRAM supply constraints could pressure costs into the next quarter. Story Continues

Apple 近一年（trailing twelve months，TTM）的整體營收年成長率約為 12.8%，同時公司正透過結合 Google Gemini 模型打造的全新 Siri AI 來強化其 AI 競爭力，試圖將此轉化為未來的產品升級與服務成長動能 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5] [AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0]。

**近一年營收成長表現**
根據新聞引用的財務數據，Apple 的 12.8% YoY（年同比）營收成長率反映了其過去一年的整體營收增長表現 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。對比單季數據，Apple 在 2025 會計年度（截至 2025 年 9 月 27 日）的總淨銷售額為 4,161.61 億美元，較 2024 會計年度的 3,910.35 億美元增長了 6% [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #155]。而在最新的 2026 會計年度第一季（截至 2025 年 12 月 27 日的三個月），單季總淨銷售額為 1,437.56 億美元，較去年同期 1,243.00 億美元增長 16% [AAPL_10Q_202512.html, chunk #53]。此外，新聞指出 Apple 的 iPhone 產品線在過去四個季度合計實現了 16% 的成長 [AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0]。

**Siri AI 新功能對未來成長動能的意義**
針對公司在 WWDC 發表的 Siri AI 新功能，參考資料指出以下幾個對未來成長具戰略意義的層面：

1. **技術合作與 AI 轉型**：在歷經兩年的延遲後，Apple 於 WWDC 發表了重新打造的 Siri AI（將以 beta 版形式推出）。此功能透過 Apple 與 Google 簽訂的協議，使用 Google 的 Gemini 模型來提供核心 AI 能力，解決了 Apple 自家模型表現不及預期的問題 [AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0]。Apple 軟體工程資深副總裁 Craig Federighi 特別強調，Apple 並非直接使用 Google 部署給客戶的模型或基礎設施，而是以自己的方式整合 [AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0]。

2. **產品功能與用戶體驗升級**：Siri AI 將能夠從用戶的應用程式中提取上下文資訊，讓用戶無需開啟其他獨立應用程式即可獲取所需內容（例如透過文字訊息找到姐姐推薦的播客名稱），使 Siri 從簡單的廚房計時器轉變為 AI 時代的數位助手 [AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0]。

3. **競爭定位與市場預期**：分析師 Gene Munster 認為這是 Apple 43 年歷史中最重要的開發者大會，預期 Siri AI 將能安全地利用個人上下文資訊、改善資訊檢索並實現第三方應用自動化，藉此讓 Apple 更有能力與 ChatGPT、Grok 和 Gemini 等競爭對手抗衡 [AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0]。這項 AI 整合策略預期將為市場情緒帶來顯著提振 [AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0]。

4. **獲利能力與評價支撐**：Apple 持續透過產品升級維持客戶忠誢度 [AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0]。目前其 TTM 毛利率已達 47.9%（高於 FY 2024 的 46.2%），營業利益率達 32.6%，並產生 1,292 億美元的自由現金流 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。雖然硬體升級帶動了營收成長，但市場給予 Apple 33.5 倍的本益比評價，很大程度是反映其服務收入佔比提升、資本回報與品牌護城河；若要支撐此高估值，Siri AI 等新功能的成功推進將是維持未來成長動能的關鍵 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。

How Apple rebuilt Siri with Google's AI
Daniel Howley
·

After two years of delays, Apple's (
AAPL
) reinvented Siri, Siri AI,
appears ready for primetime
. The company unveiled the AI-powered version of its assistant at its Worldwide Developers Conference in Cupertino, Calif., on Monday, saying it will launch, albeit as a beta, later this year. The update is designed to transform Siri from a glorified kitchen timer to a
digital helper for the AI age
. Apple said Siri AI will be able to pull context from your apps, allowing you to, say, ask it the name of a podcast your sister recommended via text and have it presented to you without opening any separate apps or services. The idea is for Siri AI to recognize what you want, when you want it, and surface it, whether it's content on your device or from the web. It's more or less what Apple promised when it showed off its AI-enhanced Siri and Apple Intelligence at WWDC 2024. And in early demos, Siri AI, which rides on Apple Intelligence, appears to deliver on Apple's initial vision for its reimagined Siri. And it's thanks, at least in part, to Google (
GOOG
,
GOOGL
). Siri gets Google brains
In January, Apple and Google signed an agreement for Apple to use the search giant's Gemini models to power its improved Siri. That gave Apple the high-powered AI models it needed to move Siri AI forward, after its own models fell short,
Bloomberg's Mark Gurman previously reported
. During a question and answer session following Apple's WWDC keynote, senior vice president of software engineering Craig Federighi explained how Apple uses Google's models to give Siri AI its smarts. The software chief was sure to point out that Siri AI isn't just a rebranded version of Google's own Gemini assistant. Federighi explained how the Gemini assistant uses Google's Gemini models, including Gemini Flash-Lite, Gemini Flash, Gemini Pro, and its Gemini Image models. When it comes to grounding those models in world knowledge, he said, Gemini takes advantage of Google Search. Apple, Federighi said, uses none of those things. "We use none of the models that Google deploys to their customers, nor do we use the infrastructure and means by which they employ models to their customers," he explained.

records.query: Microsoft 的營收成長率與營業利益率表現如何？加上新聞中它自研七個 AI 模型的策略進展，對公司的 AI 布局透露什麼訊息？
records.answer:
Microsoft 在 2025 會計年度的營收成長率為 15%，營業利益率約為 45.6%，顯示公司維持穩健的雙位數成長與高獲利能力，但大規模的 AI 基礎設施投資正對整體毛利率帶來些微壓力 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #143]。

以下為各項財務表現與 AI 布局訊息的詳細數據與分析：

**1. 營收與營業利益表現**
*   **2025 會計年度（截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日）**：Microsoft 的總營收為 2,817.24 億美元，較前一年成長 15%；營業利益為 1,285.28 億美元，年增 17%。若以營業利益除以總營收計算，整體營業利益率約為 45.6% [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #143] [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #168]。其中，Microsoft Cloud 營收成長 23% 至 1,689 億美元，是推動整體營收成長的核心動能 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #138]。
*   **2025 會計年度下半年（截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的單季與半年報）**：根據 10-Q 數據，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的三個月，總營收為 812.73 億美元（年增 17%），營業利益為 382.75 億美元（年增 23%）[MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #106]。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的六個月，總營收為 1,589.46 億美元（年增 18%），營業利益為 762.36 億美元（年增 23%）[MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #106]。

**2. AI 投資對利潤率的影響與 OpenAI 投資收益**
Microsoft 的財報數據明確顯示，公司正處於 AI 基礎設施的擴張期，這對短期利潤率造成影響，但也帶來了顯著的投資回報：
*   **毛利率受 AI 投資壓縮**：在 2025 會計年度，整體毛利率百分比微降，主因是 Intelligent Cloud 規模擴大 AI 基礎設施所帶來的影響，所幸部分被 Azure 的效率提升所抵銷；Microsoft Cloud 的毛利率百分比也降至 69% [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #143]。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的單季與半年報中，此一趨勢延續，Microsoft Cloud 毛利率百分比進一步降至 67%，主因是持續投資 AI 基礎設施且 AI 產品使用量增長，所幸 Azure 與 Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud 的效率提升抵銷了部分影響 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #105]。
*   **OpenAI 投資挹注獲利**：截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的三個月，Microsoft 對 OpenAI 的投資產生了淨利得，使淨利潤與稀釋每股盈餘分別增加了 76 億美元與 1.02 美元；而去年同期則因 OpenAI 投資的淨損失，使淨利潤與稀釋每股盈餘分別減少 9.39 億美元與 0.12 美元 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #105]。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的六個月期間，OpenAI 投資的淨利得則使淨利潤與稀釋每股盈餘分別增加 45 億美元與 0.60 美元 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #106]。

**3. 對公司 AI 布局透露的訊息**
雖然提供的參考資料中並未提及「自研七個 AI 模型」的具體策略進展，但從現有財報數據仍可歸納出 Microsoft 目前 AI 布局的幾個明確方向：
*   **AI 服務需求強勁，驅動雲端成長**：Azure 和其他雲端服務營收在 2025 會計年度成長 34% [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #138]，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的單季與半年報中，Azure 成長率進一步提升至 40%，顯示市場對 AI 相關雲端服務的需求持續擴大 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #109]。
*   **AI 產品已實質貢獻營收**：Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud 的營收成長中，明確受惠於「Microsoft 365 Copilot」的推動與每位用戶營收的增長，顯示 AI 功能已成功轉化為商用雲端的營收動能 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #109]。
*   **研發資源向 AI 與算力傾斜**：公司的營業費用成長主要來自於對算力與 AI 人才研發的投資 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #105]。這意味著 Microsoft 的 AI 策略不僅是透過對 OpenAI 的外部投資，更是將資源深度投入內部的雲端與 AI 工程研發，以支撐未來的 AI 服務規模化。

註：關於「自研七個 AI 模型」的問題，提供的參考文件中並無相關資訊，以上 AI 布局訊息皆為財報中可得的實質數據推論。

Microsoft 的營業利益率表現如何？
Microsoft 自研的七個 AI 模型的策略進展對公司 AI 布局透露了什麼訊息？

records.query: Microsoft 目前的獲利能力（淨利率）如何？加上新聞中它加入 Anthropic Mythos 資安計畫的最新消息，這顯示公司在 AI 資安領域有哪些布局？
records.answer:
Microsoft 在 2025 會計年度的淨利率約為 36.1%（淨利 $101,832M ÷ 營收 $281,724M），獲利能力極為強勁；同時，Microsoft 已加入 Anthropic 的「Project Glasswing」計畫，獲准使用未公開的 Claude Mythos Preview 網路安全模型來進行防禦性資安用途，顯示其積極以 AI 技術強化資安布局。

**獲利能力分析**

Microsoft 在 2025 會計年度（截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日）的淨利率約為 36.1%，這是基於當年度淨利 $101,832M 與總營收 $281,724M 計算得出 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #0]。相較於 2024 會計年度的淨利 $88,136M 與營收 $245,122M（淨利率約 36.0%），獲利能力保持穩定 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #0]。

在 2025 會計年度，Microsoft 的營業利益為 $128,528M，較前一年度成長 17% [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #143]。毛利率為 $193,893M [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #0]。不過，毛利率百分比略有下降，主要原因是 Intelligent Cloud 部門因擴充 AI 基礎設施而影響了毛利 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #143]。具體而言，Microsoft Cloud 毛利率百分比在 2025 會計年度降至 69% [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #143]，而在 2025 年 12 月季度（10-Q 報告期），Microsoft Cloud 毛利率百分比進一步降至 67% [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #105]。這兩個數據點分別來自不同報告期，顯示 AI 基礎設施投資對雲端毛利率持續產生壓力。

在 2025 年 12 月季度，Microsoft 的淨利和稀釋每股盈餘受到 OpenAI 投資淨收益的正向影響，分別增加了 $7.6B 和 $1.02 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #105]。

**AI 資安領域布局**

根據 2026 年 5 月的新聞，Microsoft 是參與 Anthropic「Project Glasswing」計畫的幾家主要科技公司之一 [MSFT_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #0]。該計畫是一項受控倡議，允許包括 Amazon、Microsoft、Nvidia 和 Apple 在內的特定組織，使用未公開的 Claude Mythos Preview 模型進行防禦性網路安全用途 [MSFT_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #0]。

Mythos 模型具備高水準的程式編寫能力，使其擁有前所未有的能力來識別網路安全漏洞並設計利用這些漏洞的方法 [MSFT_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #0]。Anthropic 已修訂其先前的立場，允許合作夥伴將透過該計畫開發的資安發現、最佳實踐、工具或程式碼與彼此以及 Glasswing 計畫外的公司分享，以進行漏洞分類 [MSFT_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #0]。合作夥伴可將資訊分享給其他公司的安全團隊、行業機構、監管機構、政府機構、開源維護者、媒體或公眾，但須遵守負責任的揭露規範 [MSFT_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #1]。

此外，The Pentagon 也正在部署 Mythos 來查找和修補美國政府各機構的軟體漏洞 [MSFT_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #1]。

在內部資安治理方面，Microsoft 的董事會至少每季度審查網路安全事項，由 CISO（首席資訊安全官）領導跨公司的網路安全策略、工程和營運，並向雲端 + AI 部門執行副總裁報告 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #130]。Microsoft 也設立了網路安全治理委員會（CGC），由具備網路安全背景的副 CISO 級別高階主管團隊組成，負責監督保護 Microsoft 運算環境、產品和服務的各項倡議 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #130]。

By Juby Babu
May 18 (Reuters) - Anthropic said on Monday it is revising its earlier position to allow users of its Mythos cybersecurity model ‌to share information about cyber threats with others who may be exposed ‌to similar vulnerabilities. Mythos, announced on April 7, is being deployed as part of Anthropic's "Project Glasswing," a controlled ​initiative under which select organizations, including major tech firms such as Amazon,
Microsoft
,
Nvidia
and
Apple
, are permitted to use the unreleased Claude Mythos Preview model for defensive cybersecurity purposes. Mythos' capabilities to code at a high level have given it a potentially ‌unprecedented ability to identify cybersecurity ⁠vulnerabilities and devise ways to exploit them, according to experts. Last week, Anthropic began telling partners that they are generally permitted to disclose ⁠their involvement in Glasswing and, at their own discretion, share findings, best practices, tools or code developed through the program. "We fully support our partners sharing findings with each ​other and ​companies outside of Glasswing to triage vulnerabilities," ​an Anthropic spokesperson said in a ‌statement. "While there was never a specific Glasswing NDA, confidentiality protections were something partners asked for at the outset and were built into agreements partners signed."
The protections were included in agreements with participating companies under which the model is provided, after partners sought assurances before sharing sensitive findings and expressed concern about being targeted by ‌attackers. "As the program has matured, we've adapted them ​to ensure key information can be shared broadly - ​including outside the program - for maximum ​defensive impact," the spokesperson added.

[MSFT 10-K period 2025] Cybersecurity reviews by the Board are scheduled to occur at least quarterly, or more frequently as determined to be necessary or advisable. Presentations to the Board of Directors are made by senior management, including our Chief Information Security Officer (“CISO”), our EVP of Microsoft Security, our EVP of Cloud + AI, and the head of our Customer Security and Trust organization. The presentations address topics such as cybersecurity threats, incidents, top risks and related remediation efforts, results from internal and third-party assessments, progress towards risk-mitigation goals, the functioning of our incident response program, regulatory developments, and digital diplomacy efforts. In addition, we have an escalation process in place to inform senior management and the Board of significant issues. Cybersecurity issues are also considered during separate Board meeting discussions regarding important matters like ERM, audit issues, operational budgeting, business continuity planning, mergers and acquisitions, brand management, and other relevant matters. Our CISO leads the strategy, engineering, and operations of cybersecurity across the company, and reports to the EVP of Cloud + AI. Our CISO has extensive experience assessing and managing cybersecurity programs and cybersecurity risk. Before joining Microsoft, our CISO served in a prior Chief Technology Officer role as well as in senior leadership, engineering, and operational roles within multiple organizations. In addition to the Board’s oversight of cybersecurity risk, to support the CISO, we have established a Cybersecurity Governance Council (“CGC”) charged with overseeing initiatives that safeguard Microsoft’s computing environments, products, and services. The CGC is comprised of an executive-level team of Deputy CISOs with cybersecurity backgrounds and expertise relevant to their roles. The CGC responsibilities include approving our enterprise security risk assessment process and results, determining the appropriate cybersecurity risk level and mitigations, reviewing the NIST CSF alignment, and supporting compliance with cybersecurity regulations. Our cybersecurity efforts are supported directly by Microsoft’s security and threat intelligence experts and our employees across the company, all of whom receive cybersecurity awareness training and education and are expected to support our efforts. 31

The Microsoft Cloud provides integration across the technology stack while offering openness, improving time to value, reducing costs, and increasing agility. records.query: Amazon 目前的毛利率與營業利益率表現如何？加上新聞中它在歐洲逾 100 億歐元的最新投資計畫，反映出什麼樣的成長策略？
records.answer:
Amazon 目前毛利率約 50.6%、營業利益率約 13.1%，獲利能力穩健，而其歐洲逾 100 億歐元的投資計畫反映出以自動化機器人、超快配送服務與人力資本升級為核心的長期成長策略，旨在深化歐洲市場的營運規模與效率。

**毛利率與營業利益率表現**

- 根據 2026 年 6 月 12 日生成的基本面資料，Amazon 的毛利率（Gross Margin）為 0.50604，即約 50.6%；營業利益率（Operating Margin）為 0.1314，即約 13.1% [AMZN_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #0]。
- 同一資料來源顯示，Amazon 的淨利率（Profit Margin）為 0.12224，即約 12.2% [AMZN_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #0]。
- 從 10-K 年報的損益表來看，2025 會計年度全年總營收為 $716,924 百萬，營業利益為 $79,975 百萬，據此計算的營業利益率約為 11.2% [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #0]。2024 會計年度全年總營收為 $637,959 百萬，營業利益為 $68,593 百萬 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #0]。
- 2025 年的銷貨成本（Cost of sales）為 $356,414 百萬，據此計算的毛利率約為 50.3% [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #0]。
- 就 TTM（過去十二個月）數據而言，營收為 $742.78B，毛利為 $375.88B，EBITDA 為 $155.86B [AMZN_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #0]。

**歐洲投資計畫與成長策略**

Amazon 於 2026 年 6 月宣布計畫在歐洲投資超過 €100 億（€10 billion），以擴張和強化其歐洲營運 [AMZN_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。此投資計畫反映出以下幾個策略面向：

1. **物流自動化與機器人部署**：Amazon 計畫現代化其履行設施，部署次世代機器人，包括能回應員工對話式文字提示的機器人系統。公司計畫於 2027 年上半年在歐洲部署自主型 Proteus 機器人，並擴展與員工協同處理貨箱放置的 STARK 機器人系統 [AMZN_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。這顯示 Amazon 將自動化視為提升物流效率與規模的關鍵手段。

2. **超快配送服務擴張**：Amazon 計畫在年底前於曼徹斯特（Manchester）和伯明罕（Birmingham）推出 Amazon Now 超快配送服務，此前該服務已於倫敦上線 [AMZN_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。這反映出 Amazon 以超快配送能力作為差異化競爭優勢，持續擴大其在歐洲主要城市的服務覆蓋。

3. **人力資本投資**：儘管部署機器人，Amazon 同時計畫在擴張中創造 25,000 個新就業機會 [AMZN_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。此外，公司已透過 Career Choice 計畫承諾投入 $10 億（$1 billion）用於員工教育與培訓，涵蓋網路安全與軟體開發等高成長領域 [AMZN_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。這顯示 Amazon 的策略並非單純以機器人取代人力，而是同時升級勞動力技能以配合技術轉型。

**整體策略意涵**

綜合來看，Amazon 在維持約 50% 毛利率與約 13% 營業利益率的穩健獲利基礎上 [AMZN_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #0]，以大規模資本投入推動歐洲市場的物流自動化、配送速度提升與人才升級，反映出以長期營運效率與市場規模擴張為導向的成長策略。同時，Amazon 的 Q4 2025 營收指引為 $206.0B 至 $213.0B，年增 10% 至 13%，營業利益指引為 $21.0B 至 $26.0B [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #79]，顯示公司在持續投資的同時仍預期維持穩定的營收成長與獲利能力。

Cost of Sales

Cost of sales primarily consists of the purchase price of consumer products, inbound and outbound shipping costs, including costs related to sortation and delivery centers and where we are the transportation service provider, and digital media content costs where we record revenue gross, including video and music. The increase in cost of sales in Q1 2026, compared to the comparable prior year period, is primarily due to increased product and shipping costs resulting from increased sales, partially offset by operational efficiencies. Changes in foreign exchange rates increased cost of sales by $1.8 billion for Q1 2026. Shipping costs were $22.5 billion and $25.7 billion in Q1 2025 and Q1 2026. Shipping costs to receive products from our suppliers are included in our inventory and recognized as cost of sales upon sale of products to our customers. We expect our cost of shipping to continue to increase to the extent our customers accept and use our shipping offers at an increasing rate, we use more expensive shipping methods, and we offer additional services. We seek to mitigate costs of shipping over time in part through achieving higher sales volumes, optimizing our fulfillment network, negotiating better terms with our suppliers, and achieving better operating efficiencies. We believe that offering low prices to our customers is fundamental to our future success, and one way we offer lower prices is through shipping offers. Costs to operate our AWS segment are primarily classified as “Technology and infrastructure” as we leverage a shared infrastructure that supports both our internal technology requirements and external sales to AWS customers. Fulfillment

Fulfillment costs primarily consist of those costs incurred in operating and staffing our North America and International fulfillment centers, physical stores, and customer service centers and payment processing costs. While AWS payment processing and related transaction costs are included in “Fulfillment,” AWS costs are primarily classified as “Technology and infrastructure.” Fulfillment costs as a percentage of net sales may vary due to several factors, such as payment processing and related transaction costs, our level of productivity and accuracy, changes in volume, size, and weight of units received and fulfilled, the extent to which third-party sellers utilize Fulfillment by Amazon services, timing of fulfillment network and physical store expansion, the extent we utilize fulfillment services provided by third parties, mix of products and services sold, and our ability to affect customer service contacts per unit by implementing improvements in our operations and enhancements to our customer self-service features. Additionally, sales by our sellers have higher payment processing and related transaction costs as a percentage of net sales compared to our retail sales because payment processing costs are based on the gross purchase price of underlying transactions.

records.query: Amazon 近一年的營收成長率是多少？加上新聞中避險基金在 SpaceX IPO 前拋售包括 Amazon 在內的大型科技股，這對市場如何看待 Amazon 透露了什麼？
records.answer:
Amazon 在 2025 年（截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的會計年度）的合併營收成長率為 12%，總淨銷售額從 2024 年的 6,379.59 億美元增至 7,169.24 億美元 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #211]。至於新聞中提及避險基金在 SpaceX IPO 前拋售大型科技股的相關細節，提供的參考資料中並未包含任何關於此事件的資訊，因此無法從中推導市場對 Amazon 的特定看法。

以下為 Amazon 近一年營收與投資動態的詳細數據：

**1. 營收成長與各區段表現（截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的會計年度）**
*   **合併淨銷售額**：總計 7,169.24 億美元，較 2024 年的 6,379.59 億美元成長 12% [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #211]。
*   **北美地區**：淨銷售額為 4,263.05 億美元，年成長率 10% [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #211]。
*   **國際地區**：淨銷售額為 1,618.94 億美元，年成長率 13% [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #211]。
*   **AWS**：淨銷售額為 1,287.25 億美元，年成長率 20% [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #211]。

**2. 資本支出與基礎設施投資**
*   **AWS 資產與設備投資**：2025 年 AWS 的物業與設備淨增額達 964.96 億美元（2024 年為 532.67 億美元） [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #121]。2025 年 AWS 的物業與設備淨額達 1,900.55 億美元，高於 2024 年的 1,106.83 億美元 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #121]。
*   **AI 與未來投資計畫**：Amazon 在 10-K 中明確表示，預期將繼續對其人工智慧計畫進行額外投資，並預期部分因素將持續影響其營運結果至 2026 年第一季 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #211]。

**3. 獲利能力與成本結構**
*   **營業收入**：2025 年合併營業收入為 799.75 億美元，高於 2024 年的 685.93 億美元 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #0]。
*   **淨利與每股盈餘**：2025 年淨利為 776.70 億美元，稀釋每股盈餘為 7.17 美元；相比 2024 年淨利 592.48 億美元，稀釋每股盈餘 5.53 美元 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #0]。
*   **技術與基礎設施費用**：2025 年的技術與基礎設施費用達 1,085.21 億美元，顯著高於 2024 年的 885.44 億美元 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #0]。

**4. 前瞻風險與不確定性**

records.answer:
Alphabet 2025 年的毛利率約為 59.7%，淨利率約為 32.8%，顯示其核心業務維持極強的獲利能力；同時，公司正以前所未有的規模投入資本支出與舉債籌資，全面押注 AI 基礎設施建設。

以下為具體的財務數據與 AI 投資策略分析：

**1. 獲利能力數據（2025 年）**
*   **毛利率：** Alphabet 2025 年的總營收為 4,028.36 億美元，營業成本為 1,625.35 億美元，毛利率約為 59.7% [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #0]。
*   **淨利率：** 2025 年淨收入為 1,321.70 億美元，淨利率約為 32.8% [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #0]。營業利益達 1,290.39 億美元 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #0]。

**2. 籌資計畫與資本支出概況**
*   **資本支出大幅攀升：** Alphabet 在 2024 年的資本支出為 525 億美元，2025 年則大幅增加至 914 億美元，主要用於投資技術基礎設施 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #308]。公司更明確指出，預期 2026 年將相較 2025 年「顯著增加」對技術基礎設施（包含伺服器、網路設備及資料中心）的投資 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #308]。
*   **大規模債務籌資：** 在籌資活動方面，2025 年透過發行債務（扣除成本後）獲得的資金從 2024 年的 135.89 億美元，暴增至 645.64 億美元 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #154]。同時，償還債務的金額也從 2024 年的 127.01 億美元增加至 324.27 億美元 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #154]。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，Alphabet 的長期債務從前一年的 108.83 億美元增至 465.47 億美元 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #1]。

*   **將 AI 基礎設施視為核心成長引擎：** 資本支出從 525 億美元躍升至 914 億美元並計畫在 2026 年持續顯著擴大，顯示 Alphabet 將 AI 與雲端運算的底層基礎設施視為未來競爭力的最核心要素 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #308]。這些投資主要用於伺服器、網路設備及資料中心建設 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #308]。
*   **以舉債支撐長期建設：** 儘管公司擁有極高的淨利率與強勁的營運現金流（2025 年營運活動產生的淨現金為 1,647.13 億美元 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #154]），Alphabet 仍選擇大舉發行債券籌資（645.64 億美元 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #154]）。這意味著公司試圖在不過度壓縮股東回報（2025 年股票回購金額為 457.09 億美元 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #154]）的前提下，加速搶建 AI 運算產能。
*   **提前鎖定長期電力與基礎設施：** 為了支撐龐大的 AI 運算需求，Alphabet 也提前布局電力等關鍵資源。截至 2025 年底，公司已簽訂主要與資料中心相關、尚未開始的租賃合約，短期與長期未來支付金額分別為 58 億美元與 527 億美元，這些租約將於 2026 年至 2031 年間生效 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #308]。此外，2026 年 1 月更簽署了一項電力採購協議，預估在 2027 年至 2047 年間將產生 99 億美元的未來支付義務 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #308]。這顯示其 AI 策略不僅限於當下硬體採購，而是確立了長達數十年的基礎建設與能源藍圖。

[GOOGL 10-K period 2025] Alphabet Inc. Net cash provided by operating activities increased from 2024 to 2025 due to an increase in cash received from customers, partially offset by an increase in cash payments for cost of revenues and operating expenses. Cash Used in Investing Activities

Cash provided by investing activities consists primarily of maturities and sales of investments in marketable and non-marketable securities. Cash used in investing activities consists primarily of purchases of marketable and non-marketable securities, purchases of property and equipment, and payments for acquisitions. Net cash used in investing activities increased from 2024 to 2025, primarily due to an increase in purchases of property and equipment, driven by investments in technical infrastructure, and a decrease in maturities and sales of marketable securities. Cash Used in Financing Activities

Cash provided by financing activities consists primarily of proceeds from issuance of debt and proceeds from the sale of interests in consolidated entities. Cash used in financing activities consists primarily of repurchases of stock, repayments of debt, net payments related to stock-based award activities, and dividend payments. Net cash used in financing activities decreased from 2024 to 2025 due to an increase in proceeds from issuance of debt and a decrease in repurchases of stock, partially offset by repayments of debt. Liquidity and Material Cash Requirements

We expect existing cash, cash equivalents, short-term marketable securities, and cash flows from operations and financing activities to continue to be sufficient to fund our operating activities and cash commitments for investing and financing activities for at least the next 12 months, and thereafter for the foreseeable future. Capital Expenditures and Leases

We make investments in land, buildings, and servers and network equipment through purchases of property and equipment and lease arrangements to provide capacity for the growth of our services and products. Capital Expenditures

Our capital investments in property and equipment consist primarily of the following major categories:

•technical infrastructure, which consists of our investments in servers and network equipment, data center land, and building construction and improvements; and

•office facilities, ground-up development projects, and building improvements. Assets not yet in service are those that are not ready for their intended use, including assets in the process of construction or assembly, and consist primarily of technical infrastructure. The time frame from date of purchase to placement in service of these assets may extend from months to years. For example, our data center construction projects are generally multi-year projects with multiple phases, where we acquire land and buildings, construct buildings, and secure and install servers and network equipment. During the years ended December 31, 2024 and 2025, we spent $52.5 billion and $91.4 billion on capital expenditures, respectively. In 2026, we expect to significantly increase, relative to 2025, our investment in our technical infrastructure, including servers and network equipment, and data centers. Depreciation of our property and equipment commences when such assets are ready for their intended use. For the years ended December 31, 2024 and 2025, our depreciation on property and equipment was $15.3 billion and $21.1 billion, respectively. Leases 

As of December 31, 2025, the amount of total undiscounted future lease payments under operating leases was $18.3 billion, of which $3.3 billion is short-term, and total undiscounted future lease payments under finance leases was $2.9 billion, of which $491 million is short-term. As of December 31, 2025, we have entered into leases primarily related to data centers that have not yet commenced with short-term and long-term future lease payments of $5.8 billion and $52.7 billion, respectively. These leases will commence between 2026 and 2031 with non-cancelable lease terms primarily between one and 25 years. In January 2026, we executed a power purchase agreement which we expect to be accounted for as a lease resulting in future payments depending on certain agreement terms of $9.9 billion between 2027 and 2047. If certain contractual conditions for the project are not met, we would instead make a one-time payment of approximately $3.5 billion and assume ownership of the power generating assets.

records.query: Alphabet 近一年的營收成長率是多少？加上新聞中 Navan 與 Google Gemini 的合作案例，反映出 Google 在 AI 生態系布局上的哪些進展？
records.answer:
Alphabet 近一年（2024 至 2025 年）的營收成長率約為 15.1%，同時透過 Google Gemini 與外部新創（如 Navan）的合作，顯示 Google 正將其 AI 模型從自家產品延伸至第三方應用場景，積極擴大 AI 生態系的覆蓋範圍。

**一、營收成長率**

Alphabet 的總營收從 2024 年的 3,500.18 億美元成長至 2025 年的 4,028.36 億美元，絕對金額增加了約 528.18 億美元，年成長率約為 15.1% [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #151]。從成本結構來看，總營收成本佔比從 2024 年的 42% 降至 2025 年的 40%，顯示在營收成長的同時，整體毛利結構有所改善 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #301]。營業利益也從 2024 年的 1,123.9 億美元成長至 2025 年的 1,290.39 億美元 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #151]。

**二、Google 在 AI 生態系布局的進展**

根據資料，Google 在 AI 生態系的布局可從以下幾個面向觀察：

1. **底層基礎設施與模型技術**：Alphabet 採取「全端」方法，從底層的 AI 基礎設施、研究模型到終端產品均涵蓋在內。在硬體方面，提供包含繪圖處理器（GPUs）與自研張量處理器（TPUs，如第七代 Ironwood）在內的多種 AI 加速器選項；在模型方面，已推出最先進的 AI 模型 Gemini 3，具備先進的多模態理解與代理式技術能力 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

2. **自家產品生態系的全面整合**：Google 已將 Gemini 模型嵌入旗下所有 15 個擁有五億用戶以上的產品中（其中 7 個產品擁有二十億用戶），涵蓋 Google 搜尋與 YouTube 等核心產品，將生成式 AI 廣泛應用於既有服務 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

3. **企業端雲端服務佈局**：針對 Google Cloud 客戶，提供 Gemini Enterprise 與 Gemini for Google Workspace 等解決方案，協助企業客戶運用 AI 技術 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

4. **外部應用場景與第三方合作（Navan 案例）**：在新聞案例中，旅遊管理平台 Navan 與 Google Gemini 進行整合，展現了 Google AI 向外部生態系擴展的策略。Navan 執行長指出，AI 的特殊之處在於能夠連結各種能力與知識並加以整合，讓 AI 代理能在不同情境下重複提供服務；Navan 將其服務整合進 Gemini 應用中，讓使用者直接透過 Gemini 完成航班預訂等旅遊體驗 [GOOGL_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #1]。這反映 Google 不僅將 AI 應用於自家產品，更透過開放 Gemini 整合第三方服務，將 AI 模型打造為連結各類外部能力的平台 [GOOGL_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #1]。

**三、研發與基礎設施投資支撐**

為支撐上述 AI 生態系布局，Alphabet 持續加大投資。研發費用從 2024 年的 493.26 億美元增至 2025 年的 610.87 億美元，增加 118 億美元，主要受員工薪酬與折舊費用增加驅動 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #301]。在資本支出方面，購置不動產與設備的支出從 2024 年的 525.35 億美元大幅增至 2025 年的 914.47 億美元 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #2]，反映 Google 正大規模擴建其 AI 基礎設施以支應生態系成長需求。

records.query: Meta 目前的毛利率與獲利能力如何？加上新聞中 Morgan Stanley 對其 AI 護城河與資本支出的評價，市場如何綜合看待 Meta 的 AI 投資？
records.answer:
Meta 目前獲利能力依然強健，2025 年全年淨利為 604.58 億美元，營運活動產生的淨現金高達 1,158 億美元，但 Morgan Stanley 認為市場因 Meta 龐大的 AI 資本支出計畫而低估了其 AI 護城河的擴張潛力 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #2] [META_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。

## 獲利能力與財務基本面

**淨利與現金流：** Meta 2025 年全年淨利為 604.58 億美元，略低於 2024 年的 623.60 億美元 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #2]。2025 年營運活動產生的淨現金為 1,158 億美元，較 2024 年的 913.28 億美元顯著成長 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #2]。截至九個月（至 2025 年 9 月 30 日），營運現金流為 795.86 億美元，高於 2024 年同期的 633.40 億美元 [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #2]。

**資產報酬指標：** Meta 的股東權益報酬率（ROE）為 0.3293，資產報酬率（ROA）為 0.1640，自由現金流為 255.6 億美元 [META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #1]。

**資產負債結構：** 截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，Meta 擁有現金及現金等價物 358.73 億美元，有價證券 457.19 億美元，長期債務為 587.44 億美元 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #1]。總資產為 3,660.21 億美元，總股東權益為 2,172.43 億美元 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #1]。基本面數據顯示總現金為 811.8 億美元，總債務為 867.7 億美元，債務權益比為 35.608，流動比率為 2.348 [META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #1]。

**業務分部投入：** 2025 年，Meta 的 Family of Apps（FoA）投入為 962.9 億美元，佔總成本與費用的 82%；Reality Labs（RL）投入為 214 億美元，佔 18% [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #134]。公司預期 RL 部門在可預見的未來將持續虧損 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #134]。

## Morgan Stanley 對 AI 護城河與資本支出的評價

**資本支出規模與市場擔憂：** Morgan Stanley 分析師 Brian Nowak 指出，投資人對 Meta 的情緒落後於其他大型科技同儕，原因在於 Meta 預計 2027 至 2028 年將投入約 3,800 億美元的資本支出，市場對此能見度有限 [META_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。

**AI 護城河擴張：** Nowak 認為華爾街忽略了 Meta 在大規模 AI 支出下正在擴展的競爭護城河，並預期這些投資將開發出能在 2028 年為每股盈餘（EPS）增加 1 至 3 美元的產品 [META_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。

**Meta AI 搜尋商機：** Morgan Stanley 預期 Meta 將受益於整合至 Meta AI 的數十億美元搜尋商機；若搜尋工具能留住 10 億用戶，且僅將每日查詢的 10% 貨幣化，預計可產生超過 100 億美元的年營收 [META_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。

**訂閱與目標價：** Meta 已開始推出分層訂閱方案以追求高利潤營收來源，Nowak 因此重申 Meta 為大型股中的首選，並給予 775 美元的目標價 [META_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。

## 市場對 Meta AI 投資的綜合看法

**短期資本支出持續攀升：** Meta 預期 2025 年資本支出約為 700 億至 720 億美元，以支援核心業務與 AI 努力，並預期 2026 年資本支出將顯著成長 [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #227]。截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日的九個月內，不動產及設備採購已達 483.08 億美元 [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #2]。

**投資重點方向：** 2026 年 Meta 計畫聚焦的關鍵投資領域包括 AI、Reels 與推薦引擎、穿戴裝置、產品變現、青少年、平台誠信與社群支援，以及基礎設施容量 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #134]。

**流動性與資金充足性：** Meta 表示目前預期可用資金及來自營運與融資活動的現金流，將足以滿足至少未來 12 個月的營運現金需求、基礎設施與 AI 投資、股票回購及股利支付 [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #227]。

**競爭格局：** Meta 面臨顯著競爭，尤其在前沿 AI 模型的開發以及消費硬體與擴增/虛擬實境產品方面，公司預期隨著新產品推出或現有產品演進，競爭將進一步加劇 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #134]。

**股東回報：** 儘管資本支出大幅增加，Meta 2025 年全年仍回購 262.48 億美元的 A 類普通股，並支付 53.24 億美元的股利與股利等價物 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #2]。基本面數據顯示股利殖利率為 0.37 [META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #1]。

**補充說明：** 提供的參考資料未包含毛利率的具體數字，因此無法直接引用毛利率數據；以上分析以淨利、現金流及資產報酬率等可得的獲利能力指標替代。

Overview

Our mission is to build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible. Our products enable people to connect and share through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality (VR) headsets, and AI glasses. We are innovating in artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to build transformative experiences and capabilities across our Family of Apps and new platforms, and to advance our vision to deliver personal superintelligence for everyone. We build technology that helps people connect and share, find and build communities, and grow businesses. We also help people discover and learn about what is going on in the world around them, enable people to share their experiences, ideas, photos, videos, and other content with audiences ranging from their closest family members and friends to the public at large, and stay connected everywhere by accessing our products. Meta is moving our offerings beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next computing platform. Our vision does not center on any single product, but rather an entire ecosystem of experiences, devices, and new technologies powered by AI. While the metaverse is in the very early stages of its development, we believe it will become the next computing platform and the future of social interaction. Across our work, we are innovating to build new experiences that help make our platform more social, useful, and immersive. Our AI investments support initiatives across our products and services, helping power the systems that rank content in our apps, our discovery engine that recommends relevant content, the tools advertisers use to reach customers, the development of new generative AI experiences, and the tools that make our product development more efficient and productive. We are also working to develop the next generation of AI models and advance our vision to build superintelligence, which we define as AI that surpasses human intelligence. Although it is inherently difficult to predict when superintelligence may be achieved, we are investing now because we believe this has the potential to begin a new era of individual empowerment, where people can direct superintelligence towards what they value in their own lives. Family of Apps Products

•Facebook. Facebook helps give people the power to build community and bring the world closer together. It's a place for people to share life's moments and discuss what's happening, nurture and build relationships, discover and connect to people with shared interests, and create economic opportunity. They can do this through Feed, Reels, Stories, Groups, Marketplace, and more. •Instagram. Instagram brings people closer to the people and things they love. Instagram Feed, Stories, Reels, Live, and messaging are places where people and creators can connect and express themselves through photos, video, and private messaging, and discover and shop from their favorite businesses. •Messenger. Messenger is a simple yet powerful messaging application for people to connect with friends, family, communities, and businesses across platforms and devices through text, audio, and video calls. •Meta AI. Meta AI is an assistant that's available across our apps, as a stand-alone app, on our AI glasses, and on the web. It's designed to help people learn, get things done, create content, and connect with others to make the most of every moment.

records.query: Meta 近一年的營收成長率是多少？加上新聞中科技股在 SpaceX IPO 前遭避險基金拋售的報導，這對 Meta 股價表現的背景有何意義？
records.answer:
Meta 2025 年總營收為 2,009.66 億美元，較 2024 年的 1,645.01 億美元成長 22% [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #296]。此成長幾乎完全由廣告營收驅動——廣告營收達 1,961.75 億美元，增加 355.54 億美元（年增 22%），主因廣告曝光量年增 12%、平均廣告價格年增 9% [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #314]。Family of Apps（FoA）部門 2025 年營收為 1,987.59 億美元（年增 22%），Reality Labs（RL）部門營收為 22.07 億美元（年增 3%）[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #296]。營業利益為 832.76 億美元，年增 20%；淨利為 604.58 億美元，稀釋每股盈餘為 23.49 美元 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #296]。

至於問題中提及「科技股在 SpaceX IPO 前遭避險基金拋售」的新聞報導，提供的參考資料中並無任何與 SpaceX IPO 或避險基金拋售科技股相關的內容，因此無法就此特定事件對 Meta 股價的影響作出判斷。

不過，Meta 在其 10-K 及 10-Q 文件中明確指出，其 A 類普通股的交易價格一直且可能持續波動。自 2012 年 5 月 IPO 以每股 38.00 美元發行以來，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，股價區間為 17.55 美元至 796.25 美元 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #248]；截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，該區間仍維持在同樣範圍 [META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #149]。Meta 列舉了多項可能導致股價波動的因素，包括：實際或預期的營收及各報告部門經營成果波動、財務預測的變動或未達預期、證券分析師的行動或估計變化、額外股票進入市場的預期、投資者對競爭對手及行業整體的情緒、Meta 或競爭對手發布重大產品或技術創新或資本承諾的公告、用戶基礎規模或參與度或廣告產品有效性的實際或預期變化、科技類公司經營績效及股市估值的變化、整體股市的價格與成交量波動、指數納入或剔除、媒體報導、訴訟發展、與廣告、競爭、內容、隱私等相關的不利政府行動或法規發展、股票回購計畫中的交易活動，以及戰爭、恐怖主義、疫情等外部破壞性事件 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #248]。文件亦指出股市整體已經歷並持續經歷極端的價格與成交量波動，影響了許多科技公司的市場價格 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #248]。

這意味著，即便參考資料未涵蓋 SpaceX IPO 相關新聞，Meta 自身的申報文件已表明其股價對廣泛的市場情緒與科技板塊波動具有高度敏感性——任何涉及科技股的板塊級拋售或避險基金部位調整，都可能透過上述「科技類公司股市估值變化」及「整體股市波動」等渠道影響 Meta 股價表現 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #248]。

Revenue is traditionally seasonally strong in the fourth quarter of each year due in part to seasonal holiday demand. We believe that this seasonality in both advertising revenue and RL consumer hardware sales affects our quarterly results, which generally reflect significant growth in revenue between the third and fourth quarters and a decline between the fourth and subsequent first quarters.
