records.query: Tesla 最新一季的營收成長與毛利率變化如何？加上新聞中 SpaceX 即將 IPO 讓 Tesla 關注度降溫的報導，這對 Tesla 目前的市場處境有何影響？
records.answer:
Tesla 最新一季（2026年第二季，截至6月30日）總營收約282.4億美元，年增25.5%，但整體毛利率從17.2%微降至16.8%，呈現「營收成長但毛利率略受壓」的格局 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #0][TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77]。

**營收成長表現**

Tesla 在2026年第二季的總營收為282.36億美元，較2025年同期的224.96億美元增加57.4億美元 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #0]。2026年上半年（六個月）總營收為506.23億美元，較2025年同期的418.31億美元增加87.9億美元 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #67]。各業務線的表現如下：

- **汽車業務**：第二季汽車營收為205.16億美元，較2025年同期的166.61億美元成長，主要受交付量年增帶動 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #0][TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77]。
- **服務與其他**：第二季服務與其他營收為45.81億美元，較2025年同期的30.46億美元增加15.4億美元（增幅50%），主要受二手車銷量與平均售價提升、非保養維修服務、碰撞維修收入及付費超充收入帶動 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #0][TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #76]。
- **能源發電與儲存**：第二季能源業務營收為31.39億美元，較2025年同期的27.89億美元增加3.5億美元（增幅13%），主要受Megapack部署量增加帶動，但部分被Megapack平均售價下降及Powerwall部署量減少所抵消 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #0][TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #76]。

**毛利率變化**

整體毛利率在2026年第二季從17.2%降至16.8%，各分項如下 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77]：

- **汽車業務毛利率**：從17.2%降至16.9%，主要受汽車銷售收入與成本變動以及監管信貸收入減少影響 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77]。
- **汽車及服務與其他合併毛利率**：從15.4%升至16.4%，受惠於服務與其他毛利率改善 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77]。
- **能源發電與儲存毛利率**：從30.3%大幅降至20.4%，主因為能源業務收入與成本的變動，包括平均每MWh成本上升（受銷售組合與不利保固調整影響） [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77]。

值得注意的是，2026年上半年（六個月）的毛利率趨勢與單季不同：總毛利率從16.8%升至18.7%，汽車毛利率從16.8%升至18.7%，顯示上半年整體較去年同期改善，但第二季單季的能源毛利率下滑拖累了短期表現 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77]。

**研發與資本支出大幅增加**

Tesla 在2026年第二季的研發費用為23.71億美元，較2025年同期的15.89億美元增加7.82億美元（增幅49%）；上半年研發費用為43.17億美元，較去年同期增加13.19億美元（增幅44%） [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #0][TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77]。Tesla 表示正大力投資研發以加速AI、軟體及車隊利潤的發展，這將在此階段對盈利能力造成負面影響 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #67]。此外，上半年資本支出為82.8億美元，較2025年同期的38.9億美元增加44億美元 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #67]。

受研發與營運支出大幅增加影響，Tesla 第二季的營業利潤從9.23億美元降至3.98億美元，淨利從11.9億美元微降至11.28億美元 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #0]。

**SpaceX IPO 與 Tesla 的市場處境**

新聞報導指出，Elon Musk 的 SpaceX 預計於2026年6月12日以代號SPCX在Nasdaq上市，IPO價格為每股135美元 [TSLA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。報導中將 Musk 稱為「big ideas之王」，並討論其領導力與擴張企業帝國的願景 [TSLA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。

然而，提供的參考資料中**並未明確提及**「SpaceX IPO 讓 Tesla 關注度降溫」這一論點。新聞僅報導了 SpaceX 即將IPO的事實及對 Musk 領導風格的討論，並未直接分析此事件對 Tesla 市場關注度或股價的影響 [TSLA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。

**可從既有資料推論的市場處境**

儘管資料未直接討論 SpaceX IPO 對 Tesla 的影響，但從 Tesla 的基本面數據可看出其目前面臨的市場挑戰：

- **估值偏高**：截至2026年6月12日，Tesla 的追蹤本益比高達369.58倍，前瞻本益比為159.54倍，市值約1,499億美元 [TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #0]。在淨利率僅3.95%、營業利益率4.20%的情況下，如此高的估值反映市場對未來成長的高度期待 [TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #0]。
- **獲利壓力**：第二季營業利潤年減56.9%（從9.23億降至3.98億美元），研發支出激增49%正在壓縮短期盈利 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #0][TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77]。

records.query: Tesla 汽車業務的毛利率近期有什麼變化趨勢？加上新聞中 Magnificent Seven 科技股近期全數下跌的報導，這對 Tesla 的股價表現透露什麼？
records.answer:
Tesla 的汽車業務毛利率近年持續下滑，從 2023 年的 19.4% 降至 2024 年的 18.4%，再降至 2025 年的 17.8% [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #130] [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #13]，而 2026 年第二季季度更進一步從去年同期的 17.2% 降至 16.9% [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77]。至於 Magnificent Seven 科技股全數下跌的報導，提供的參考資料中並未涵蓋此一主題，僅有 Yahoo Finance 影片提及 Tesla 股價單日下跌 2.96%，並指出 Tesla 近期表現平淡、缺乏令人振奮的催化劑 [TSLA_News_20260721_01.txt, chunk #0]。

以下從三個面向進一步說明：

**1. 汽車業務毛利率的長期下滑趨勢（年度數據）**

Tesla 的「總汽車毛利率」（Gross margin total automotive）呈現連年下降的趨勢：
- 2023 年為 19.4% [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #130]
- 2024 年降至 18.4%，較 2023 年下降約 1 個百分點 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #130]
- 2025 年進一步降至 17.8%，較 2024 年再降約 0.6 個百分點 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #130]

若將服務及其他業務一併計入，總汽車及服務和其他板塊的毛利率下滑更為明顯，從 2023 年的 18.2% 降至 2024 年的 16.9%，再降至 2025 年的 16.2% [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #130]。

**2. 2026 年第二季季度毛利率的短期波動**

根據 Tesla 2026 年第二季季度（截至 6 月 30 日）的 10-Q 報告，汽車毛利率呈現短期波動：
- 三個月期間：總汽車毛利率從 2025 年第二季的 17.2% 降至 2026 年第二季的 16.9%，主要原因是汽車銷售收入與成本變動，以及監管信貸收入（regulatory credits revenue）的減少 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77]。
- 六個月期間：總汽車毛利率反而從 2025 年上半年的 16.8% 升至 2026 年上半年的 18.7% [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77]。

值得注意的是，總汽車及服務和其他板塊的毛利率在 2026 年第二季季度有所改善，三個月期間從 15.4% 升至 16.4%，六個月期間從 14.9% 升至 17.5%，主要受惠於服務及其他業務毛利率的改善 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77]。

**3. 能源業務毛利率的對比與股價相關資訊**

與汽車業務毛利率下滑形成對比的是，Tesla 的能源發電與儲存（Energy Generation and Storage）板塊毛利率在年度數據上持續改善，從 2023 年的 18.9% 升至 2024 年的 26.2%，再升至 2025 年的 29.8% [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #130]。不過，2026 年第二季季度該板塊毛利率從去年同期的 30.3% 大幅降至 20.4%，主要因為收入與成本的變化、平均每 MWh 成本上升（受銷售組合與不利的保固調整影響） [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77]。

關於股價表現，Yahoo Finance 的報導指出 Tesla 股價在報導當日下跌 2.96%，評論員提到 Tesla 近期「沒有做太多令人振奮的事」（"hasn't done a lot anything too exciting in a while"），且在 SpaceX 的熱度之下 Tesla「退居次要位置」（"taken a back seat"），暗示市場對 Tesla 近期缺乏強勁的正面催化劑 [TSLA_News_20260721_01.txt, chunk #0]。此外，Tesla 的 10-K 報告也披露了與 CEO Elon Musk 相關的風險因素，包括若 Musk 被迫出售持股以履行個人貸款或稅務義務，可能導致 Tesla 股價下跌 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #101]。

**總結而言**，Tesla 核心汽車業務的毛利率在年度趨勢上持續承壓，從 2023 年的 19.4% 一路降至 2025 年的 17.8% [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #130]，2026 年第二季季度進一步微降至 16.9% [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77]。能源板塊雖在年度數據上展現成長動能，但 2026 年第二季季度毛利率也出現顯著回落 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77]。至於 Magnificent Seven 科技股全數下跌的報導，參考資料中並無相關資訊，無法據此分析對 Tesla 股價的具體影響。

records.query: NVIDIA 和 Microsoft 的毛利率誰比較高？加上新聞中兩家公司在 AI 策略布局上的最新動態，兩者目前的 AI 競爭定位有何不同？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 的毛利率明顯高於 Microsoft——NVIDIA 最近十二個月（TTM）毛利率約為 71.1%，而 Microsoft 在 2025 會計年度的整體毛利率因 AI 基礎設施投資擴大而略有下降，Microsoft Cloud 的毛利率更從 69% 降至 67%（截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的季度）[NVDA_Fundamentals_20260508.txt, chunk #0][MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #143][MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #105]。

以下從財務數據與 AI 策略定位兩個層面進一步比較：

---

## 一、毛利率比較

**NVIDIA：**
- 截至 2026 年 5 月 8 日的數據顯示，NVIDIA 的毛利率（TTM）為 71.1%，營業利益率為 65.0%，淨利率為 55.6% [NVDA_Fundamentals_20260508.txt, chunk #0]。
- 其營收（TTM）為 2,159.4 億美元，年增 73.2%，顯示在 AI 需求推動下，NVIDIA 在高速成長的同時仍維持極高的獲利能力 [NVDA_Fundamentals_20260508.txt, chunk #0]。

**Microsoft：**
- 2025 會計年度（截至 2025 年 6 月）總營收為 2,817.2 億美元，年增 15%；營業利益為 1,285.3 億美元，年增 17% [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #143]。
- 整體毛利率百分比略有下降，主因是 Intelligent Cloud 部門因擴大 AI 基礎設施而拉低成本效率 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #143]。
- Microsoft Cloud 的毛利率百分比在 2025 會計年度降至 69%，在截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的季度進一步降至 67%，原因為持續投資 AI 基礎設施及 AI 產品使用量增長，部分被 Azure 的效率提升所抵銷 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #143][MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #105]。

---

## 二、AI 策略布局與競爭定位差異

### NVIDIA：以加速運算平台為核心的 AI 基礎設施提供者

NVIDIA 將自身定位為「data center scale AI infrastructure company」，其核心策略是推進 NVIDIA 加速運算平台，以解決複雜運算問題 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20][NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。

- **全端平台策略：** NVIDIA 的技術堆疊涵蓋基礎的 CUDA 開發平台、數百個領域專屬軟體庫、框架、演算法、SDK 與 API，並以統一的可程式化架構支援多個數十億美元規模的終端市場 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。
- **資料中心級協同設計：** Blackwell 架構引入了「extreme co-design」，將基礎設施的晶片、網路、系統、軟體與演算法進行整體架構與優化，數十萬顆 GPU 可互聯為一台巨型電腦運作 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。
- **實體 AI 與機器人：** NVIDIA 提供端到端平台，涵蓋資料中心基礎設施、開放模型、系統、嵌入式運算模組與軟體堆疊，用於訓練、模擬與部署先進的自動化與機器人解決方案 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。
- **遊戲與專業視覺化：** 在遊戲領域，NVIDIA 於 2026 會計年度推出並擴展 Blackwell 架構的 GeForce RTX 50 系列，引入神經圖形技術與新一代 DLSS 技術 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。在專業視覺化領域，RTX PRO GPU 利用與資料中心解決方案相同的 Tensor Core 技術，支援日益增長的生成式與代理式 AI 應用 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。
- **研發投入：** NVIDIA 自成立以來已投入超過 767 億美元於研發 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。

### Microsoft：以雲端服務與生產力應用為載體的 AI 整合者

Microsoft 的 AI 策略圍繞將 AI 能力嵌入其雲端服務與生產力工具中，透過 Azure 與 Microsoft 365 等產品線實現 AI 變現。

- **Azure 雲端服務驅動 AI 基礎設施需求：** 在截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的季度，Microsoft 的 Intelligent Cloud 部門營收年增 29%，其中 Azure 及其他雲端服務營收年增 39%，受其服務組合需求推動，各項工作負載持續增長 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #107]。
- **Microsoft 365 Copilot 帶動生產力業務：** Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端營收在同期增長 17%，每位用戶營收增長由 Microsoft 365 E5 與 Microsoft 365 Copilot 推動 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #107]。
- **OpenAI 投資影響淨利：** 截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的當季，Microsoft 的淨利與稀釋每股盈餘因投資 OpenAI 的淨收益而分別增加了 7.6 億美元與 1.02 美元；而去年同期則因 OpenAI 投資的淨損失，分別減少了 9.39 億美元與 0.12 美元 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #105]。
- **研發投入方向：** 在截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的六個月期間，Microsoft 的研發費用增加了 12 億美元（增幅 8%），主要受運算能力與 AI 人才投資以及遊戲業務的減損費用驅動 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #111]。
- **AI 基礎設施對毛利率的壓力：** Microsoft 在多個部門均提到，擴大 AI 基礎設施與 AI 產品使用量增長對毛利率造成壓力，但部分被 Azure 與 Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端的效率提升所抵銷 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #143][MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #105][MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #107]。

---

## 三、競爭定位總結

兩家公司在 AI 價值鏈中扮演不同角色：

- **NVIDIA** 是 AI 基礎設施的底層提供者，透過其 GPU 硬體、CUDA 軟體平台與資料中心級協同設計，為各行各業的 AI 訓練與推論提供核心運算能力，其高毛利率（71.1%）反映了其平台在 AI 運算領域的技術壁壘與定價能力 [NVDA_Fundamentals_20260508.txt, chunk #0][NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。

- **Microsoft** 則是 AI 應用與服務的整合者，透過 Azure 雲端提供 AI 運算服務，並將 AI 能力嵌入 Microsoft 365、Dynamics 365 等生產力工具中，同時透過對 OpenAI 的策略投資獲取 AI 技術與財務回報。其毛利率因 AI 基礎設施投資而承受壓力，但透過效率提升與高毛利業務的組合轉換來部分緩解 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #143][MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #105][MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #107]。

records.query: NVIDIA 的核心技術護城河是什麼？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 的核心技術護城河在於其將 GPU 硬體、CUDA 軟體平台與資料中心級系統架構深度整合的「平台策略」，並結合龐大的開發者生態系統與長期的研發投入 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。以下從來源中可歸納出的幾個關鍵面向：

**1. CUDA 軟體平台與領域專用軟體庫**
NVIDIA 的技術堆疊包含基礎的 CUDA 開發平台，該平台可在所有 NVIDIA GPU 上運行，此外還包含數百個領域專用軟體庫、框架、演算法、軟體開發套件（SDK）及應用程式介面（API）[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。這個深且廣的軟體堆疊能加速運算效能並促進 NVIDIA 加速運算在 AI 模型訓練與推論、資料分析、科學運算、機器人及 3D 圖形等運算密集型工作負載中的部署 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。2006 年 CUDA 的推出，將 GPU 的平行處理能力開放給廣泛的運算密集應用，為現代 AI 的出現鋪路 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。

**2. 資料中心級的極限協同設計（Extreme Co-design）**
NVIDIA 引入 Blackwell 架構的資料中心級產品具備「極限協同設計」，即基礎設施的晶片、網路、系統、軟體與演算法經過整體架構與最佳化，以最大化效能與規模 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。數十萬個 GPU 可以互連作為一台巨型電腦運作，這種資料中心架構與規模是開發與部署現代 AI 及加速運算應用所必需的 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。NVIDIA 的運算解決方案涵蓋 AI 伺服器中的三種主要處理單元——GPU、CPU 與 DPU，並提供完整的端對端加速運算平台以同時解決訓練與推論需求 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。

**3. 統一底層架構支撐多個終端市場**
NVIDIA 採用平台策略，將硬體、系統、軟體、演算法、函式庫、AI 模型、訓練資料集與服務整合在一起，為其服務的市場創造獨特價值 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。雖然這些終端市場的運算需求多樣，但 NVIDIA 以統一的底層可程式化架構來支援數個價值數十億美元的終端市場，並透過內部或第三方開發的各種軟體堆疊來達成 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。

records.query: NVIDIA 如何用同一套底層架構同時佈局資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與車用市場？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 透過其統一的可程式化加速運算架構——以 GPU、CPU、CUDA 與網路技術為共同基礎建構模組——讓同一套底層技術搭配不同的軟體堆疊，即可同時佈局資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與車用四大市場 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #27]。

**統一底層架構的核心邏輯**

NVIDIA 採用平台策略，將硬體、系統、軟體、演算法、函式庫、AI 模型與訓練資料集及服務整合在一起，以統一的底層可程式化架構支援多個價值數十億美元的終端市場 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。該架構以 GPU、CPU、CUDA 及網路技術作為基本建構模組，雖然各終端市場的運算需求各異，但 NVIDIA 透過內部或第三方開發的多種軟體堆疊，即可用同一套底層技術加以涵蓋 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #27]。這種可程式化特性使 NVIDIA 能夠在研發上進行槓桿式投資，以共享的底層技術同時支援多個市場 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #27]。CUDA 開發平台可運行於所有 NVIDIA GPU 之上，搭配數百個特定領域的軟體函式庫、框架、演算法、SDK 與 API，加速 AI 模型訓練與推論、資料分析、科學運算、機器人及 3D 圖形等運算密集型工作負載 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。

**資料中心市場**

NVIDIA 的資料中心平台專注於加速 AI、資料處理、圖形、機器人與科學運算等運算密集型工作負載，以機架級系統、子系統或模組形式交付，並配備軟體與服務 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #24]。該平台包含高效能、節能的 GPU、CPU、互連技術與完全優化的 AI 及 HPC 軟體堆疊，並提供 NVLink 互連與交換器、InfiniBand 與 Ethernet 端到端平台等網路方案，可互連多達數十萬個運算節點 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #24]。在 2024 年，NVIDIA 推出 Blackwell 架構，將 36 顆 Grace CPU 與 72 顆 Blackwell GPU 連接於資料中心級別的液冷設計中，用於即時兆參數推論與訓練 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]。2026 財年，NVIDIA 推出並擴展 Blackwell Ultra 平台，針對 agentic AI、reasoning AI 及 physical AI 進行優化，相較 Hopper 世代顯著提升 token 吞吐量並降低每 token 成本 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]。NVIDIA 也提供 NVIDIA AI Enterprise 軟體套件，包含 NIM（提升 token 吞吐量）、NeMo（用於模型策展、微調與評估）及 AI Blueprints（預建可執行範本），協助企業安全地開發與部署 AI 應用 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。所有主要公有與私有雲端服務提供商、AI 模型製造商、企業與新創公司及公共部門均為其客戶 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #24]。

**遊戲市場**

NVIDIA 的遊戲產品包括 GeForce RTX GPU（用於遊戲桌機與筆電）、GeForce NOW 雲端遊戲服務，以及遊戲主機的 SoC 與開發服務 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。GeForce RTX GPU 採用光線追蹤技術實現即時電影級渲染，並搭載 NVIDIA DLSS AI 技術以提升幀率同時生成高品質影像 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。RTX GPU 同時配備 Tensor Core 技術，使其能加速新一代裝置端 AI 應用 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。2025 財年，NVIDIA 發表 Blackwell GeForce RTX 50 系列桌面與筆電 GPU，引入神經圖形技術，將 AI 模型與傳統渲染結合以提升遊戲效能、影像品質與互動性 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。2026 財年，NVIDIA 在遊戲與 GeForce NOW 中推出並擴展 Blackwell 架構 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。Blackwell GPU 的先進 AI 與神經渲染能力結合 NVIDIA 的 AI 軟體堆疊，顯著加速在 PC 上本地運行的 AI 工作負載 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。

**專業視覺化市場**

NVIDIA 與獨立軟體供應商（ISV）密切合作，將其產品優化以運行於 NVIDIA GPU 之上，服務設計、工程與數位內容創作等領域的關鍵工作流程 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。隨著生成式與 agentic AI 應用日益增多，對 RTX PRO GPU 的增強 AI 與資料處理能力需求也隨之上升 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。這些 RTX PRO GPU 採用與資料中心方案相同的 Tensor Core 技術 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。NVIDIA 的電腦圖形平台從開發者工具、雲端服務到所有 RTX 級 GPU 內建的 Tensor Core，端到端地融入 AI [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。此外，Omniverse 是即時 3D 設計協作與虛擬世界模擬軟體，讓藝術家、設計師與創作者在主流設計應用中連接與協作 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。

**車用市場**

NVIDIA 的車用業務提供從雲端到車輛的自動駕駛平台解決方案，以 DRIVE Hyperion 平台為核心，涵蓋開發基礎設施、高效能節能的 DRIVE AGX 運算硬體、車載作業系統（DRIVE OS）、支援全自動駕駛的參考感測器套件，以及用於自動駕駛、地圖建構與停車服務的開放模組化 DRIVE 軟體平台 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。NVIDIA 憑藉其在 AI 領域的技術領導地位及與數百家車用生態系合作夥伴的長期關係，提供端到端的全棧解決方案 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。NVIDIA 於 2018 年推出首款自動駕駛 SoC，並建構了 NVIDIA DRIVE 自動駕駛軟體堆疊 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]。

**架構共用的關鍵優勢**

NVIDIA 的全棧創新方法涵蓋架構、晶片設計、系統、互連、演算法與軟體各層面，使其在目標市場中能提供相較於傳統方案達數量級的效能優勢 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #27]。NVIDIA 自成立以來已投入超過 767 億美元於研發，工程師中超過半數從事軟體工作 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20] [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]。全球有超過 750 萬名開發者使用 CUDA 及其他軟體工具 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。Blackwell 架構引入了資料中心級別的極致協同設計（extreme co-design），將基礎設施的晶片、網路、系統、軟體與演算法進行整體架構與優化，數十萬顆 GPU 可互連為一台巨型電腦 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。2026 財年，NVIDIA 推出 NVLink Fusion，讓超大規模資料中心營運商與客製化 ASIC 設計者能將自訂 CPU 與 XPU 整合至 NVIDIA 平台中 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #24]。

records.query: Microsoft 如何把 Copilot 整合進 Microsoft 365 的產品策略？
records.answer:
Microsoft 將 Copilot 納入 Microsoft 365 Commercial 平台的產品組合中，與 Office、Windows 及企業行動力與安全等服務並列，作為平台整合的組件之一 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。以下從產品定位、營收影響機制、競爭策略及生態系滲透現況等面向說明整合方式：

**1. 產品組合定位**
Microsoft 365 Commercial 被描述為「AI 驅動的商業與生產力解決方案平台」，將 Office、Windows、Microsoft 365 Copilot 與 Enterprise Mobility + Security 整合在一起，協助組織賦能員工 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。Copilot 被列為 Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端訂閱服務的組成項目之一，與 Microsoft 365 Commercial、Enterprise Mobility + Security、Windows Commercial 雲端部分、Power BI 按用戶部分、Exchange、SharePoint、Microsoft Teams、Microsoft 365 Security and Compliance 等並列 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52] [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #142] [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #103]。

**2. 營收影響機制**
Microsoft 365 Commercial 的營收主要受持續的安裝基礎成長與平均每位用戶營收（ARPU）擴張的綜合影響，以及從 Office 地端授權持續轉向 Microsoft 365 的趨勢所驅動 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。該業務的成長策略包括在核心產品與服務中新增 AI 驅動的工具、功能與代理式場景（agentic scenarios），涵蓋通訊、協作、分析、安全、合規及其他 AI 商業生產力類別 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。

**3. 搜尋與數位助理應用**
在搜尋與新聞廣告業務中，Microsoft Copilot 被定位為「數位伴侶」（digital companion），旨在提供資訊、娛樂與啟發功能，並與 Microsoft Edge 瀏覽器及 Bing 搜尋引擎搭配，作為獲取與吸引使用者的關鍵工具 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #57]。

**4. 生態系滲透現況**
根據微軟生態系合作夥伴 AvePoint 執行長的說法，Microsoft Office Cloud 約有 4 億至 5 億個用戶席位，而 Copilot 的滲透率約為 5%，E5 的滲透率則低於 20% [MSFT_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #2]。AvePoint 本身在 Microsoft 365 備份領域覆蓋「數千萬」個席位，尚未達到 1 億，該公司認為仍有成長空間 [MSFT_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #2]。AvePoint 也將 Microsoft 的 Backup Express 快照功能整合至其自身的備份技術堆疊中，協助客戶完成 Purview、E5 與 Copilot 等工作負載的「最後一哩」採用 [MSFT_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #2]。

**5. AI 代理治理**
在 AI 治理方面，AvePoint 推出的 AgentPulse 產品可協助客戶發現跨雲端環境（如 Gemini 與 Copilot）運行的 AI 代理，控制其可存取的系統與資料、監控權杖消耗量，並在必要時關閉代理 [MSFT_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #2]。這反映出 Copilot 整合策略中，AI 代理的管理與治理已成為生態系中合作夥伴關注的配套需求 [MSFT_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #2]。

**6. 競爭定位**
Microsoft 365 Commercial 面臨的競爭對手包括軟體與全球應用程式供應商、網頁與行動應用程式公司、AI 優先（AI-first）應用程式公司，以及在地應用程式開發商 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。將 Copilot 整合進 Microsoft 365 的策略，與微軟在競爭中強化 AI 功能的方向一致 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。

agentic_sub_queries: Microsoft 如何把 Copilot 整合進 Microsoft 365 的產品策略？

records.query: Microsoft 如何靠 Windows 帶動雲端與 Copilot 相關服務的參與度？
records.answer:
Microsoft 將 Windows 視為推動其雲端業務與 Copilot 等服務參與度的核心引擎，策略上是利用 Windows 作為平台來帶動客戶對 Microsoft Edge、Bing、Copilot、Microsoft Teams、Microsoft 365 Consumer 與 Xbox Game Pass 等服務的參與度與使用量 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49]。

以下是具體的運作機制與細節：

**1. 透過 Windows 擴大服務生態系與用戶參與度**
Microsoft 在其未來機會的戰略中明確指出，公司正致力於「利用 Windows 來推動其雲端業務、提升 PC 市場的佔有率，並增加客戶對 Microsoft Edge、Bing、Copilot、Microsoft Teams、Microsoft 365 Consumer、Xbox Game Pass 等服務的參與度」[MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49]。這顯示 Windows 作業系統不僅是產品本身，更是帶動各項雲端與 AI 服務觸及率的基礎平台。

**2. 搜尋與 Copilot 的用戶獲取**
在搜尋與新聞廣告業務方面，Microsoft 結合了 Windows 環境中的工具來推動用戶獲取與參與。Microsoft Edge 瀏覽器與內建 Copilot 的 Bing 搜尋引擎被視為實現用戶獲取和參與的關鍵工具，進而加速數位廣告解決方案的交付 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #57]。

**3. 透過 OEM 渠道預裝擴大觸及面**
Microsoft 透過原始設備製造商（OEM）將 Windows 作業系統預裝在新出售的設備和伺服器上，而 OEM 同時也會在設備上預裝其他 Microsoft 產品與服務，包含 Office 應用程式以及訂閱 Microsoft 365 Consumer 的功能 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #61]。這種預裝模式確保了使用者從接觸 Windows 設備的第一刻起，便能連結至 Microsoft 的雲端服務生態系。

**4. Copilot 與雲端服務的財務與指標追蹤**
在 Microsoft 的商業雲端營收中，Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端營收的成長指標明確包含了 Microsoft 365 Copilot 的貢獻，該指標涵蓋了 Microsoft 365 Commercial、Enterprise Mobility + Security、雲端版 Windows Commercial、Power BI、Exchange、SharePoint、Microsoft Teams、Microsoft 365 Security and Compliance 以及 Microsoft 365 Copilot 的訂閱營收 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #103]。此外，Microsoft 的商業業務主要由伺服器產品與雲端服務（包含 Azure 與其他雲端服務）、Microsoft 365 Commercial 產品與雲端服務等組成 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #103]。

**5. 裝置設計與 Windows 的整合**
Microsoft 所設計與銷售的裝置（如 Surface 及 Copilot+ PCs）旨在讓人們與組織能使用 Windows 及整合的 Microsoft 產品和服務，連結對他們最重要的人與內容 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #57]。這進一步說明了 Microsoft 透過硬體裝置與 Windows 系統的深度整合，強化客戶對其雲端與生產力服務的依賴與參與。

[MSFT 10-K period 2025] Individual consumers obtain these products primarily through retail outlets. We distribute our devices through third-party retailers. We have a network of field sales representatives and field support personnel that solicit orders from distributors and resellers and provide product training and sales support. Our Dynamics business solutions are also licensed to enterprises through a global network of channel partners providing vertical solutions and specialized services. OEMs 

We distribute our products and services through OEMs that pre-install our software on new devices and servers they sell. The largest component of the OEM business is the Windows operating system pre-installed on devices. OEMs also sell devices pre-installed with other Microsoft products and services, including applications such as Office and the capability to subscribe to Microsoft 365 Consumer. There are two broad categories of OEMs. The largest category of OEMs are direct OEMs as our relationship with them is managed through a direct agreement between Microsoft and the OEM. We have distribution agreements covering one or more of our products with virtually all the multinational OEMs, including Dell, Hewlett-Packard, Lenovo, and with many regional and local OEMs. The second broad category of OEMs are system builders consisting of lower-volume PC manufacturers, which source Microsoft software for pre-installation and local redistribution primarily through the Microsoft distributor channel rather than through a direct agreement or relationship with Microsoft. LICENSING OPTIONS 

We offer options for organizations of varying sizes that want to purchase our cloud services and on-premises software. We license these organizations under volume licensing agreements to allow the customer to acquire multiple licenses of products and services instead of having to acquire separate licenses through retail channels. These volume licensing programs have varying programmatic requirements and benefits to best meet the needs of our customers. Software Assurance (“SA”) conveys rights to new software and upgrades for perpetual licenses released over the contract period. It also provides support, tools, training, and other licensing benefits to help customers deploy and use software efficiently. SA is required to be purchased with certain volume licensing agreements and is an optional purchase with others. Volume Licensing Programs

Enterprise Agreement 

Enterprise Agreements offer large organizations a manageable volume licensing program that gives them the flexibility to buy cloud services and software licenses under one agreement. Enterprise Agreements are designed for medium or large organizations that want to license Microsoft products and services organization-wide over a three-year period. Organizations can elect to purchase perpetual licenses (covered with SA) and/or subscribe to cloud services. Microsoft Customer Agreement

Microsoft Customer Agreements are simplified purchase agreements presented, accepted, and stored through a digital experience. Microsoft Customer Agreements are non-expiring agreements that are designed to support all customers over time, whether purchasing through a partner or directly from Microsoft. Microsoft Online Subscription Agreement

Microsoft Online Subscription Agreements are designed for small and medium organizations that want to subscribe to, activate, provision, and maintain cloud services seamlessly and directly via the web. These agreements allow customers to acquire monthly or annual subscriptions for cloud-based services. Microsoft Products and Services Agreement 

Microsoft Products and Services Agreements are designed for medium and large organizations that want to license cloud services and on-premises software as needed, with no organization-wide commitment, under a single, non-expiring agreement. Organizations purchase perpetual licenses or subscribe to licenses. SA is optional for customers that purchase perpetual licenses. Open Value

Open Value agreements are a simple, cost-effective way to acquire the latest Microsoft technology. These agreements are designed for small and medium organizations that want to license cloud services and on-premises software over a three-year period. Under Open Value agreements, organizations can elect to purchase perpetual licenses or subscribe to licenses and SA is included. Select Plus 

A Select Plus agreement is designed for government and academic organizations to acquire on-premises licenses at any affiliate or department level, while realizing advantages as one organization. Organizations purchase perpetual licenses and SA is optional. Partner Programs 

The Microsoft Cloud Solution Provider Program offers customers an easy way to license the cloud services they need in combination with the value-added services offered by their systems integrator, managed services provider, or cloud reseller partner. Partners in this program can easily package their own products and services to directly provision, manage, and support their customer subscriptions. The Microsoft Services Provider License Agreement allows hosting service providers and independent software vendors who want to license eligible Microsoft software products to provide hosted applications and software services to their end customers. Partners license software over a three-year period and are billed monthly based on units licensed. The Independent Software Vendor Royalty Program enables partners to integrate Microsoft products into other applications and then license the unified business solution to their end users. records.query: Amazon 在 AWS 基礎設施與 AI 領域（含與 Anthropic 的合作）的投資策略是什麼？
records.answer:
Amazon 的 AWS 基礎設施與 AI 投資策略核心是：透過持續且大幅增加技術基礎設施的資本支出與研發投入來推動 AWS 業務增長及 AI/機器學習能力，同時透過對 Anthropic 的大規模股權與債券投資深化 AI 戰略合作夥伴關係。

**一、AWS 基礎設施投資策略**

Amazon 持續擴大對 AWS 技術基礎設施的資本投入，以支援業務增長及 AI/機器學習倡議。公司明確表示預期技術與基礎設施支出將隨時間增加，雖然這可能對短期自由現金流產生負面影響，但目的是支援長期增長 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198]。基礎設施成本包含伺服器、網路設備及資料中心相關的折舊攤銷、租金、水電等費用，以支援 AWS 及其他 Amazon 業務 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #215]。

從資產規模來看，依據 10-K 報告中標註為「December 31, 2025」的數據，AWS 部門的總資產為 $252,588 million，其中財產與設備淨額為 $190,055 million [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #121]。AWS 的財產與設備淨額從 2024 年的 $110,683 million 大幅成長至 2025 年的 $190,055 million [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #121]。

在資本支出方面，AWS 的淨新增財產與設備從 2024 年的 $53,267 million 大幅增加至 2025 年的 $96,496 million [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #121]。其中，2025 年透過融資租賃新增的財產與設備為 $1.9 billion，透過 build-to-suit 租賃安排新增的為 $421 million [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #121]。AWS 的折舊與攤銷費用也從 2024 年的 $13,320 million 增加至 2025 年的 $21,450 million [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #121]。

AWS 的營業收入在 2025 年達到 $45,606 million，較 2024 年的 $39,834 million 增長，主要歸因於銷售增加，但部分被支援 AWS 業務增長的技術基礎設施投資支出所抵消 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #216]。2025 年技術與基礎設施成本的增加，主要歸因於基礎設施支出（包含折舊與攤銷）的增加 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #215]。

**二、AI 領域投資策略**

Amazon 認為技術的進步——特別是處理能力、資料儲存與分析的速度提升及成本降低，以及人工智慧與機器學習的實際應用——將持續改善使用者體驗，因此正在投資 AWS 以提供包括運算、儲存、資料庫、分析及機器學習在內的廣泛隨選技術服務 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198]。公司預期將持續增加基礎設施和員工投入，以支援其人工智慧和機器學習倡議 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #215]。

**三、與 Anthropic 的合作及投資策略**

Amazon 對 Anthropic 進行了大規模的投資，涵蓋可轉換債券與非投票權優先股。在 2025 年第二季，Amazon 投資了 $1.3 billion 於 Anthropic 的新可轉換債券，並計畫在 2025 年第四季再投資 $1.4 billion [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #37]。

截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日，Amazon 對 Anthropic 非投票權優先股的投資帳面價值約為 $14.8 billion（包含於資產負債表上的非投票權優先股項目），而可轉換債券的估計公允價值約為 $23.7 billion，相關未實現收益為 $18.8 billion [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #37]。截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日與 2025 年 9 月 30 日，非權益法核算的私人公司股權投資（主要與 Anthropic 的非投票權優先股相關）的帳面價值分別為 $989 million 與 $16.0 billion [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #37]。

在 2025 年第三季，Amazon 的部分 Anthropic 債券被轉換為非投票權優先股，因此將相關未實現收益重新分類並認列了約 $2.3 billion 的收益；同時，為反映可觀察的價格變動，對非投票權優先股記錄了 $7.2 billion 的向上調整 [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #37]。

此外，Amazon 與 Anthropic 之間還有商業合作安排，主要涉及 AWS 雲端服務的提供，包括使用 AWS 晶片 [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #37]。這項商業安排將 Anthropic 的 AI 發展與 AWS 的基礎設施服務直接連結，形成戰略協同效應。

在財務影響方面，Amazon 2025 年的其他收入（費用）淨額為 $15.2 billion 的淨收益，主要來自 Anthropic 非投票權優先股可觀察價格變動的向上調整，以及可轉換債券投資轉換為非投票權優先股時的重新分類調整收益 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #216]。相比之下，2024 年的其他收入（費用）淨額為 $(2.3) billion 的淨損失，主要來自對 Rivian 的股權投資產生的有價證券損失 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #216]。

Our interest income was $4.7 billion and $4.4 billion during 2024 and 2025, primarily due to a decrease in prevailing rates, offset by a higher average balance of invested funds. We generally invest our excess cash in investment grade short- to intermediate-term marketable debt securities and AAA-rated money market funds. Our interest income corresponds with the average balance of invested funds based on the prevailing rates, which vary depending on the geographies and currencies in which they are invested. Interest expense was $2.4 billion and $2.3 billion in 2024 and 2025 and was primarily related to debt and finance leases. See Item 8 of Part II, “Financial Statements and Supplementary Data — Note 4 — Leases and Note 6 — Debt” for additional information. The net loss of $(2.3) billion in 2024 is primarily from the marketable securities loss from our equity investment in Rivian Automotive, Inc. (“Rivian”). We expect spending in technology and infrastructure will increase over time, which can negatively impact short-term free cash flow, as we add infrastructure and employees, including to support our artificial intelligence and machine learning initiatives, to support long-term growth. Our technology and infrastructure investment and capital spending projects often support a variety of product and service offerings due to geographic expansion and the cross-functionality of our systems and operations. We seek to invest efficiently in several areas of technology and infrastructure, including AWS, and expansion of new and existing product categories and service offerings, as well as in infrastructure to enhance the customer experience and improve our process efficiencies. We believe that advances in technology, specifically the speed and reduced cost of processing power, data storage and analytics, improved wireless connectivity, and the practical applications of artificial intelligence and machine learning, will continue to improve users’ experience on the internet and increase its ubiquity in people’s lives. To best take advantage of these continued advances in technology, we are investing in AWS, which offers a broad set of on-demand technology services, including compute, storage, database, analytics, and machine learning, and other services to developers and enterprises of all sizes. We are also investing in initiatives to build and deploy innovative and efficient software and electronic devices as well as other initiatives including the development of a satellite network for global broadband service and autonomous vehicles for ride-hailing services. We seek to efficiently manage shareholder dilution while maintaining the flexibility to issue shares for strategic purposes, such as financings, acquisitions, and aligning employee compensation with shareholders’ interests. We utilize restricted stock units as our primary vehicle for equity compensation because we believe this compensation model aligns the long-term interests of our shareholders and employees. In measuring shareholder dilution, we include all vested and unvested stock awards outstanding, without regard to estimated forfeitures. Total shares outstanding plus outstanding stock awards were 10.9 billion and 11.0 billion as of December 31, 2024 and 2025. Our financial reporting currency is the U.S.

[AMZN 10-K period 2025] We regularly evaluate our facility requirements. Technology and Infrastructure

Technology and infrastructure costs include payroll and related expenses for employees involved in the research and development of new and existing products and services, development, design, and maintenance of our stores, curation and display of products and services made available in our online stores, and infrastructure costs. Infrastructure costs include servers, networking equipment, and data center related depreciation and amortization, rent, utilities, and other expenses necessary to support AWS and other Amazon businesses. Collectively, these costs reflect the investments we make in order to offer a wide variety of products and services to our customers, including expenditures related to initiatives to build and deploy innovative and efficient software and electronic devices and the development of a satellite network for global broadband service and autonomous vehicles for ride-hailing services. We seek to invest efficiently in numerous areas of technology and infrastructure so we may continue to enhance the customer experience and improve our process efficiency through rapid technology developments, while operating at an ever increasing scale. Our technology and infrastructure investment and capital spending projects often support a variety of product and service offerings due to geographic expansion and the cross-functionality of our systems and operations. We expect spending in technology and infrastructure to increase over time as we continue to add infrastructure and employees, including to support our artificial intelligence and machine learning initiatives. These costs are allocated to segments based on usage. The increase in technology and infrastructure costs in 2025, compared to the prior year, is primarily due to an increase in spending on infrastructure, including depreciation and amortization. Changes in foreign exchange rates increased technology and infrastructure costs by $312 million in 2025. We currently expense the majority of the costs associated with the development of our satellite network for global broadband service (including production, launch, and payroll costs, and launch services deposits upon launch). We will capitalize certain of these costs once the service achieves commercial viability, including sales to customers. Sales and Marketing

Sales and marketing costs include advertising and payroll and related expenses for personnel engaged in marketing and selling activities, including sales commissions related to AWS. We direct customers to our stores primarily through a number of marketing channels, such as our sponsored search, third-party customer referrals, social and online advertising, television advertising, and other initiatives. Our marketing costs are largely variable, based on growth in sales and changes in rates. To the extent there is increased or decreased competition for these traffic sources, or to the extent our mix of these channels shifts, we would expect to see a corresponding change in our marketing costs. The increase in sales and marketing costs in 2025, compared to the prior year, is primarily due to increased third-party advertising expenses. Changes in foreign exchange rates increased sales and marketing costs by $283 million in 2025. While costs associated with Amazon Prime membership benefits and other shipping offers are not included in sales and marketing expense, we view these offers as effective worldwide marketing tools, and intend to continue offering them indefinitely. 26

records.query: Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 與電商業務上面臨哪些反壟斷或監管風險？
records.answer:
Amazon 面臨多項反壟斷與監管風險，涵蓋電商市集與物流實務、AWS 雲端服務、Prime 會員制度、隱私資料保護，以及中國與印度等國際市場的外資准入限制等多個層面。

**電商市集與物流的反壟斷訴訟（義大利）**

義大利競爭管理局（ICA）於 2021 年 12 月對 Amazon 數個歐洲與義大利實體作出裁決，認定 Amazon 在義大利的市集與物流實務違反歐盟競爭規則，並處以 €11.3 億罰款，同時要求採取補救措施。Amazon 已支付該筆罰款，並將在所有上訴程序結束後尋求追回 [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #42]。2025 年 9 月，義大利行政法庭（TAR）維持了 ICA 的裁決，但將罰款金額降至 €7.52 億。Amazon 認為 TAR 維持 ICA 裁決的決定缺乏依據，將繼續積極抗辯 [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #42]。Amazon 已於 2025 年 12 月就 TAR 的裁決提出上訴 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #101]。

**AWS、Prime 與電商業務的廣泛競爭與消費者保護調查**

Amazon 面臨多項公開調查，這些調查主張 Amazon 的部分營運方式違反競爭或消費者保護規則，具體涉及 Amazon 商店的營運（包括其配送網絡與 Prime）以及 AWS 雲端服務的某些提供方式。Amazon 強烈反駁這些主張，並打算在這些調查中積極抗辯 [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108]。

**隱私與資料保護監管風險**

Amazon 面臨在日益增長的法規 patchwork 下的調查，這些法規規範資料的收集、使用與揭露，其解釋持續演變，導致監管機構將如何看待 Amazon 的隱私實務存在不確定性 [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108]。此外，Amazon 提到一項 CNPD 的裁決，Amazon 認為該裁決缺乏依據，將繼續積極抗辯 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #101]。（來源中未說明 CNPD 的全稱或其所屬國家。）

**「守門人」定位與科技業監管趨勢**

監管機構與立法者日益關注透過適用現有法規及制定新法規，來控制被其歸類為線上「守門人」的科技公司營運面向，這增加了 Amazon 的合規成本並限制了業務營運。不利的法規、法律、決定或解釋可能導致 Amazon 承擔巨額成本、面臨民事與刑事責任或罰款（包括巨額貨幣罰款）、降低產品與服務的需求或可用性、增加營業成本、要求改變商業實務、損害聲譽、阻礙增長，或對營運產生重大影響 [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108]。

**中國與印度的外資准入與監管風險**

中國（PRC）與印度透過法規與牌照要求規範 Amazon 及其關聯公司在當地的業務與營運，可能限制外資對網路、IT 基礎設施、資料中心、零售、配送等領域的投資與營運，以及網路內容與媒體產品銷售 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #136]。為滿足中國的所有權、監管牌照與網路安全要求，Amazon 透過與持有 PRC 牌照的第三方建立合約關係來提供某些技術服務 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #136]。在印度，政府限制外國實體對從事線上多品牌零售交易的印度公司的所有權或控制權；對於 www.amazon.in，Amazon 向第三方賣家提供行銷工具與物流服務，並持有一家作為該平台第三方賣家實體的間接少數股權。雖然 Amazon 認為這些結構與活動符合現行法律，但涉及獨特風險，且 PRC 與印度可能不時考慮並實施額外的監管、牌照或其他要求的變更，可能影響這些結構與活動 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #136]。

**專利與其他訴訟風險**

Amazon 也定期面臨涉及專利與其他智慧財產權、稅務、勞動與就業、競爭與反壟斷、隱私與資料保護、消費者保護、商業糾紛等方面的索賠、訴訟與其他程序。這些法律程序與其他或有事項的結果本質上不可預測，且可能對特定期間的營運結果與現金流產生重大影響 [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #42]。在一項專利訴訟中，原告於 2023 年 3 月的損害賠償報告中主張，若認定 Amazon 須承擔責任，可能面臨 $1.4 億至 $2.67 億的損害賠償；2024 年 3 月地方法院作出簡易判決，裁定該專利無效並駁回案件，但原告於 2024 年 4 月提出上訴 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #92]。

records.query: Google 如何把 Gemini AI 整合進搜尋與其他產品生態系？
records.answer:
Google 透過將 Gemini 模型嵌入旗下眾多產品、改造搜尋體驗，並結合其客製化 AI 基礎設施，把 Gemini AI 深度整合進搜尋與其他產品生態系中。

以下是各個整合層面的詳細說明：

**1. 搜尋體驗的 AI 整合**
Google 將 Gemini 的先進推理、思考與多模態能力導入搜尋引擎，推出「AI Overviews」與「AI Mode」功能。「AI Overviews」讓使用者能更輕鬆地提出問題並獲得有用的回應；「AI Mode」則允許使用者提出過去可能需要多次搜尋才能解答的細微問題 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。此外，大型語言模型讓使用者能輸入更自然的語言查詢，大幅改善了可提出的問題類型與結果品質，將原本僅提供十個藍色連結的網頁搜尋，轉變為動態的多模態體驗 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。

**2. 廣泛嵌入消費級產品生態系**
Google 將生成式 AI 與 Gemini 的力量嵌入其產品與平台中，目前所有 15 個擁有五億使用者的產品（包含七個擁有二十億使用者的產品）都在使用 Gemini 模型 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。這些產品涵蓋 Google 搜尋與 YouTube 等核心服務 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

**3. Google Cloud 與企業級服務**
針對 Google Cloud 的企業客戶，Google 提供「Gemini Enterprise」與「Gemini for Google Workspace」等解決方案，協助企業保持創新前沿 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。其中，Google Cloud Platform 提供包含企業 AI 基礎設施、Vertex AI 平台及 Gemini Enterprise 在內的 AI 服務 [GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #31]；而 Google Workspace 則將 Gemini 整合至 Gmail、Docs、Calendar、Drive 與 Meet 等雲端通訊與協作工具中 [GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #31]。

**4. 消費者訂閱服務**
在訂閱服務方面，Google One 服務提供使用者存取 Google 最強大的 Gemini 模型 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #155]。

**5. 底層 AI 基礎設施支援**
這些產品整合的基礎是 Google 採「全端」方法的 AI 最佳化基礎設施，這是一項關鍵差異化優勢，使其能夠支援自家產品（如搜尋與 YouTube）並服務 Google Cloud 客戶 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。該基礎設施提供多種 AI 加速器選項，包括專用圖形處理器（GPU）以及 Google 自行客製化打造的 Tensor Processing Unit（TPU），如代號「Ironwood」的 TPU [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

We believe AI is a profound platform shift that can bring meaningful and positive change to people and societies across the world, and to our business. Our technical infrastructure allows us to use and offer our customers a range of AI accelerator options, including specialized Graphics Processing Units (GPUs) and our own custom-built Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), such as Ironwood, our seventh-generation TPU. Designed to deliver advanced multimodal understanding, Gemini 3 represents our most capable iteration of agentic and generative coding technologies. records.query: Google 搜尋如何演變出 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 來回應生成式 AI 對搜尋的衝擊？
records.answer:
Google 搜尋從最初的「十個藍色連結」網頁查找工具，演變為結合大型語言模型的動態多模態體驗，透過 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 直接回應生成式 AI 對搜尋市場的衝擊 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。

## 搜尋體驗的演變歷程

Google 搜尋最初只是一種查找網頁的方式，將搜尋結果組織為十個藍色連結 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。大型語言模型的出現使得使用者能以更自然的語言進行查詢，大幅改善了使用者可提出的問題類型及結果品質 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。在此基礎上，Google 推出了兩項關鍵 AI 搜尋功能：

- **AI Overviews**：讓使用者更容易詢問 Google 任何問題並獲得有用的回應 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。
- **AI Mode**：允許使用者提出過去可能需要多次搜尋才能解答的更細緻問題，運用 Gemini 的高級推理、思考與多模態能力 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。

## AI 功能的商業化影響與競爭壓力

Alphabet 預期，使用者與 AI 產品和服務的互動將持續有利於其業務與營收 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #289]。然而，將 AI 整合至產品與服務中（如搜尋中的 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode，以及 Google Cloud Platform 上的企業 AI 解決方案），其變現方式可能與歷史上的消費者與企業產品不同，這可能影響營收成長率與利潤趨勢 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #289]。Google 在開發新產品與服務時，通常優先關注使用者體驗，其次才是變現 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #289]。

同時，Google 面臨來自其他 AI 產品與服務開發商及供應商日益激烈的競爭，這可能影響其營收 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #289]。為支撐這些 AI 產品與服務，Google 持續增加資本支出以擴充技術基礎設施，特別是針對 AI 領域，包括伺服器、網路設備與資料中心 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #289]。開發與提供 AI 產品所需的運算能力高於歷史上的消費者與企業產品，技術基礎設施的營運成本（折舊、能源、設備與網路容量）預計將顯著增加 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #289]。

## 搜尋營收與變現指標的實際表現

Google 搜尋與其他業務（Google Search & other）的營收在 2025 年達到 224,532 百萬美元，高於 2024 年的 198,084 百萬美元與 2023 年的 175,033 百萬美元 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #164]。2026 年前六個月，該項營收達到 123,670 百萬美元，較 2025 年同期的 104,892 百萬美元增加 188 億美元 [GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #47]。

在變現指標方面，2024 年至 2025 年期間，付費點擊量成長 6%，每次點擊成本成長 7% [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #299]。2026 年前三個月與前六個月，付費點擊量均較 2025 年同期成長 13%，每次點擊成本則分別成長 3%（三個月）與 4%（六個月）[GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #47]。整體成長的驅動因素包括行動裝置上使用者採用與使用量增加帶動的搜尋查詢量成長，以及廣告主支出增加 [GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #47]。

## 搜尋業務面臨的反壟斷挑戰

Google 搜尋業務同時面臨重大的反壟斷法律風險。2020 年 10 月，美國司法部與多州檢察長就 Google 的搜尋與搜尋廣告實踐提起訴訟 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #185]。2024 年 8 月，美國哥倫比亞特區聯邦地方法院裁定 Google 敗訴 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #185]。2025 年 12 月，法院作出最終判決，對 Google 分銷其服務的方式施加限制，並要求 Google 與競爭對手分享某些搜尋資料及提供內容聯播服務 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #185]。2026 年 1 月，Alphabet 就最終判決提出上訴，並請求暫停實施某些救濟措施 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #185]。此外，澳洲、日本等司法管轄區也對 Google 的搜尋分銷實踐進行了調查並要求修改 Android 相關協議 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #185]。

Alphabet Inc. Our products and services have come a long way since the company was founded more than 25 years ago. While Google Search started as a way to find web pages, organized into ten blue links, we have driven technical advancements and product innovations that have transformed Google Search into a dynamic, multimodal experience. Overview

As our founders Larry and Sergey wrote in the original founders' letter, "Google is not a conventional company. We do not intend to become one." That unconventional spirit has been a driving force throughout our history, inspiring us to tackle big problems and invest in moonshots. It led us to be a pioneer in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) and, since 2016, be an AI-first company. We continue this work under the leadership of Alphabet and Google CEO, Sundar Pichai. Alphabet is a collection of businesses — the largest of which is Google. We report Google in two segments, Google Services and Google Cloud, and all non-Google businesses collectively as Other Bets. Supporting these businesses, we have centralized certain AI-related research and development focused on advanced research in AI and developing the frontier models that serve our businesses, which is reported in Alphabet-level activities. Alphabet's structure is about helping each of our businesses prosper through strong leaders and independence. Access and Technology for Everyone

The Internet is one of the world’s most powerful equalizers; it propels ideas, people, and businesses large and small. Our mission to organize the world’s information and make it universally accessible and useful is as relevant today as it was when we were founded in 1998. Since then, we have evolved from a company that helps people find answers to a company that also helps people get things done. We are focused on building an even more helpful Google for everyone, and we aspire to give everyone the tools they need to increase their knowledge, health, happiness, and success. Google Search helps people find information and make sense of the world in more natural and intuitive ways, with trillions of searches on Google every year. YouTube provides people with entertainment, information, and opportunities to learn something new and helps support the creator economy through the YouTube Partner Program. Google Cloud helps customers build for the future, improve productivity, reduce costs, and unlock new growth engines. We continually innovate and build new products and features to help our users, partners, customers, and communities and have invested more than $200 billion in research and development in the last five years in support of these efforts.

[GOOGL 10-K period 2025] Alphabet Inc. Antitrust Matters

We are subject to formal and informal inquiries and investigations as well as litigation on various competition matters by regulatory authorities and private parties in the US, Europe, and other jurisdictions globally, including the following:

•Shopping: In June 2017, the EC announced its decision that certain actions taken by Google relating to its display and ranking of shopping search results and ads infringed European antitrust laws and imposed a €2.4 billion fine. In 2024, we made a cash payment of $3.0 billion for the fine. •Android: In July 2018, the EC announced its decision that certain provisions in Google's Android-related distribution agreements infringed European antitrust laws, imposed a €4.3 billion fine, and directed the termination of the conduct at issue. We appealed the EC decision and implemented changes to certain of our Android distribution practices. In September 2022, the General Court affirmed the EC decision but reduced the fine from €4.3 billion to €4.1 billion. We subsequently appealed the General Court's affirmation of the EC decision with the European Court of Justice, which remains pending. In 2018, we recognized a charge of $5.1 billion for the fine, which we reduced by $217 million in 2022. •AdSense for Search: In March 2019, the EC announced its decision that certain provisions in Google's agreements with AdSense for Search partners infringed European antitrust laws, imposed a €1.5 billion fine, and directed actions related to AdSense for Search partners' agreements, which we implemented prior to the decision. In 2019, we recognized a charge of $1.7 billion for the fine and appealed the EC decision. In September 2024, the General Court overturned the EC decision and annulled the €1.5 billion fine. The EC has appealed the General Court's decision with the European Court of Justice. •Search: In October 2020, the DOJ and a number of state Attorneys General filed a lawsuit in the US District Court for the District of Columbia concerning Google's Search and Search advertising practices and its compliance with US antitrust laws. In August 2024, the US District Court for the District of Columbia ruled against Google. A final judgment was entered in December 2025, which, among other things, imposes restrictions on how Google distributes its services and requires Google to share certain search data with and offer syndication services to certain competitors. In January 2026, we appealed the final judgment and moved to pause implementation of certain remedies. In February 2026, the DOJ and state Attorneys General also appealed. Further, in June 2022, the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC) opened an investigation into Search distribution practices. In August 2025, we agreed to a settlement with the ACCC requiring, among other things, changes to our Android agreements. We recognized a charge in the second quarter of 2025, and the settlement was approved by the court in December 2025. In October 2023, the Japanese Fair Trade Commission (JFTC) opened an investigation into Search distribution practices. In April 2025, the JFTC issued a cease-and-desist order requiring us to make changes to our Android agreements to ensure they are consistent with Japanese antitrust law. The JFTC did not impose monetary penalties. •Advertising Technology: In December 2020, a number of state Attorneys General filed a lawsuit in the US District Court for the Eastern District of Texas concerning Google's advertising technology and its compliance with US antitrust laws and state deceptive trade laws. In January 2023, the DOJ, along with a number of state Attorneys General, filed a lawsuit in the US District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia concerning Google's advertising technology and its compliance with US antitrust laws, and a number of additional state Attorneys General subsequently joined the lawsuit. In April 2025, the US District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia issued a mixed decision in the DOJ case against Google, ruling that neither Google's advertiser tools nor the DoubleClick and AdMeld acquisitions were anticompetitive, but that Google's publisher tools unfairly excluded rivals. A separate proceeding to determine remedies, the range of which vary widely, took place in September 2025, with the parties presenting differing remedy proposals.

Overview

Our vision does not center on any single product, but rather an entire ecosystem of experiences, devices, and new technologies powered by AI. records.query: Meta 在 AI 與 Reality Labs 上的長期願景與投資方向是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 的長期願景是打造「下一個運算平台」，將 AI、穿戴式裝置與元宇宙（metaverse）整合為下一代社交科技，為此持續大舉投資，但 Reality Labs 短期內仍將嚴重拖累獲利。以下依據參考資料，從願景方向、產品佈局、財務影響與風險四個面向說明：

**1. 長期戰略願景**

Meta 認為元宇宙——一種讓人們超越二維螢幕、擁有沉浸式體驗的具象化網際網路——是社交科技的下一個演化階段，並自 2021 年起將業務與產品策略轉向聚焦於使元宇宙成真 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]。公司將努力方向投入 AI、穿戴式裝置與裝置的創新，以協助打造下一代介面 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]。所有這些投資都是公司協助打造下一個運算平台的長期倡議的一部分 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。

**2. 產品與技術佈局**

- **VR 領域**：Meta 目前的 VR 產品包括 Meta Quest 裝置，以及透過 Meta Horizon Store 提供的軟體與內容，支援遊戲、健身、娛樂等社交體驗；為推動 VR 更廣泛採用，Meta 在 Meta Quest 裝置中引入透視（passthrough）功能，讓使用者在體驗 VR 沉浸感的同時仍能與物理世界保持連結 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。

- **穿戴式裝置**：Meta 的穿戴式裝置努力包括 AI 眼鏡與長期 AR 倡議；目前的 AI 眼鏡包括 Ray-Ban Meta 與 Oakley Meta 眼鏡，配備 Meta AI 對話助理及其他功能如免持互動 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。2024 年 Meta 公開了 Orion 原型，一副 AR 眼鏡，以眼鏡形式提供舒適佩戴體驗 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。2025 年 Meta 推出 Meta Ray-Ban Display，將 AI 眼鏡與內建於鏡片的顯示器結合，並搭配 Meta Neural Band——一款使用肌電圖讓人們以神經肌肉訊號控制 AI 眼鏡的腕戴式穿戴裝置 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。

- **2026 年支出分配**：Meta 預期 2026 年將約 70% 的 Reality Labs 營運支出投入穿戴式裝置倡議，剩餘 30% 投入 VR 與 Horizon 倡議 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。

**3. 財務影響**

Meta 持續增加 AI 模型開發與訓練的投資，並預期將繼續增加這些投資 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #188]。然而，Reality Labs 的重大投資僅產生有限營收，並降低了公司的營業利益率與獲利能力 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #188]。具體而言，Reality Labs 的投資使 Meta 2025 年整體營業利益減少約 191.9 億美元，且公司預期 2026 年 Reality Labs 的營運虧損將與 2025 年保持相似水準 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #188]。公司預期此類投資的不利財務影響在可預見的未來將持續存在 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #188]。

**4. 風險與不確定性**

- **市場接受度不確定**：元宇宙可能不會按照 Meta 的預期發展，公司所建構的功能、產品或服務的市場接受度存在不確定性 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]。

- **硬體經驗有限**：Meta 在消費性硬體產品與虛擬及擴增實境技術方面的經驗相對有限，這可能使其他公司比 Meta 更具競爭力 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]。

- **平台互操作性風險**：部分消費性硬體產品依賴與第三方行動平台的合作能力，而這些平台不一定為 Meta 的產品提供與其自身競爭產品相同水準的互操作性 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]。

- **資源排擠**：Reality Labs 的努力可能將資源與管理層注意力從公司其他業務領域轉移，且支援這些努力的能力依賴於從其他業務領域產生足夠的利潤 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]。

- **法規風險**：隨著 Reality Labs 努力演進，Meta 可能受到美國及國際司法管轄區各種現有或新法律法規的約束，涵蓋隱私、安全、AI、競爭、內容監管、醫療器材、關稅、出口管制、消費者保護與電子商務等領域，可能延遲或阻礙產品與服務的開發、增加營運成本，或以其他方式損害業務 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]。

- **長期成功不確定**：由於上述或其他因素，Meta 的 Reality Labs 策略與投資在可預見的未來可能無法成功，或根本無法成功，可能對公司的業務、聲譽或財務結果產生不利影響 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]。

records.query: Meta 的廣告獲利模式與 Meta AI 在旗下 App 中扮演的角色是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 的廣告獲利模式主要來自在 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger 及第三方行動應用程式上展示廣告產品，行銷人員依曝光數或點擊等行動付費；而 Meta AI 則是跨 App、獨立 App、AI 眼鏡及網頁皆可使用的智慧助手，協助使用者學習、完成任務、創作內容並與他人連結。

**廣告獲利模式**

Meta 的廣告收入幾乎全部來自廣告，廣告收入是透過在 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger 及第三方行動應用程式上展示廣告產品所產生 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311]。行銷人員可以直接或透過與廣告代理商或經銷商的關係，根據交付的曝光數或使用者採取的行動（如點擊）來支付廣告產品費用 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311]。就曝光型廣告而言，當廣告展示給使用者時即視為已交付，Meta 在合約約定的交付期間認列收入；就行動型廣告而言，則在使用者採取行銷人員合約約定的行動期間認列收入 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311]。Meta 將平均每則廣告價格計算為總廣告收入除以交付的廣告數量，代表行銷人員無論其期望目標（如曝光或行動）所支付的每則廣告平均價格 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311]。不同產品的變現率有所差異，例如影片和 Reels 產品目前的變現率與 Feed 或 Stories 產品不同 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311]。

**Meta AI 的角色**

Meta AI 是一個跨平台、跨裝置的智慧助手，可在 Meta 旗下各 App 中使用，也可作為獨立 App、在 AI 眼鏡上及在網頁上使用 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。其設計目的是協助使用者學習、完成任務、創作內容，並與他人連結，以充分利用每一刻 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。Meta AI 也與 Meta 的 AI 眼鏡產品整合，例如 Ray-Ban Meta 和 Oakley Meta 眼鏡均搭載 Meta AI 作為先進的對話式助手 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。此外，Meta AI 也出現在 Meta Ray-Ban Display 產品中，該產品將 AI 眼鏡與內建於鏡片的顯示器結合，並搭配 Meta Neural Band 腕帶裝置，讓使用者透過肌電訊號控制 AI 眼鏡 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。

**AI 投資與廣告業務的關聯**

Meta 的 AI 投資支援旗下產品與服務的各項計畫，包括協助驅動 App 中的內容排序系統、推薦相關內容的探索引擎，以及廣告商用來觸及客戶的工具 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。這些 AI 投資也支援新生成式 AI 體驗的開發，以及提升產品開發效率與生產力的工具 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。Meta 正致力於開發下一代 AI 模型，並推進其建構超級智慧的願景，Meta 將超級智慧定義為超越人類智慧的 AI [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

**地理區域的廣告收入趨勢**

Meta 的收入按使用者地理區域計算，美國與加拿大及歐洲等地區的收入相對較高，主要原因是這些線上與行動廣告市場的規模與成熟度，而廣告曝光成長主要來自變現率較低的地區，如亞太地區 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #303]。2025 年，美國與加拿大的收入成長 21%，歐洲成長 24%，亞太地區成長 20%，世界其他地區成長 27%，均為相對於 2024 年的數據 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #303]。在 2025 年第三季度，美國與加拿大收入成長 24%，歐洲成長 29%，亞太地區成長 25%，世界其他地區成長 32%，均為相對於 2024 年同期的數據 [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #211]。

[META 10-K period 2025] 70


Components of Results of Operations

Revenue

Family of Apps (FoA)

Advertising. We generate substantially all of our revenue from advertising. Our advertising revenue is generated by displaying ad products on Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, and third-party mobile applications. Marketers pay for ad products either directly or through their relationships with advertising agencies or resellers, based on the number of impressions delivered or the number of actions, such as clicks, taken by users. We recognize revenue from the display of impression-based ads in the contracted period in which the impressions are delivered. Impressions are considered delivered when an ad is displayed to a user. We recognize revenue from the delivery of action-based ads in the period in which a user takes the action the marketer contracted for. The number of ads we show is subject to methodological changes as we continue to evolve our ads business and the structure of our ads products. In particular, the ads we show may vary by product (for example, our video and Reels products are not currently monetized at the same rate as our Feed or Stories products), and from time to time we increase or decrease the number or frequency of ads we show as part of our product and monetization strategies. We calculate average price per ad as total advertising revenue divided by the number of ads delivered, representing the average price paid per ad by a marketer regardless of their desired objective such as impression or action. For advertising revenue arrangements where we are not the principal, we recognize revenue on a net basis.

[META] It operates through two segments, Family of Apps (FoA) and Reality Labs (RL). The FoA segment offers Facebook, which enables people to build community through feed, reels, stories, groups, marketplace, and other; Instagram that brings people closer through Instagram feed, stories, reels, live, and messaging; Messenger, a messaging application for people to connect with friends, family, communities, and businesses across platforms and devices through text, audio, and video calls; Meta AI, an assistant that's available across apps, as a stand-alone app, on AI glasses, and on the web; Threads, an application for text-based updates and public conversations; and WhatsApp, a messaging application that is used by people and businesses to communicate and transact. The RL segment provides virtual and augmented reality products, including consumer hardware, software, and content that help people feel connected, as well as Meta Quest devices that enable social experiences across gaming, fitness, entertainment, and more. The segment also includes wearables such as AI glasses like Ray Ban Meta and Oakley Meta glasses; and the Meta Ray Ban Display, which combines AI glasses with an integrated lens display and the Meta Neural Band, a wrist worn device using electromyography that lets people control their AI glasses through neuromuscular signals. Meta Platforms, Inc. has a collaboration with Microsoft Corporation, NVIDIA Corporation, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc., Broadcom Inc., and OpenAI, L.L.C. The company was formerly known as Facebook, Inc. and changed its name to Meta Platforms, Inc. in October 2021. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Menlo Park, California.

[META 10-K period 2025] Item 1.Business 

Overview

Our mission is to build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible. Our products enable people to connect and share through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality (VR) headsets, and AI glasses. We are innovating in artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to build transformative experiences and capabilities across our Family of Apps and new platforms, and to advance our vision to deliver personal superintelligence for everyone. We build technology that helps people connect and share, find and build communities, and grow businesses. We also help people discover and learn about what is going on in the world around them, enable people to share their experiences, ideas, photos, videos, and other content with audiences ranging from their closest family members and friends to the public at large, and stay connected everywhere by accessing our products. Meta is moving our offerings beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next computing platform. Our vision does not center on any single product, but rather an entire ecosystem of experiences, devices, and new technologies powered by AI. While the metaverse is in the very early stages of its development, we believe it will become the next computing platform and the future of social interaction. Across our work, we are innovating to build new experiences that help make our platform more social, useful, and immersive. Our AI investments support initiatives across our products and services, helping power the systems that rank content in our apps, our discovery engine that recommends relevant content, the tools advertisers use to reach customers, the development of new generative AI experiences, and the tools that make our product development more efficient and productive. We are also working to develop the next generation of AI models and advance our vision to build superintelligence, which we define as AI that surpasses human intelligence. records.query: Tesla 如何把自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）技術當作與競爭對手的核心差異化？
records.answer:
Tesla 將自動駕駛技術（FSD/Autopilot）視為核心差異化優勢，主要透過自研視覺式 AI 系統、專用推理晶片、以及將自動駕駛能力延伸至 Robotaxi 服務與人形機器人 Optimus 來實現。

**技術路線與自研能力**

Tesla 採用基於視覺的技術（vision-based technologies）、系統與軟體來訓練其人工神經網路，並使用自家設計的專用推理晶片（in-house, custom designed inference chips）來加速這些網路的運算 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。公司明確表示，其 AI 能力與進展使其與競爭對手產生差異化（"we believe our capabilities and advancements in AI differentiate us from our competitors"）[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。Tesla 透過空中軟體更新（over-the-air software updates）持續改善客戶車輛中的駕駛輔助功能 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。

**從駕駛輔助到 Robotaxi 的商業模式延伸**

Tesla 於 2025 年 6 月推出了 Robotaxi 服務，這是一個自主叫車平台（autonomous ride-hailing platform），目前使用 Model Y 車輛營運，未來將納入專為自動駕駛設計的 Cybercab [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。公司期望該服務將隨著交通模式的演變，擴大客戶群，並結合 FSD（Supervised）訂閱服務，開啟以 AI、軟體與車隊為基礎的服務驅動商業模式 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。Tesla 預期 Robotaxi 服務將透過 FSD（Supervised）與神經網路能力的持續進步、Supercharger 網路以及資訊娛樂系統，與傳統叫車與計程車服務競爭 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #51]。

**AI 技術跨領域應用：從自駕到機器人**

Tesla 將自動駕駛技術中累積的 AI 經驗應用於機器人領域，例如正在開發中的通用型自主人形機器人 Optimus [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。公司整體戰略定位為「將 AI 帶入真實世界」，透過 FSD（Supervised）、Robotaxi 以及 AI 機器人（Bots）等產品與服務來實現此目標 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #30]。

**垂直整合與全車自主性設計**

Tesla 宣稱目前交付的每一輛車都為自主駕駛而設計（"Every Tesla vehicle delivered today is designed for autonomy"）[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。公司認為其工程專業知識、真實世界 AI 的進展、垂直整合的商業模式以及對使用者體驗的關注，使其與其他公司產生差異化 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #30]。

**競爭定位**

在自動駕駛領域，Tesla 面臨 AI 與機器人領域的競爭，公司尋求成為自主解決方案的頂級供應商（"top provider of autonomous solutions"）[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #51]。值得注意的是，來源中提到「規格與功能、強大的品牌以及模組化、可擴展的產品特性」是針對 Tesla 的**儲能產品**的競爭優勢，而非自動駕駛領域 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #51]。

**相關訴訟風險**

Tesla 的自動駕駛技術也帶來法律風險。多起集體訴訟指控 Tesla 有關 Autopilot 與 FSD 技術的虛假陳述與產品缺陷，包括 2022 年 9 月在加州北區聯邦地方法院提起的集體訴訟，以及 2025 年 8 月 4 日在德州西區聯邦法院提起的另一起集體訴訟，後者指控 Tesla 在 Autopilot、FSD（Supervised）及 Robotaxi 的有效性方面違反聯邦證券法 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #227; TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #47]。

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] We have planned electric vehicles to address additional vehicle markets, and will continue leveraging developments in our proprietary Full Self-Driving (“FSD”) (Supervised) features, battery cell and other technologies. For purposes of this filing, use of the term “FSD (Supervised)” includes the equivalent naming convention, “FSD (Capability)” that is used in the European, Middle East and Asia-Pacific regions. In June 2025, we launched our Robotaxi service, an autonomous ride-hailing platform that harnesses our technology and vehicles. We expect this service will open access to an expanded customer base as modes of transportation evolve, and, along with products such as FSD (Supervised) subscriptions, unlock the potential to advance a service-driven business model based on AI, software and fleet-based profits. Our Robotaxi business currently operates with Model Y vehicles but, in time, will include Cybercab, our purpose-built autonomous vehicle. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Products

Powerwall and Megapack are our lithium-ion battery energy storage products. Powerwall, which we sell and lease to customers, as well as through channel partners, is designed to store energy at homes or small commercial facilities. Megapack is an energy storage solution for commercial, industrial, utility and energy generation customers, multiple of which may be grouped together to form larger installations of gigawatt hours (“GWh”) or greater capacity. As AI infrastructure drives rapid load growth, Megapack helps to, among other things, increase utilization of existing generation and transmission capacity, resulting in a more efficient use of the electric grid. We also continue to develop software capabilities for remotely controlling and dispatching our energy storage systems across a wide range of markets and applications, including through our real-time energy control and optimization platforms for Megapack batteries (Autobidder) and distributed energy resources like Powerwall (Powerhub). Energy Generation Offerings

We sell energy generation systems directly to customers and also through channel partners. We design and manufacture certain components for our energy generation products, including solar panels and Solar Roof, which combines premium glass roof tiles with energy generation. We also purchase many components for our energy generation systems from various third-party manufacturers to provide for competitive pricing and adequate supply. Technology

Automotive

Self-Driving Development and Artificial Intelligence 

We use AI to develop real-world applications, such as autonomous driving solutions and robots. We utilize vision-based technologies, systems and software to train our artificial neural networks, which are accelerated by our own in-house, custom designed inference chips. We are also applying our artificial intelligence learnings from self-driving technology to Bots, such as Optimus, a general purpose, autonomous humanoid robot in development. Currently, we offer in our customer vehicles certain advanced driver assistance systems. Although at present, same as in the past, the driver is responsible for remaining fully engaged in the driving operation, these systems provide safety and convenience functionality that may relieve drivers of many tedious and potentially dangerous aspects of road travel much like the system that airplane pilots use, when conditions permit. As with other vehicle systems, we improve these functions in our customer vehicles through over-the-air software updates. Every Tesla vehicle delivered today is designed for autonomy, and we believe our capabilities and advancements in AI differentiate us from our competitors. Vehicle Control and Infotainment Software

The performance and safety systems of our vehicles and their battery packs utilize sophisticated control software. Control systems in our vehicles optimize performance, customize vehicle behavior, manage charging and control all infotainment functions. We develop almost all of this software, including most of the user interfaces, internally and update our vehicles’ software regularly through over-the-air updates, and work to actively improve our software security with every release. Battery and Powertrain

Our core vehicle technology competencies include powertrain engineering and manufacturing and our ability to design vehicles that utilize the unique advantages of an electric powertrain. We have designed our proprietary powertrain systems to be adaptable, efficient, reliable and cost-effective while withstanding the rigors of an automotive environment. We offer dual motor powertrain vehicles, which use two electric motors to maximize traction and performance in an all-wheel drive configuration, as well as vehicle powertrain technology featuring three electric motors for further increased performance in certain versions of Model S and Model X, Cybertruck and the Tesla Semi. We maintain extensive testing and R&D capabilities for battery cells, packs and systems, and have built an expansive body of knowledge on lithium-ion cell chemistry types and performance characteristics.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] ITEM 1. BUSINESS

Overview

We are focused on bringing artificial intelligence (“AI”) into the real world, through products and services like Full Self-Driving (“FSD”) (Supervised) and Robotaxi, as well as working to develop and commercialize AI robots (“Bots”) (including Optimus). We intend to leverage our current operations, in which we design, develop, manufacture, sell and lease high-performance fully electric vehicles and energy generation and storage systems that increasingly deliver AI-related and enhanced software and services to our customers, to achieve that objective. We generally sell our products directly to customers, and continue to grow our global retail, service and charging footprint to accelerate the widespread adoption of our products. We emphasize performance, attractive styling and the safety of our users and workforce in the design and manufacture of our products and are continuing to develop full self-driving technology for improved safety. We also strive to lower the cost of ownership for our customers through continuous efforts to reduce manufacturing costs and by offering financial and other services tailored to our products. Our mission is building a world of amazing abundance. We believe that this mission, along with our engineering expertise, advancements in real-world AI, vertically integrated business model, and focus on user experience differentiate us from other companies. Segment Information

records.query: Tesla 在電動車市場面臨什麼樣的競爭態勢？
records.answer:
Tesla 在電動車市場面臨極度激烈的競爭，傳統汽車大廠與新興製造商紛紛推出電動及替代燃料車輛，且許多競爭對手擁有比 Tesla 更豐富或更穩固的資源 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66]。

以下從多個面向說明 Tesla 面臨的競爭態勢：

**1. 產品線各級別的競爭對手**

Tesla 各車型在多個傳統細分市場中與不同類型的車輛競爭：Cybertruck 與其他皮卡競爭，Model S 和 Model X 主要與高級轎車和高級 SUV 競爭，Model 3 和 Model Y 則與中小型轎車和緊湊型 SUV 競爭 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #50]。競爭產品通常包括來自成熟汽車製造商的內燃機車輛，但許多成熟製造商和新製造商已進入或已宣布計畫進入電動及其他替代燃料車輛市場 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #50]。

**2. 競爭對手的資源優勢**

許多競爭對手擁有比 Tesla 顯著更多或更穩固的資源，可用於產品設計、開發、製造、分銷、推廣、銷售和支援，且可能因地理位置和經濟環境而獲得額外的成本效率 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66]。此外，某些政府與經濟激勵措施為在國內組裝或擁有本地供應商的製造商提供優惠，這可能使競爭對手獲得更大利益，進而對 Tesla 的盈利能力產生負面影響 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66]。

**3. 自駕與機器人計程車領域的競爭**

Tesla 在自駕技術與服務市場面臨激烈競爭，包括其他車輛應用和軟體平台領域的競爭者 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66]。Tesla 預期其 Robotaxi 服務將透過 FSD（Supervised）和神經網路能力的持續進步、Supercharger network（超級充電網路）以及 infotainment offerings（資訊娛樂服務），在這個發展中的市場與傳統叫車服務和計程車服務競爭 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #51]。Tesla 同時也面臨 AI 和機器人領域的競爭 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #51]。

**4. 電動車市場需求的不確定性**

電動車仍佔整體車輛銷售的一小部分，Tesla 的市場可能受到多種因素負面影響，包括：對電動車功能、品質、安全性、性能和成本的看法；對單次充電可行駛里程有限及充電設施取得不便的擔憂；來自其他替代燃料車輛、插電式混合動力車和高燃油效率內燃機車輛的競爭；石油、汽油和能源成本的波動；政府法規與經濟激勵措施；以及對 Tesla 未來生存能力的擔憂 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #62]。

**5. 競爭加劇的後果**

日益激烈的競爭可能導致 Tesla 的車輛單位銷量下降、價格下調、收入不足、客戶流失和市占率下降，進而損害其業務、財務狀況和經營成果 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66]。全球汽車市場目前競爭激烈，Tesla 預期未來競爭將更加激烈 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66]。

**6. 人才市場的競爭**

Tesla 在人才方面也面臨激烈競爭，特別是在工程與製造中心所在地區，對具備電動車、工程及電氣與建築專業知識的人才需求競爭激烈，員工可能因競爭激烈的勞動市場或負面宣傳而離開 Tesla [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #78]。

records.query: Tesla 的能源生成與儲能業務在公司整體策略中扮演什麼角色？
records.answer:
Tesla 的能源生成與儲能業務是公司兩大核心營運板塊之一，涵蓋太陽能發電系統與鋰電池儲能產品的設計、製造、安裝、銷售及租賃，並且該業務的收入與毛利在近年持續增長，是公司整體營收結構中的重要組成部分。[TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2]

以下從多個面向說明該業務在公司策略中的角色：

**1. 獨立的報告板塊與財務貢獻**

Tesla 將業務分為兩個營運板塊：汽車板塊與能源生成及儲能板塊，公司的首席營運決策者（CODM）使用毛利來分配營運和資本資源並評估各板塊的績效。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #239] 從年度財務數據來看，能源生成與儲能板塊的收入從 2023 年的 60.35 億美元增長至 2024 年的 100.86 億美元，並進一步增長至 2025 年的 127.71 億美元；同期毛利也從 2023 年的 11.41 億美元增長至 2024 年的 26.40 億美元，2025 年達到 38.02 億美元。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #239] 在 2026 年第一季度，該業務收入為 24.08 億美元，成本為 14.56 億美元（2025 年同期收入為 27.30 億美元，成本為 19.45 億美元）。[TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #16]

**2. 產品線與客戶群多元覆蓋**

該業務向住宅、商業、工業客戶及公用事業提供產品與服務，具體包括鋰電池儲能產品 Powerwall 與 Megapack，以及太陽能板和太陽能屋頂等能源生成產品。[TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2] 在銷售模式上，針對住宅與小型商業客戶，Tesla 提供系統的工程設計與安裝服務，客戶預先支付全額購買價款，收入在系統安裝完成並通過公用事業或主管機關檢查後確認；對於渠道合作夥伴的儲能系統銷售，則在產品交付時確認收入。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #161] 此外，公司也透過 PPA（購電協議）交易方式向部分商業客戶銷售太陽能與儲能產品。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #35]

**3. 與汽車業務的協同效應**

能源業務與汽車業務在基礎設施上存在協同。Tesla 在可能的情况下將超級充電站與太陽能及儲能系統共址建設，以降低成本並推廣可再生能源的使用。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #35] 此外，能源板塊的庫存從 2024 年 12 月 31 日的 20.29 億美元增加至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的 27.14 億美元，而同期汽車板塊庫存則從 99.88 億美元降至 96.78 億美元。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #239]

**4. 品牌與市場推廣策略**

在能源產品的行銷方面，Tesla 強調簡單化、標準化與可及性，以降低客戶採用清潔能源的門檻與公司的客戶獲取成本，銷售渠道包括網站、門店、畫廊以及渠道合作夥伴網絡。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #35] 同時，Tesla 為能源產品客戶提供維修與保固服務，包括對儲能產品提供製造商有限保固，對安裝工程提供工藝保固，並針對太陽能屋頂提供防漏水和耐候性保固。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #35]

**5. 資產規模與資源投入**

截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，Tesla 資產負債表上「能源生成與儲能系統淨額」為 45.65 億美元（2025 年 12 月 31 日為 46.04 億美元），顯示公司在該業務領域持有相當規模的長期資產。[TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #16] 該板塊在 2025 年的折舊與攤銷費用為 3.55 億美元。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #239]

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] Energy Generation and Storage Sales

Energy generation and storage sales revenue consists of the sale of energy generation and storage systems to residential, small commercial, large commercial and utility grade customers. Sales of energy generation and storage systems to residential and small-scale commercial customers consist of the engineering, design and installation of the system. Residential and small-scale commercial customers pay the full purchase price of the system upfront. Revenue for the design and installation obligation is recognized when control transfers, which is when we install a system and the system passes inspection by the utility or the authority having jurisdiction. [TSLA 10-K period 2025] We also customize solutions including our energy storage products, energy generation systems and/or Solar Roof for customers to meet their specific needs. 4


Sales and Marketing

Historically, we have been able to achieve sales without relying on traditional advertising and at relatively low marketing costs. We continue to monitor our public narrative and brand, and tailor our marketing efforts accordingly, including through investments in customer education and advertising as necessary. Automotive

Direct Sales

Our vehicle sales channels currently include our website and a global network of company-owned stores. In some jurisdictions, we also have galleries to educate and inform customers about our products, but such locations do not transact in the sale of vehicles. We believe this infrastructure enables us to better control costs of inventory, manage warranty service and pricing, educate consumers about electric vehicles, make our vehicles more affordable, maintain and strengthen the Tesla brand and obtain rapid customer feedback. We reevaluate our sales strategy both globally and at a location-by-location level from time to time to optimize our sales channels. However, sales of vehicles in the automobile industry tend to be cyclical in many markets, which may expose us to volatility from time to time. Used Vehicle Sales

Our used vehicle business supports new vehicle sales by integrating the trade-in of a customer’s existing Tesla or non-Tesla vehicle with the sale of a new Tesla vehicle. The Tesla and non-Tesla vehicles we acquire as trade-ins, along with vehicles returned upon lease-end are subsequently remarketed, either directly by us or through third parties. Public Charging

We have a growing global network of Tesla Superchargers, which are our industrial-grade, high-speed vehicle chargers. Where possible, we co-locate Superchargers with our solar and energy storage systems to reduce costs and promote renewable power. Supercharger stations are typically placed along well-traveled routes and in and around dense city centers to allow vehicle owners the ability to enjoy quick, reliable charging along an extensive network with convenient stops. Use of the Supercharger network either requires payment of a fee or is free under certain sales programs. We offer Supercharger access to non-Tesla vehicles in support of our mission, with all major automakers announcing their adoption of the North American Charging Standard (NACS) in certain markets. We continue to monitor and increase our network of Tesla Superchargers in anticipation of future demand, including with respect to our Robotaxi services. We also work with a wide variety of hospitality, retail and public destinations, as well as businesses with commuting employees, to offer additional charging options for our customers, as well as single-family homeowners and multi-family residential entities, to deploy home charging solutions. To accelerate dependable charging ubiquity, Superchargers are also available through our Supercharger for Business program, where third parties can purchase and install Superchargers and set the charging price, while Tesla remains responsible for software updates, network operations, maintenance and driver support. In 2025, we opened the first Tesla Diner in California, which offers Supercharging as well as Tesla themed food and merchandise. In-App Upgrades 

As our vehicles are capable of being updated remotely over-the-air, our customers may purchase additional paid options and features through the Tesla app or through the in-vehicle user interface, which also allows us to offer certain options and features on a subscription basis. Energy Generation and Storage

We market and sell our solar and energy storage products to residential, commercial and industrial customers and utilities through a variety of channels, including through our website, stores and galleries, as well as through our network of channel partners, and in the case of some commercial customers, through PPA transactions. We emphasize simplicity, standardization and accessibility to make it easy and cost-effective for customers to adopt clean energy, while reducing our customer acquisition costs. 5


Service and Warranty

Automotive

Service

We provide service for our electric vehicles at our company-owned service locations and through Tesla Mobile Service technicians who perform work remotely at customers’ homes or other locations. Servicing the vehicles ourselves allows us to identify problems and implement solutions and improvements faster than traditional automobile manufacturers and their dealer networks. The connectivity of our vehicles also allows us to diagnose and remedy many problems remotely and proactively. Vehicle Limited Warranties and Extended Service Plans

We provide a manufacturer’s limited warranty on all new and used Tesla vehicles we sell directly to consumers, which may include limited warranties on certain components, specific types of damage or battery capacity retention. We also currently offer optional extended service plans that provide coverage after the new vehicle limited warranties end for certain models in specified regions. Energy Generation and Storage

We provide service and repairs to our energy product customers, including under warranty where applicable. We generally provide manufacturer’s limited warranties with our energy storage products and offer certain extended limited warranties that are available at the time of purchase of the system. If we install a system, we also provide certain limited warranties on our installation workmanship. For retrofit energy generation systems, we provide separate limited warranties for workmanship and against roof leaks, and for Solar Roof, we also provide limited warranties for defects and weatherization. For components not manufactured by us, we generally pass-through the applicable manufacturers’ warranties.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] Additionally, the automotive segment also includes services and other, which includes sales of used vehicles, non-warranty maintenance services and collision, paid Supercharging sessions, automotive insurance business revenue, part sales and retail merchandise sales. The energy generation and storage segment includes the design, manufacture, installation, sales and leasing of energy generation and storage products and related services and sales of energy generation incentives. Our CODM does not evaluate operating segments using asset or liability information. The CODM uses gross profit to allocate operating and capital resources and assesses performance of each segment by comparing actual gross profit results to historical results and previously forecasted financial information. records.query: Apple 自己在 10-K 中如何描述它在智慧型手機、PC、平板市場面臨的競爭壓力與市佔地位？
records.answer:
Apple 在 2025 年 10-K 中明確表示，公司在全球智慧型手機、個人電腦、平板電腦及穿戴式裝置市場中僅持有少數（少數）市佔率，且所處市場高度競爭，面臨對手以低價策略侵蝕利潤的巨大壓力 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24] [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #104]。

以下依據 Apple 2025 年 10-K 的揭露，從幾個面向進一步說明：

**1. 市佔地位：少數市場份額，部分市場甚至零成長或萎縮**

Apple 在文件中直接指出：「本公司在全球智慧型手機、個人電腦、平板電腦及穿戴式裝置市場中持有少數市佔率，且本公司所競爭的某些市場有時幾乎沒有成長或整體萎縮。」[AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24] [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #104]

**2. 競爭壓力的來源與特徵**

Apple 描述其產品與服務市場「高度競爭」，具特徵包括：激烈的價格競爭、毛利率下行壓力、產品性能持續提升、以及消費者與企業對價格的敏感度 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #23] [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #104]。此外，市場還受新產品頻繁推出、產品生命週期短、行業標準不斷演變、以及競爭對手快速採用新技術等因素定義 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #23] [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #104]。

**3. 競爭對手的策略與資源優勢**

Apple 指出，許多競爭對手主要透過激進定價和極低成本結構來競爭，並模仿 Apple 的產品及侵犯其智慧財產權 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #23] [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #104]。某些競爭對手甚至擁有足夠的資源、經驗或成本結構，能以微利甚至虧損的方式提供產品與服務 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24] [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #104]。Apple 的競爭對手具有廣泛的產品線、低價產品、龐大的活躍裝置安裝基數與龐大客戶群 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24] [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #104]。

**4. 競爭加劇的趨勢：模仿與整合**

Apple 預期競爭將持續加劇，因為競爭對手不僅模仿 Apple 的產品功能和應用程式，還模仿 Apple 將組件無縫整合到其產品中的方式，或透過合作提供整合解決方案 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24] [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #104]。

**5. Apple 的應對策略與競爭優勢來源**

Apple 表示其成功競爭的能力在很大程度上取決於確保持續且及時地向市場推出創新的新產品、服務和技術 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24] [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #104]。Apple 設計並開發幾乎整個產品解決方案，包括硬體、作業系統、眾多軟體應用程式及相關服務 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24] [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #104]。主要競爭因素包括：價格、產品與服務功能（含安全功能）、性價比、品質與可靠性、設計與技術創新、強大的第三方軟體與配件生態系統、行銷與分銷能力、服務與支援、企業聲譽，以及有效保護和執行智慧財產權的能力 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24]。為維持競爭力，Apple 必須在研發方面進行大量投資，但這些投資可能無法達到預期回報 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #104]。

**6. 智慧財產權保護的挑戰**

Apple 持有大量專利、商標和版權，但有效智慧財產權保護並非在 Apple 營運的每個國家都能一致獲得 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #104]。若競爭對手侵犯 Apple 的智慧財產權，或 Apple 無法繼續開發和銷售具吸引利潤率的創新產品，其維持競爭優勢的能力可能受到重大不利影響 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #104]。監管要求、政府調查和訴訟也可能迫使 Apple 退出某些國家或修改產品，甚至要求 Apple 與競爭對手分享創新成果 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #104]。

**7. 產品生命週期與利潤壓力**

Apple 必須成功管理頻繁的產品與服務推出和轉換，但新產品、服務和技術可能取代或取代現有產品，且可能產生較低的收入和較低的利潤率 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #104]。競爭尤其激烈，因為競爭對手已積極降價並降低產品利潤率 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24] [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #104]。
