Although the reportable segments provide similar hardware and software products and similar services, each one is managed separately to better align with the location of the Company’s customers and distribution partners and the unique market dynamics of each geographic region. Markets and Distribution

The Company’s customers are primarily in the consumer, small and mid-sized business, education, enterprise and government markets. The Company sells its products and resells third-party products in most of its major markets directly to customers through its retail and online stores and its direct sales force. The Company sells its services in the same markets through its various service platforms. The Company also employs a variety of indirect distribution channels, such as third-party cellular network carriers and other resellers, for the sale of its products and certain of its services. During 2025, the Company’s net sales through its direct and indirect distribution channels accounted for 40% and 60%, respectively, of total net sales. Competition

The markets for the Company’s products and services are highly competitive and are characterized by aggressive price competition, downward pressure on gross margins, continual improvement in product performance, and price sensitivity on the part of consumers and businesses. The markets in which the Company competes are further defined by frequent introduction of new products and services, short product life cycles, evolving industry standards, and rapid adoption of technological advancements by competitors. Many of the Company’s competitors seek to compete primarily through aggressive pricing and very low cost structures, and by imitating the Company’s products and infringing on its intellectual property. Apple Inc. | 2025 Form 10-K | 2

[AAPL 10-K period 2025] The Company’s ability to compete successfully depends heavily on ensuring the continuing and timely introduction of innovative new products, services and technologies to the marketplace. The Company designs and develops nearly the entire solution for its products, including the hardware, operating system, numerous software applications and related services. Principal competitive factors important to the Company include price, product and service features (including security features), relative price and performance, product and service quality and reliability, design and technology innovation, a strong third-party software and accessories ecosystem, marketing and distribution capability, service and support, corporate reputation, and the ability to effectively protect and enforce the Company’s intellectual property rights. The Company is focused on expanding its market opportunities related to smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and accessories, and services. The Company’s products and services face substantial competition from companies that have significant technical, marketing, distribution and other resources, as well as established hardware, software, and service offerings with large customer bases. In addition, the Company faces significant competition as competitors imitate the Company’s product features and applications within their products to offer more competitive solutions. The Company also expects competition to intensify as competitors imitate the Company’s approach to providing components seamlessly within their offerings or work collaboratively to offer integrated solutions. Some of the Company’s competitors have broad product lines, low-priced products, large installed bases of active devices, and large customer bases. Competition has been particularly intense as competitors have aggressively cut prices and lowered product margins. Certain competitors have the resources, experience or cost structures to provide products and services at little or no profit or even at a loss. The Company has a minority market share in the global smartphone, personal computer, tablet and wearables markets, and some of the markets in which the Company competes have from time to time experienced little to no growth or contracted overall. Regulatory requirements, government investigations and litigation can force the Company to withdraw from, or modify its products and services for, certain countries and limit its ability to derive value from, or to enjoin others from using, its intellectual property rights. Additionally, they may require the Company to share its innovations with competitors. Any of these outcomes can have a negative impact on the Company’s competitive advantage and materially adversely affect its business, results of operations, financial condition and stock price. The Company currently holds a significant number of patents, trademarks and copyrights and has registered, and applied to register, additional patents, trademarks and copyrights. In contrast, many of the Company’s competitors seek to compete primarily through aggressive pricing and very low cost structures, and by imitating the Company’s products and infringing on its intellectual property. Effective intellectual property protection is not consistently available in every country in which the Company operates. If the Company is unable to continue to develop and sell innovative new products with attractive margins or if competitors infringe on the Company’s intellectual property, the Company’s ability to maintain a competitive advantage could be materially adversely affected. The Company’s products and services face substantial competition from companies that have significant technical, marketing, distribution and other resources, as well as established hardware, software and service offerings. In addition, the Company faces significant competition as competitors imitate the Company’s product features and applications within their products to offer more competitive solutions. The Company also expects competition to intensify as competitors imitate the Company’s approach to providing components seamlessly within their offerings or work collaboratively to offer integrated solutions. Some of the Company’s competitors have broad product lines, low-priced products, large installed bases of active devices, and large customer bases. Competition has been particularly intense as competitors have aggressively cut prices and lowered product margins. Certain competitors have the resources, experience or cost structures to provide products and services at little or no profit or even at a loss. The Company has a minority market share in the global smartphone, personal computer, tablet and wearables markets, and some of the markets in which the Company competes have from time to time experienced little to no growth or contracted overall. If the Company is unable to compete successfully, its business, reputation, results of operations, financial condition and stock price can be materially adversely affected.

[AAPL 10-K period 2025] Trade and other international disputes can have an adverse impact on the overall macroeconomic environment and result in shifts and reductions in consumer spending and negative consumer sentiment for the Company’s products and services, all of which can further adversely affect the Company’s business and results of operations. Business Risks

To remain competitive and stimulate customer demand, the Company must successfully manage frequent introductions and transitions of products and services. Due to the highly volatile and competitive nature of the markets and industries in which the Company competes, the Company must continually introduce new products, services and technologies, enhance existing products and services, effectively stimulate customer demand for new and upgraded products and services, navigate global regulatory requirements and barriers to market access, and successfully manage the transition to these new and upgraded products and services. The success of new product and service introductions depends on a number of factors, including the Company’s ability to recruit and retain highly skilled personnel to execute on its strategic initiatives, and the timely and successful development and market acceptance of new products, services and technologies. Success also relies on the Company’s ability to manage the risks associated with new technologies and production ramp-up issues, the effective integration of third-party services and technologies into the Company’s products and services, the availability, delivery and performance of application software or other third-party support for the Company’s products and services, the effective management of manufacturing and other purchase commitments and the management of inventory levels in line with anticipated product demand, and the availability of products in appropriate quantities and at expected costs to meet anticipated demand. Additionally, quality issues or other defects or deficiencies can adversely affect the success of new product and service introductions and market acceptance. New products, services and technologies may replace or supersede existing offerings and may produce lower revenues and lower profit margins. The Company may not be able to successfully manage future introductions and transitions of products and services, which can materially adversely affect the Company’s business, reputation, results of operations, financial condition and stock price. The Company depends on component and product manufacturing and logistical services provided by outsourcing partners, many of which are located outside of the U.S. A significant majority of the Company’s manufacturing is performed in whole or in part by outsourcing partners located primarily in China mainland, India, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and Vietnam, in addition to sourcing from partners and facilities located in the U.S. The Company relies on single-source partners in the U.S., Asia and Europe to supply and manufacture many components, and on partners primarily located in Asia, for final assembly of substantially all of the Company’s hardware products. The Company has also outsourced much of its transportation and logistics management.

[AAPL 10-K period 2025] Although most components essential to the Company’s business are generally available from multiple sources, certain components are currently obtained from single or limited sources. The Company also competes for various components with other participants in the markets for smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and accessories. Therefore, many components used by the Company, including those that are available from multiple sources, are at times subject to industry-wide shortage and significant commodity pricing fluctuations. Restrictions on international trade can increase the cost or limit the availability of the Company’s products and the components and rare earths and other raw materials that go into them. The Company uses some custom components that are not commonly used by its competitors, and new products introduced by the Company often utilize custom components available from only one source. When a component or product uses new technologies, initial capacity constraints may exist until the suppliers’ yields have matured or their manufacturing capacities have increased. The Company has entered into agreements for the supply of many components; however, the Company may not be able to extend or renew agreements for the supply of components on similar terms, or at all, and may not be successful in obtaining sufficient quantities from its suppliers or in a timely manner, or in identifying and obtaining sufficient quantities from an alternative source. In addition, component suppliers may fail, be subject to consolidation within a particular industry, or decide to concentrate on the production of common components instead of components customized to meet the Company’s requirements, further limiting the Company’s ability to obtain sufficient quantities of components on commercially reasonable terms, or at all. Research and Development

Because the industries in which the Company competes are characterized by rapid technological advances, the Company’s ability to compete successfully depends heavily upon its ability to ensure a continual and timely flow of competitive products, services and technologies to the marketplace. The Company continues to develop new technologies to enhance existing products and services, and to expand the range of its offerings through research and development (“R&D”), licensing of intellectual property and acquisition of third-party businesses and technology. Intellectual Property

The Company currently holds a broad collection of intellectual property rights relating to certain aspects of its hardware, software and services. This includes patents, designs, copyrights, trademarks, trade secrets and other forms of intellectual property rights in the U.S. and various foreign countries. Although the Company believes the ownership of such intellectual property rights is an important factor in differentiating its business and that its success does depend in part on such ownership, the Company relies primarily on the innovative skills, technical competence and marketing abilities of its personnel. The Company regularly files patent, design, copyright and trademark applications to protect innovations arising from its hardware, software and service research, development, design and marketing, and is currently pursuing thousands of applications around the world. Over time, the Company has accumulated a large portfolio of issued and registered intellectual property rights around the world. No single intellectual property right is solely responsible for protecting the Company’s products and services. The Company believes the duration of its intellectual property rights is adequate relative to the expected lives of its products and services. Apple Inc. | 2025 Form 10-K | 3

records.query: Apple 的第三方開發者生態系相對於 Android、Windows 等平台的黏著度是如何建立的？
records.answer:
根據提供的參考資料，我沒有足夠的資訊來直接比較 Apple、Android 與 Windows 平台之間的第三方開發者生態系黏著度，因為資料中並未包含 Android 平台的相關資訊，也沒有直接針對這三個平台進行開發者生態系黏著度的比較。不過，參考資料確實提供了 Apple 與 Microsoft (Windows/Xbox) 個別生態系與用戶基礎的相關細節，以下分別說明：

**Apple 的生態系與用戶基礎**
Apple 透過其龐大的硬體裝置與高毛利服務生態系來建立用戶與開發者的黏著度。Apple 向全球約十億付費用戶銷售 iPhone、Mac、iPad、穿戴式裝置及不斷增長的訂閱服務 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4]。其服務收入（包含 App Store、廣告、iCloud、Apple Music、Apple TV+ 與支付服務）佔總收入的 28%，且上季度達到 310 億美元的歷史新高，年增 16% [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4]。Apple 的活躍裝置安裝基數在所有產品類別與地區均創下歷史新高，這龐大的用戶群為開發者提供了極具吸引力的市場基礎 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4]。此外，Apple 持續加大研發投入，上季度研發支出年增 34% 至 114 億美元，並積極佈局 AI 基礎設施 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4]。

**Microsoft 的生態系與合作夥伴網絡**
Microsoft 則透過 OEM 預裝、大量授權方案以及 Xbox 遊戲生態系來建立其平台黏著度。在 Windows 作業系統方面，Microsoft 透過與 Dell、HP、Lenovo 等幾乎所有跨國 OEM 廠商簽訂直接協議，將軟體預裝在新設備上，擴大平台覆蓋率 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #61]。針對企業用戶，Microsoft 提供多種大量授權方案（如 Enterprise Agreement、Microsoft Customer Agreement 等），讓不同規模的組織能彈性購買雲端服務與軟體授權 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #61]。在遊戲領域，Microsoft 的 Xbox 生態系透過第一方與第三方工作室創造獨特的遊戲體驗，並以 Xbox Game Pass 訂閱服務為核心，讓玩家能在 Xbox 主機、Windows 設備與其他裝置上連線與分享遊戲體驗 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #57]。Microsoft 也透過 Xbox 生態系為開發者與合作夥伴提供龐大的客戶群，並專注於拓展平台與新生態系以吸引更多玩家 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #57]。

**資料缺口說明**
提供的參考資料中未包含任何關於 Android 平台第三方開發者生態系的資訊，也沒有直接比較 Apple、Android 與 Windows 三個平台在開發者生態系黏著度上的量化指標或質化評估。

[MSFT 10-K period 2025] •Piracy. We design and sell devices, such as Surface (including Copilot+ PCs) and PC accessories. Our devices are designed to enable people and organizations to connect to the people and content that matter most using Windows and integrated Microsoft products and services. Surface is designed to help organizations, students, and consumers be more productive. Growth in Devices is dependent on total PC shipments, the ability to attract new customers, our product roadmap, and expanding into new categories. Gaming

Microsoft is expanding how billions of people globally access and play video games on PC, console, mobile, and cloud. Our game content is developed through a collection of first-party studios creating iconic and differentiated gaming experiences. We continue to invest in gaming studios and content to expand our intellectual property roadmap and leverage new content creators. These unique gaming experiences are the cornerstone of Xbox Game Pass, a subscription service and gaming community with access to a curated library of first- and third-party titles. The gamer remains at the heart of the Xbox ecosystem. We are identifying new opportunities to attract gamers across a variety of different end points through our first- and third-party content and business diversification across subscriptions, ads, and digital stores. We’ve seen new devices from third-party manufacturers along with key PC and mobile end points that help us empower gamers to play in a way that is most convenient to them. We are focused on growing the platform and expanding to new ecosystems to engage as many gamers as possible. Xbox enables people to connect and share online gaming experiences that are accessible on Xbox consoles, Windows-enabled devices, and other devices. Xbox is designed to benefit users by providing access to a network of certified applications and services and to benefit our developer and partner ecosystems by providing access to a large customer base. Xbox revenue is mainly affected by subscriptions and sales of first- and third-party content, as well as advertising. Growth of our Gaming business is determined by the overall active user base through Xbox enabled content, availability of games, providing exclusive game content that gamers seek, the computational power and reliability of the devices used to access our content and services, and the ability to create new experiences. Search and News Advertising

Our Search and news advertising business is designed to deliver relevant search, native, and display advertising to a global audience. Microsoft Copilot is a digital companion designed to inform, entertain, and inspire. Our Microsoft Edge browser and Bing search engine with Copilot are key tools to enable user acquisition and engagement, while our technology platform enables accelerated delivery of digital advertising solutions. In addition to first-party tools, we have several partnerships with companies through which we provide and monetize search offerings.

[MSFT 10-K period 2025] Individual consumers obtain these products primarily through retail outlets. We distribute our devices through third-party retailers. We have a network of field sales representatives and field support personnel that solicit orders from distributors and resellers and provide product training and sales support. Our Dynamics business solutions are also licensed to enterprises through a global network of channel partners providing vertical solutions and specialized services. OEMs 

We distribute our products and services through OEMs that pre-install our software on new devices and servers they sell. The largest component of the OEM business is the Windows operating system pre-installed on devices. OEMs also sell devices pre-installed with other Microsoft products and services, including applications such as Office and the capability to subscribe to Microsoft 365 Consumer. There are two broad categories of OEMs. The largest category of OEMs are direct OEMs as our relationship with them is managed through a direct agreement between Microsoft and the OEM. We have distribution agreements covering one or more of our products with virtually all the multinational OEMs, including Dell, Hewlett-Packard, Lenovo, and with many regional and local OEMs. The second broad category of OEMs are system builders consisting of lower-volume PC manufacturers, which source Microsoft software for pre-installation and local redistribution primarily through the Microsoft distributor channel rather than through a direct agreement or relationship with Microsoft. LICENSING OPTIONS 

We offer options for organizations of varying sizes that want to purchase our cloud services and on-premises software. We license these organizations under volume licensing agreements to allow the customer to acquire multiple licenses of products and services instead of having to acquire separate licenses through retail channels. These volume licensing programs have varying programmatic requirements and benefits to best meet the needs of our customers. Software Assurance (“SA”) conveys rights to new software and upgrades for perpetual licenses released over the contract period. It also provides support, tools, training, and other licensing benefits to help customers deploy and use software efficiently. SA is required to be purchased with certain volume licensing agreements and is an optional purchase with others. Volume Licensing Programs

Enterprise Agreement 

Enterprise Agreements offer large organizations a manageable volume licensing program that gives them the flexibility to buy cloud services and software licenses under one agreement. Enterprise Agreements are designed for medium or large organizations that want to license Microsoft products and services organization-wide over a three-year period. Organizations can elect to purchase perpetual licenses (covered with SA) and/or subscribe to cloud services. Microsoft Customer Agreement

Microsoft Customer Agreements are simplified purchase agreements presented, accepted, and stored through a digital experience. Microsoft Customer Agreements are non-expiring agreements that are designed to support all customers over time, whether purchasing through a partner or directly from Microsoft. Microsoft Online Subscription Agreement

Microsoft Online Subscription Agreements are designed for small and medium organizations that want to subscribe to, activate, provision, and maintain cloud services seamlessly and directly via the web. These agreements allow customers to acquire monthly or annual subscriptions for cloud-based services. Microsoft Products and Services Agreement 

Microsoft Products and Services Agreements are designed for medium and large organizations that want to license cloud services and on-premises software as needed, with no organization-wide commitment, under a single, non-expiring agreement. Organizations purchase perpetual licenses or subscribe to licenses. SA is optional for customers that purchase perpetual licenses. Open Value

Open Value agreements are a simple, cost-effective way to acquire the latest Microsoft technology. These agreements are designed for small and medium organizations that want to license cloud services and on-premises software over a three-year period. Under Open Value agreements, organizations can elect to purchase perpetual licenses or subscribe to licenses and SA is included. Select Plus 

A Select Plus agreement is designed for government and academic organizations to acquire on-premises licenses at any affiliate or department level, while realizing advantages as one organization. Organizations purchase perpetual licenses and SA is optional. Partner Programs 

The Microsoft Cloud Solution Provider Program offers customers an easy way to license the cloud services they need in combination with the value-added services offered by their systems integrator, managed services provider, or cloud reseller partner. Partners in this program can easily package their own products and services to directly provision, manage, and support their customer subscriptions. The Microsoft Services Provider License Agreement allows hosting service providers and independent software vendors who want to license eligible Microsoft software products to provide hosted applications and software services to their end customers. Partners license software over a three-year period and are billed monthly based on units licensed. The Independent Software Vendor Royalty Program enables partners to integrate Microsoft products into other applications and then license the unified business solution to their end users. GOVERNMENT REGULATION 

We are subject to a wide range of laws, regulations, and legal requirements in the U.S.

Our Opinion 7/10
Apple’s quarter was a genuine surprise to the upside, and the company’s cash generation remains in a league of its own. The dividend hike and fresh $100 billion buyback give investors a tangible return floor. But the stock isn’t cheap. At 33.5x forward earnings with sub-10% forward revenue growth, you’re paying a quality premium that leaves little room for an iPhone stumble or a tariff escalation. For long-term holders, Apple stays a core position.

[AAPL] The Board authorized another $100 billion buyback and raised the dividend 4%. Search volume from financial pros spiked, with Apple drawing nearly 21,000 searches in the past month, per our TrackStar data, more than its next four hardware peers combined. So is the run sustainable, or did Apple just front-load demand ahead of more tariff drama? Apple’s Business
Apple needs no introduction, but the company’s transformation does. What was once a hardware story is now a hybrid: $80.2 billion in product sales last quarter alongside $31.0 billion in high-margin services. The installed base of active devices hit another all-time high across every product category and every geography. Apple sells iPhones, Macs, iPads, wearables, and a growing suite of subscription services to roughly a billion paying users globally. Apple segments its business into the following areas:
iPhone (51% of total revenues)
– Flagship smartphone line, recently expanded with the iPhone 17 lineup and a new iPhone 17e
Services (28% of total revenues)
– App Store, advertising, iCloud, Apple Music, Apple TV+, and payment services
Mac (8% of total revenues)
– Laptops and desktops, including the newly launched MacBook Neo
Wearables, Home & Accessories (7% of total revenues)
– AirPods, Apple Watch, Vision Pro, and accessories
iPad (6% of total revenues)
– Tablet lineup, recently refreshed with the M4-powered iPad Air
iPhone revenue jumped 22% to $57.0 billion, the standout of the quarter. Services climbed 16% to a record $31.0 billion, propelled by advertising, App Store, and cloud. Greater China rebounded sharply, with renminbi strength adding fuel. Tim Cook called demand for the iPhone 17 lineup “extraordinary.”
On the strategic front, Apple is going all-in on AI infrastructure. R&D spending jumped 34% year-over-year to $11.4 billion last quarter, citing higher infrastructure costs. Tariff overhang remains real but manageable. A February Supreme Court ruling struck down certain tariffs, and Apple is applying for refunds. The company also flagged that semiconductor, NAND, and DRAM supply constraints could pressure costs into the next quarter. Story Continues

records.query: Microsoft More Personal Computing 部門最新一季營收表現如何？哪些因素互相抵銷？
records.answer:
Microsoft 最新一季（截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的三個月）More Personal Computing 部門營收為 131.92 億美元，較去年同期微幅下滑 1%，呈現幾近持平的表現，主因是遊戲業務的衰退與搜尋廣告的成長互相抵銷 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104]。

以下為各項抵銷因素的詳細說明：

**1. 營收下滑因素：遊戲業務衰退**
遊戲營收減少 11 億美元，降幅為 6%，主要原因是 Xbox 硬體與 Xbox 內容及服務的雙雙衰退 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #111]。其中，Xbox 硬體營收因主機銷量下滑而大減 31%；Xbox 內容及服務營收也因去年同期受惠於強勁的第一方內容表現而形成高基期，衰退了 3%，這部分僅部分被 Xbox Game Pass 的成長所抵銷 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #111]。

**2. 營收成長因素：搜尋廣告與 Windows OEM**
搜尋廣告營收增加 10 億美元，增幅達 10% [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #111]。同時，Windows and Devices 營收微幅成長，Windows OEM and Devices 營收增長 2%，主要受 Windows OEM 成長 8% 所帶動（庫存水準仍偏高），但部分被 Devices（裝置）的下滑所抵銷 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #111]。

整體而言，More Personal Computing 部門的營收變動率為 -1%（由去年同期的 133.71 億美元降至本季的 131.92 億美元），反映搜尋廣告與 Windows OEM 的正向貢獻大致被遊戲業務的衰退所抵消 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104]。

records.query: Microsoft 最新一季整體營業利益成長多少？主要由哪些部門帶動？
records.answer:
Microsoft 最新一季（2026 會計年度第三季，截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止三個月）整體營業利益成長 20%，增加 64 億美元，主要由 Productivity and Business Processes 及 Intelligent Cloud 兩個部門帶動 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #102]。

以下為支撐細節：

**整體數字：** 該季營業利益從去年同期的 320.0 億美元增至 383.98 億美元，增幅為 64 億美元或 20% [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104]。營業利益包含約 3% 的有利外匯影響 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #102]。

**主要驅動部門：**

1. **Productivity and Business Processes（生產力與業務流程）：** 營業利益從 173.79 億美元增至 209.73 億美元，成長 21%，增加 35.94 億美元 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104]。該部門營收成長 17%（增加 51 億美元），主要受 Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud 帶動，其中 Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud 營收成長 18%，受益於每用戶營收成長（由 Microsoft 365 E5 與 Microsoft 365 Copilot 驅動）以及持續的商用席位增長 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #109]。

2. **Intelligent Cloud（智慧雲端）：** 營業利益從 110.95 億美元增至 137.53 億美元，成長 24%，增加 26.58 億美元 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104]。該部門營收成長 30%（增加 81 億美元），主要受 Azure 驅動 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #102]。

3. **More Personal Computing（更多個人運算）：** 該部門營業利益僅小幅成長 4%，從 35.26 億美元增至 36.72 億美元，營收則下降 1%，因 Devices 與 Gaming 硬體銷售下滑，僅部分被 Search advertising 成長抵銷 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104][MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #102]。

records.query: Amazon AWS 部門最新一季營業利益成長的主要驅動因素是什麼？
records.answer:
AWS 部門最新一季（2026 年第一季）營業利益從去年同期的 115.47 億美元增至 141.61 億美元，主要驅動因素是客戶使用量增加帶動的銷售成長，但部分被支援 AWS 業務成長的技術基礎設施投資所抵消 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #79]。

具體而言，AWS Q1 2026 銷售額從去年同期的 292.67 億美元增至 375.87 億美元，年增 28%，反映客戶使用量增加，但部分被長期客戶合約驅動的定價變化所抵消 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #74]。營業利益方面，AWS 從 115.47 億美元增至 141.61 億美元，成長主要來自銷售增加，但部分被技術基礎設施支出所抵消，該支出主要為支援 AWS 業務成長的額外投資 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #79]。此外，外匯匯率變動對 AWS 營業利益產生 3.39 億美元的負面影響 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #79]。

agentic_sub_queries: Amazon AWS 部門最新一季營業利益成長的主要驅動因素是什麼？

records.query: Google Cloud 部門最新一季的營收成長多少？
records.answer:
Google Cloud 最新一季（2026年第二季，截至6月30日）的營收為 $24.8 billion，較去年同期的 $13.6 billion 增加了 $11.1 billion [GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #47]。成長的主要動能來自 Google Cloud Platform 的基礎建設與平台服務 [GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #47]。此外，Google Cloud 在2026年第二季開始認列 TPU 系統銷售的營收 [GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #47]。

若看2026年第一季（截至3月31日），Google Cloud 營收為 $20.0 billion，較去年同期的 $12.3 billion 增加了 $7.8 billion，年增幅為63% [GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #35]。同樣由 Google Cloud Platform 的基礎建設與平台服務所推動 [GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #42]。

**關於忠實度稽核的說明：** 原答案中提到的「年增率約為81.5%」是自行計算的數值，來源材料中並未明確揭露該百分比，因此已予刪除。而「增加了 $11.1 billion」及「第二季開始認列 TPU 系統銷售營收」兩項陳述確實有來源支持，已保留並附上引用。

records.query: Google 收購 Wiz 花了多少錢？這如何影響 Google Cloud 部門？
records.answer:
Google 以 295 億美元（29.5 billion）完成了對 Wiz 的收購，這項交易被納入 Google Cloud 部門，旨在加速 Google Cloud 在多雲和 AI 驅動安全領域的能力 [GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #77]。

**收購金額與背景**

- 2025 年 3 月，Google 母公司 Alphabet 簽訂了收購 Wiz 的最終協議，當時公告的收購價格為 320 億美元（32.0 billion），為全現金交易，預計於 2026 年完成交割 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #182]。
- 2026 年 3 月 11 日，Google 正式完成收購 Wiz，最終交易金額為 295 億美元（29.5 billion），此金額為購買價格調整後的金額，且不包含合併後的薪酬安排 [GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #77]。

**對 Google Cloud 部門的影響**

- **財務報表合併**：收購完成後，Wiz 的財務結果被納入 Alphabet 的合併財務報表中的 Google Cloud 部門 [GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78]。
- **收購價格分配**：根據 2026 年第二季度的 10-Q 報告，294.67 億美元的初步購買價格被分配如下：無形資產 83 億美元、商譽 227.05 億美元、承擔的淨負債 -15.38 億美元 [GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #94]。
- **商譽歸屬與性質**：商譽被記錄在 Google Cloud 部門內，主要歸因於預期收購後將產生的協同效應，且該商譽不可作為稅務扣除 [GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #94]。
- **戰略意義**：此次收購代表 Google Cloud 的一項投資，目的是加速其在多雲和 AI 驅動安全方面的能力 [GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #77]。

records.query: Meta 最新一季總營收成長多少？主要驅動因素是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 最新一季（2025 年第三季）總營收為 514.24 億美元，較 2024 年同期成長 26%，主要驅動因素是廣告營收的成長 [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #203]。

以下是支撐細節：

**營收與成長率**
- 2025 年第三季總營收為 514.24 億美元，2024 年第三季為 405.89 億美元，成長 26% [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #0] [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #203]。
- 若以固定匯率計算，營收成長率為 25% [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #203]。

**主要驅動因素：廣告營收成長**
- 營收成長的主因是廣告營收增加 [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #203]。
- 廣告曝光量（ad impressions）較去年同期成長 14%，平均廣告價格（average price per ad）較去年同期成長 10% [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #203]。

**各分部表現**
- Family of Apps（FoA）分部營收從 2024 年第三季的 403.19 億美元增至 2025 年第三季的 507.72 億美元，成長 26% [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #203]。
- Reality Labs（RL）分部營收從 2024 年第三季的 2.70 億美元增至 2025 年第三季的 4.70 億美元，成長 74% [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #203]。

**各地區營收成長**
- 2025 年第三季，美國與加拿大地區營收成長 24%，歐洲成長 29%，亞太地區成長 25%，其餘地區（Rest of World）成長 32%，均相對於 2024 年同期 [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #211]。

**營業利益與成本**
- 2025 年第三季營業利益為 205.35 億美元，較 2024 年同期的 173.50 億美元增加 31.80 億美元，成長 18%，主要受廣告營收增加帶動，但部分被成本與費用的增加所抵消 [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #203]。
- 成本與費用的增加主要來自員工薪酬、基礎設施成本及法律相關成本的上升 [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #203]。

RL revenue in 2025 increased $61 million, or 3%, compared to 2024. The increase was driven by an increase in sales of AI glasses, partially offset by a decrease in Meta Quest sales. Revenue Seasonality

Revenue is traditionally seasonally strong in the fourth quarter of each year due in part to seasonal holiday demand. We believe that this seasonality in both advertising revenue and RL consumer hardware sales affects our quarterly results, which generally reflect significant growth in revenue between the third and fourth quarters and a decline between the fourth and subsequent first quarters. records.query: Apple iPhone 營收成長主要是由哪些機型帶動的？
records.answer:
Apple iPhone 營收成長主要是由 **Pro 機型** 的更高銷售所帶動的。

根據資料，Apple 在 2026 會計年度第一季（截至 2025 年 12 月 27 日的三個月）與第二季（截至 2026 年 3 月 28 日的三個月）均明確指出，iPhone 營收較去年同期成長的原因是 Pro 機型銷量增加 [AAPL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #66] [AAPL_10Q_202512.html, chunk #53]。

進一步來看，前六個月（截至 2026 年 3 月 28 日）的累計數據也顯示相同趨勢，iPhone 淨銷售額從 1,159.79 億美元增至 1,422.63 億美元（成長 23%），同樣歸因於 Pro 機型的更高淨銷售額 [AAPL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #66]。

此外，回顧 2025 會計年度的年度數據（截至 2025 年 9 月），iPhone 淨銷售額從 2,011.83 億美元增至 2,095.86 億美元（成長 4%），成長動力同樣來自 Pro 機型的更高銷售 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #155]。

**補充說明：** 提供的參考資料僅涵蓋 2026 會計年度前兩季（第一季與第二季，即前六個月）的數據，並未包含第三季的相關資料。

records.query: NVIDIA 最新一季資料中心（Data Center）營收成長多少？主要驅動產品是什麼？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 最新一季（FY2027 Q1，截至 2026 年 4 月 26 日）資料中心營收為 752.46 億美元，較去年同期（FY2026 Q1 的 391.12 億美元）成長 92%，並較前一季（623.14 億美元）成長 21% [NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #47]。

主要驅動產品與技術如下：

1. **Blackwell 300 產品的量產爬坡（ramp）**：該季資料中心營收的成長是受到 Blackwell 300 產品爬坡的帶動 [NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #47]。

2. **網路與連接解決方案**：InfiniBand、Spectrum-X Ethernet 以及 NVLink 解決方案的需求同樣推動了資料中心營收的成長 [NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #47]。

3. **客戶結構組成**：在資料中心營收中，Hyperscale 營收約佔 50%，其餘 50% 來自持續多元化的客戶群，包括 AI Clouds、工業、企業及 sovereign customers [NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #47]。

4. **中國出貨狀況**：本季並未向中國出貨任何 Data Center Hopper 產品，作為對比，在 FY2026 第一季度此類出貨金額為 46 億美元 [NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #47]。

agentic_sub_queries: NVIDIA 最新一季資料中心營收成長多少？
NVIDIA 最新一季資料中心的主要驅動產品是什麼？

records.query: NVIDIA 這一季在中國市場的資料中心晶片出貨狀況如何？跟去年同期相比有何變化？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 本季（2026 財年第三季，截至 2025 年 10 月 26 日）來自中國（含香港）的營收為 29.73 億美元，較去年同期的 81.42 億美元顯著下降 [NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #42]。以下為具體數據與細節：

**單季中國營收對比：** 2026 財年第三季中國（含香港）營收為 29.73 億美元，而 2025 財年第三季（截至 2024 年 10 月 27 日）為 81.42 億美元 [NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #42]。

**前九個月累計中國營收對比：** 2026 財年前九個月，中國累計營收為 166.17 億美元，去年同期為 172.30 億美元，同樣呈現年減趨勢 [NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #42]。

**中國營收佔比變化：** 從佔總營收比重來看，中國市場的佔比明顯縮小。2026 財年第三季中國營收佔總營收 57,006 億美元中的約 5.2%，而 2025 財年第三季佔比約為 23.2% [NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #42]。相對之下，美國市場營收佔比大幅攀升，從去年同期的 196.20 億美元增至本季的 391.77 億美元 [NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #42]。

**全年趨勢：** 2026 財年全年（截至 2026 年 1 月 25 日）中國營收為 196.77 億美元，低於 2025 財年全年的 250.48 億美元 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #210]。NVIDIA 在 10-K 中指出，美國營收的增長主要歸因於美國本土運算與網路區段需求的增加 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #210]。

**與中國市場相關的庫存費用：** NVIDIA 在 2026 財年第一季認列了一筆 45 億美元的費用，與 H20 過剩庫存及採購義務相關，這筆費用被計入運算與網路區段的營業利益中 [NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #53]。此外，2026 財年前九個月的庫存撥備總額為 36 億美元，高於去年同期的 8.76 億美元 [NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #28]。

**補充說明：** 上述營收數據是依客戶總部所在地進行地理分類的結果。NVIDIA 在 2026 財年第三季改採此分類方式，認為能更好地反映營收的地理分佈，並已重述前期數據 [NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #42]。值得注意的是，台灣總部客戶的資料中心營收中，約 86% 最終歸屬於美國和歐洲的終端客戶 [NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #42]，因此按總部所在地分類的中國營收數字可能未完全反映終端使用者的實際地理分佈。

records.query: Tesla 汽車銷售營收最新一季成長多少？主要驅動因素是什麼？
records.answer:
Tesla 最新可取得「汽車銷售（Automotive sales）」單項數據的季度為 2026 年第一季（Q1），該季汽車銷售營收較去年同期增加 25.48 億美元，成長幅度為 20%，主要驅動因素為車輛交付量增加及平均售價上升 [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #63]。

**營收變動金額與幅度**

- 2026 年第一季，Automotive sales 較 2025 年第一季增加 25.48 億美元，成長 20% [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #63]。
- 同一季度的 Automotive regulatory credits 減少 2.15 億美元（-36%），Automotive leasing 減少 0.66 億美元（-15%），合計 Total automotive revenues 增加 22.67 億美元（+16%）[TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #63]。

**主要驅動因素**

1. **交付量增加**：現金交付量較去年同期成長約 10%，部分原因是去年同期所有車廠同時停產進行 New Model Y 改裝，使比較基期較低 [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #63]。

2. **平均售價上升**：每單位平均售價提高，主要受銷售組合（sales mix）以及美元相對外幣貶值帶來的正向影響 [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #63]。

**補充說明**

2026 年第二季（Q2）的財報中僅揭露「Automotive Revenues」總計為 205.16 億美元（去年同期為 166.61 億美元），但未將其進一步拆分為「Automotive sales」、「Automotive regulatory credits」及「Automotive leasing」等細項 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #0]。因此，第二季「汽車銷售（Automotive sales）」的單項金額與其年增率在來源中無法確認。

records.query: 關於 NVIDIA 賣 AI 晶片到中國，最近有什麼消息？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 執行長黃仁勳預期中國市場將「隨時間推移」逐步開放給美國高階 AI 晶片，但目前中國科技公司並未採購 NVIDIA 的 H200 晶片，且北京正加速發展本土晶片以挑戰美國在該領域的主導地位 [NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #0]。

以下是具體細節：

**H200 晶片已獲准銷往中國，但無採購跡象**
H200 晶片此前因美國國家安全考量被禁止在中國銷售，如今已獲得銷售許可 [NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #0]。然而，黃仁勳表示，他上週隨美國總統川普出訪中國時，並未與北京高層官員討論 H200 的銷售事宜 [NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #0]。目前也沒有跡象顯示中國科技公司正在購買 H200 [NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #0]。

**川普曾表示與習近平達成放寬 H200 限制的協議**
川普在 12 月表示已與習近平達成協議，將放寬對 H200 晶片的限制，但部分美國國會議員警告此舉可能幫助中國軍方 [NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #1]。

**最高階產品仍遭禁售**
NVIDIA 最頂級的 Blackwell 系列及即將推出的 Rubin 系列仍被禁止在中國銷售 [NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #1]。

**中國聚焦自主研發，市場開放存變數**
投資者原本希望習近平能允許 NVIDIA 進口更多晶片，但川普告訴記者，中國正專注於發展自己的 AI 處理器 [NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #1]。黃仁勳指出，中國政府必須決定要保護多少本地市場，他認為市場「隨時間推移」會開放 [NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #1]。習近平則向美國企業高層代表團表示，中國將向世界「更加開放」[NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #1]。

**競爭壓力加劇**
除了中國市場的不確定性，NVIDIA 在 AI 晶片領域也面臨日益激烈的競爭，包括來自 AMD 的競爭，以及亞馬遜和 Google 等客戶向第三方提供自家 AI 晶片 [NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4]。

records.query: 微軟最近在 AI 策略上有什麼新消息，分析師怎麼看？
records.answer:
微軟最近在 AI 策略上最重要的新進展是：公司開始建立七個自研 AI 模型，專注於微調與成本優化，藉此降低對外部前沿實驗室的依賴，分析師對此持正面看法——TD Cowen 在 2026 年 6 月 4 日重申對微軟的「買入」評級，並設定 540 美元的目標價 [MSFT_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。

以下從幾個面向進一步說明：

**自研 AI 模型與基礎設施佈局**

微軟在 Build 2026 大會上展示了其 AI 平台的最新進展，並已將大量 GPU 算力分配給內部研發團隊，標誌著其 AI 組合策略進入新階段 [MSFT_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。公司也重申了協助客戶部署 AI 代理（AI agents）的計畫，並正在打造自己的 OpenClaw 版本 [MSFT_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。

**AI 投資對財務表現的影響**

微軟對 AI 基礎設施的持續投資正在影響其毛利率。在 FY2025（截至 2025 年 6 月的會計年度），Microsoft Cloud 毛利率下降至 69%，主因是擴展 AI 基礎設施的影響，但部分被 Azure 的效率提升所抵消 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #143]。在 FY2026 Q2（截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的三個月），Microsoft Cloud 毛利率進一步下降至 67%，同樣受到 AI 基礎設施投資及 AI 產品使用量增長的驅動，部分被 Azure 及 Microsoft 365 商業雲端的效率提升所抵消 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #105]。

**Azure 與雲端增長**

在 FY2025，Intelligent Cloud 收入增長 21% 至 1,062.65 億美元，其中 Azure 及其他雲端服務收入增長 34%，受其服務組合需求推動 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #143]。在 FY2026 上半年（截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的六個月），Intelligent Cloud 收入增長 29%，其中 Azure 及其他雲端服務收入增長 40%，涵蓋所有工作負載的持續增長 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #109]。

**OpenAI 投資的損益波動**

微軟對 OpenAI 的投資對其淨利產生了顯著影響。在截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的三個月內，來自 OpenAI 投資的淨收益使淨利潤增加了 76 億美元，稀釋每股盈餘增加了 1.02 美元；而去年同期則因 OpenAI 投資的淨虧損，導致淨利潤減少 9.39 億美元、每股盈餘減少 0.12 美元 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #105]。

**AI 治理與生態系風險**

隨著生成式 AI 的普及，企業對資料治理的關注度提高。與微軟生態系關係密切的 AvePoint 執行長指出，AI 代理的興起引發了對「影子 AI」（shadow AI）及基於 token 的成本管理的擔憂，企業需要更謹慎地管理 AI 部署的成本與風險 [MSFT_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #1]。此外，美國關稅政策與 AI 出口管制（如 AI Diffusion Rule）也可能增加微軟的營運成本並造成產品持續性的不確定性 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #110]。

Asked about investor concerns over Microsoft concentration, Jiang said AvePoint has operated in the Microsoft ecosystem for more than 20 years but does not depend on Microsoft as a reseller. He said Microsoft does not resell AvePoint’s products, and AvePoint helps customers complete “last mile” adoption of workloads such as Purview, E5 and Copilot. Jiang said AvePoint is also active in the Google, Salesforce and AWS ecosystems as customers become increasingly multi-cloud. He said AvePoint is complementary to hyperscalers because it helps customers manage different license types and workloads across multiple platforms. On Microsoft 365 backup, Jiang said Microsoft Office Cloud has roughly 400 million to 500 million user seats, while AvePoint covers “tens of millions” of seats and is not yet at 100 million. He said the company still sees room for growth, while also incorporating Microsoft’s Backup Express snapshot capability into its own backup stack. Jiang said many customers use a mix of license levels, noting that E5 penetration remains below 20% and Copilot penetration is about 5%, according to his comments. He said AvePoint helps customers maximize existing investments rather than pushing them toward the highest-cost licenses. Multi-Cloud Expansion and SaaS Model
Jiang said AvePoint expects non-Microsoft revenue to rise to more than 30% of its mix as the company pursues its goal of reaching $1 billion in annual recurring revenue. He said non-Microsoft revenue is currently less than 10%. He said the company already has product coverage across ecosystems including Google, Salesforce, Atlassian, ServiceNow and AWS, but go-to-market development takes time because each ecosystem has different partners and channels. Jiang also highlighted AvePoint’s SaaS-heavy model. He said 88% of revenue is recurring and that AvePoint runs on hyperscaler infrastructure across GCP, Azure, AWS and U.S. government data centers. He said hyperscaler contracts help shield AvePoint from hardware supply-chain shocks and pricing volatility. “We are a true SaaS company that’s asset light,” Jiang said. Control Suite and AgentPulse
Kessinger asked Jiang to clarify AvePoint’s role in governance and security. Jiang said the company’s roots in enterprise content management mean it manages the lifecycle of unstructured data, from ingestion, migration, classification and tagging to backup, ransomware recovery and governance. Jiang said these capabilities are increasingly important in the AI era because AI can accelerate access and data-management problems. He said AvePoint competes across areas that had previously been separate, including migration, backup, governance and data security posture management. Jiang also discussed AvePoint AgentPulse, which he said became generally available in the first quarter after a preview late last year. He said AgentPulse helps customers discover AI agents running across cloud environments such as Gemini and Copilot, control what systems and data they can access, monitor token consumption and shut agents down when needed. Jiang said AgentPulse is monetized through AvePoint’s “best” Control bundle and is helping increase Control deal sizes. He said Control represents about 40% of the company’s pipeline, compared with 26% of blended revenue contribution last year, while resiliency remains close to 60%. records.answer:
微软目前的自由现金流约为 **370亿美元**，这是根据基本面数据中列出的 Free Cash Flow 为 $37.01B [MSFT_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #1; MSFT_Fundamentals_20260508.txt, chunk #1; MSFT_Fundamentals_20260519.txt, chunk #1]。

以下为补充细节：

- **基本面数据中的自由现金流**：三份基本面文件均显示 Free Cash Flow 为 **$37.01B**，且 Total Cash 为 $78.23B，Total Debt 为 $125.43B [MSFT_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #1; MSFT_Fundamentals_20260508.txt, chunk #1; MSFT_Fundamentals_20260519.txt, chunk #1]。

- **从现金流量表推算的自由现金流（FCF = 经营现金流 − 资本支出）**：
  - **FY2025 全年（截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日）**：经营现金流为 $136,162M，资本支出为 $64,551M，推算自由现金流约为 **$71,611M** [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #2]。
  - **FY2026 Q2（截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的三个月）**：经营现金流为 $35,758M，资本支出为 $29,876M，推算自由现金流约为 **$5,882M** [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #2]。
  - **FY2025 Q2（截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日的三个月）**：经营现金流为 $22,291M，资本支出为 $15,804M，推算自由现金流约为 **$6,487M** [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #2]。
  - **FY2026 上半年（六个月，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日）**：经营现金流为 $80,815M，资本支出为 $49,270M，推算自由现金流约为 **$31,545M** [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #2]。

**需要注意的是**：基本面数据中直接给出的 $37.01B 自由现金流与从现金流量表推算的数字存在差异，可能反映不同的计算口径或时间区间。来源材料未说明基本面数据中 $37.01B 的具体计算方式或对应期间。

records.answer:
Amazon 在 2025 年的現金資本支出（cash capital expenditures）為 1,283 億美元（即 $128.3 billion），主要反映對技術基礎設施（其中大部分用於支援 AWS 業務成長）及履行網絡（fulfillment network）額外產能的投資，且公司預期 2026 年這兩項投資都將進一步增加 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #205]。

以下為補充細節：

- 作為對照，2024 年的現金資本支出為 777 億美元（$77.7 billion），2025 年較前一年大幅成長 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #205]。
- 現金流量表中「購置不動產及設備」（Purchases of property and equipment）科目顯示，2025 年全年為 $131,819 million（約 $131.8 billion），2024 年為 $82,999 million（約 $83.0 billion），2023 年為 $52,729 million（約 $52.7 billion）[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #56][AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #2]。
- 截至 2025 年前九個月（九個月期截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日），購置不動產及設備為 $92,297 million [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #27][AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #2]。

Our principal sources of liquidity are cash flows generated from operations and our cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities balances, which, at fair value, were $101.2 billion and $123.0 billion as of December 31, 2024 and 2025. Amounts held in foreign currencies were $25.5 billion and $29.7 billion as of December 31, 2024 and 2025. Our foreign currency balances include British Pounds, Canadian Dollars, Euros, Indian Rupees, and Japanese Yen. Cash provided by (used in) operating activities was $115.9 billion and $139.5 billion in 2024 and 2025. Our operating cash flows result primarily from cash received from our consumer, seller, developer, enterprise, and content creator customers, and advertisers, offset by cash payments we make for products and services, employee compensation, payment processing and related transaction costs, operating leases, and interest payments. Cash received from our customers and other activities generally corresponds to our net sales. The increase in operating cash flow in 2025, compared to the prior year, was due to an increase in net income (loss), excluding non-cash expenses, and changes in working capital. Working capital at any specific 

22


point in time is subject to many variables, including variability in demand, inventory management and category expansion, the timing of cash receipts and payments, customer and vendor payment terms, and fluctuations in foreign exchange rates. Cash provided by (used in) investing activities corresponds with cash capital expenditures, including leasehold improvements, incentives received from property and equipment vendors, proceeds from asset sales, cash outlays for acquisitions, investments in other companies and intellectual property rights, and purchases, sales, and maturities of marketable securities. Cash provided by (used in) investing activities was $(94.3) billion and $(142.5) billion in 2024 and 2025, with the variability caused primarily by purchases, sales, and maturities of marketable securities and cash capital expenditures. Cash capital expenditures were $77.7 billion, and $128.3 billion in 2024 and 2025, which primarily reflect investments in technology infrastructure (the majority of which is to support AWS business growth) and in additional capacity to support our fulfillment network, both of which we expect to increase in 2026. We made cash payments, net of acquired cash, related to acquisition and other investment activity of $7.1 billion and $3.8 billion in 2024 and 2025, which primarily reflect investments in convertible notes from Anthropic, PBC (“Anthropic”), including $2.7 billion we invested in 2025. Cash provided by (used in) financing activities was $(11.8) billion and $9.7 billion in 2024 and 2025. Cash inflows from financing activities resulted from proceeds from short-term debt, and other and long-term-debt of $5.1 billion and $25.0 billion in 2024 and 2025. Cash outflows from financing activities resulted from payments of short-term debt, and other, long-term debt, finance leases, and financing obligations of $17.0 billion and $15.3 billion in 2024 and 2025. Property and equipment acquired under finance leases was $854 million and $2.9 billion in 2024 and 2025. We had no borrowings outstanding under the two unsecured revolving credit facilities or the commercial paper programs as of December 31, 2025. See Item 8 of Part II, “Financial Statements and Supplementary Data — Note 6 — Debt” for additional information. As of December 31, 2025, cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities held by foreign subsidiaries were $7.1 billion. We intend to invest substantially all of our foreign subsidiary earnings, as well as our capital in our foreign subsidiaries, indefinitely outside of the U.S. in those jurisdictions in which we would incur significant, additional costs upon repatriation of such amounts.

[GOOGL 10-K period 2025] NOTES TO CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS

Note 1. Summary of Significant Accounting Policies

Nature of Operations

Google was incorporated in California in September 1998 and re-incorporated in the State of Delaware in August 2003. In 2015, we implemented a holding company reorganization, and as a result, Alphabet Inc. ("Alphabet") became the successor issuer to Google. We generate revenues by delivering relevant, cost-effective online advertising; cloud-based solutions that provide enterprise customers of all sizes with infrastructure, platform services, and applications; and sales of other products and services, such as fees received for subscription-based products, apps and in-app purchases, and devices. Basis of Consolidation

The consolidated financial statements of Alphabet include the accounts of Alphabet and entities consolidated under the variable interest and voting models. Intercompany balances and transactions have been eliminated. Use of Estimates

Preparation of consolidated financial statements in conformity with GAAP requires us to make estimates and assumptions that affect the amounts reported and disclosed in the financial statements and the accompanying notes. Actual results could differ materially from these estimates due to uncertainties. On an ongoing basis, we evaluate our estimates, including those related to the allowance for credit losses; contingent liabilities; fair values of financial instruments and goodwill; income taxes; inventory; and useful lives of property and equipment, among others. We base our estimates on assumptions, both historical and forward looking, that are believed to be reasonable, and the results of which form the basis for making judgments about the carrying values of assets and liabilities. Revenue Recognition

Revenues are recognized when control of the promised goods or services is transferred to our customers, and the collectibility of an amount that we expect in exchange for those goods or services is probable. Sales and other similar taxes are excluded from revenues. Google Advertising

Google advertising revenues consist of revenues from:

•Google Search and other properties, including revenues from traffic generated by search distribution partners who use Google.com as their default search in browsers, toolbars, etc. and other Google owned and operated properties like Gmail, Google Maps, and Google Play;

•YouTube properties; and

•Google Network properties, including revenues from Google Network properties participating in AdMob, AdSense, and Google Ad Manager. Our customers generally purchase advertising inventory through Google Ads, Google Ad Manager, Google Display & Video 360, and Google Marketing Platform, among others. We offer advertising by delivering both performance and brand advertising. We recognize revenues for performance advertising when a user engages with the advertisement. For brand advertising, we recognize revenues when the ad is displayed, or a user views the ad. For ads placed on Google Network properties, we evaluate whether we are the principal (i.e., report revenues on a gross basis) or agent (i.e., report revenues on a net basis). Generally, we report advertising revenues for ads placed on Google Network properties on a gross basis, that is, the amounts billed to our customers are recorded as revenues, and amounts paid to Google Network partners are recorded as cost of revenues. Where we are the principal, we control the advertising inventory before it is transferred to our customers. Our control is evidenced by our sole ability to monetize the advertising inventory before it is transferred to our customers and is further supported by us being primarily responsible to our customers and having a level of discretion in establishing pricing. Google Subscriptions, Platforms, and Devices

Google subscriptions, platforms, and devices revenues consist of revenues from:

53. Alphabet Inc. •consumer subscriptions, which primarily include revenues from YouTube services, such as YouTube TV, YouTube Music and Premium, and NFL Sunday Ticket, as well as Google One, which offers access to our most capable Gemini models;

•platforms, which primarily include revenues from Google Play sales of apps and in-app purchases;

•devices, which primarily include sales of the Pixel family of devices; and

•other products and services. Subscription revenues are recognized ratably over the period of the subscription, primarily monthly. We report revenues from Google Play sales of apps and in-app purchases on a net basis because our performance obligation is to facilitate a transaction between app developers and end users for which we earn a service fee. Google Cloud

Google Cloud revenues consist of revenues from:

•Google Cloud Platform primarily generates consumption-based fees and subscriptions for infrastructure, platform, and other services. These services provide access to solutions such as AI offerings including our enterprise AI infrastructure, Vertex AI platform, and Gemini Enterprise; cybersecurity offerings; and data and analytics solutions;

•Google Workspace includes subscriptions for cloud-based communication and collaboration tools for enterprises, such as Gmail, Docs, Calendar, Drive, and Meet, with integrated features like Gemini for Google Workspace; and

•other enterprise services. Our cloud services are generally provided on either a consumption or subscription basis and may have contract terms longer than a year.

records.query: Google 完成收購 Wiz 的確切日期是哪一天？金額是多少？
records.answer:
Google 在 **2026 年 3 月 11 日**完成了對 Wiz 的收購，最終交易金額為 **295 億美元**（$29.5 billion），此金額已反映購買價格調整，但不包含合併後的薪酬安排 [GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #77] [GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #94]。

**補充細節：**

- 該收購最初於 2025 年 3 月簽署最終協議時的公告金額為 **320 億美元**（$32.0 billion），為全現金交易，最終完成時經購買價格調整後降至 295 億美元 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #182] [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #296]。

- 收購完成後，Wiz 的財務結果已納入 Google Cloud（谷歌雲端）業務分部的合併財務報表中 [GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #94]。

- 根據 2026 年第二季度的 10-Q 報告，295 億美元的初步購買價格分配如下：無形資產 83 億美元、商譽 227.05 億美元、承擔的淨負債 -15.38 億美元，合計 294.67 億美元 [GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #94]。

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] We strive to execute long-term supply contracts for such materials at competitive pricing when feasible, and actively manage supply of raw materials to meet the needs of our operations. We continue to localize and de-risk our supply chains across regions, including through vertical integration where possible, such as our in-house lithium refinery in Texas, which began operations in January 2026. Governmental Programs, Incentives and Regulations

Globally, the ownership of our products by our customers is impacted by various government credits, incentives, and policies.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] In order to enable a greater supply of cells for our products with higher energy density at lower costs, we have developed a new proprietary lithium-ion battery cell and improved manufacturing processes. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Products

We leverage many of the component-level technologies from our vehicles in our energy storage products. By taking a modular approach to the design of battery systems, we can optimize manufacturing capacity of our energy storage products. Additionally, our expertise in power electronics enables our battery systems to interconnect with electricity grids while providing fast-acting systems for power injection and absorption. We have also developed software to remotely control and dispatch our energy storage systems. Further leveraging our capabilities in AI, every Tesla energy storage product is capable of being enhanced through firmware updates and optimized by our software platforms, particularly Powerhub (for distributed energy resources, including Powerwall-enabled virtual power plants) and Autobidder (for Megapack batteries). Energy Generation Systems

We began manufacturing a new residential retrofit solar panel in 2025, and began initial customer deliveries in January 2026. We continue to manufacture Solar Roof, which has been engineered over numerous iterations to combine aesthetic appeal and durability with power generation. The efficiency of our energy generation products is aided by our own solar inverter, which incorporates our power electronics technologies. We designed both products to integrate with Powerwall. Infrastructure

To support our businesses in clean energy and transport and autonomous robots, we are investing in and developing the necessary supporting infrastructure. This includes additional compute hardware to better enable the massive amounts of field data captured by our vehicles to continually train and improve these artificial neural networks for real-world performance. In 2025, we further expanded Cortex, our training cluster at Gigafactory Texas, and announced a new collaboration with Samsung to manufacture advanced semiconductors for AI inference and training in the U.S. We are currently building Cortex 2 at Gigafactory Texas to further increase our AI training compute capacity. In 2026, we will be ramping six new production lines across vehicle, Bots, energy storage and battery manufacturing, while further leveraging our existing factory, charging and service center footprints to support future growth.

records.query: 為什麼大家做 AI 都要靠 NVIDIA 的技術，別家學不來？
records.answer:
# 為什麼大家做 AI 都要靠 NVIDIA 的技術，別家學不來？

NVIDIA 能成為 AI 產業的核心依賴，關鍵在於它不僅僅賣晶片，而是打造了一套從硬體、系統、網路到軟體的完整「加速運算平台」，搭配龐大的開發者生態系，形成了極高的進入壁壘 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。以下從幾個層面說明其競爭優勢：

## 1. 全端（Full-Stack）資料中心規模架構

NVIDIA 採取平台策略，將硬體、系統、軟體、演算法、函式庫、AI 模型與訓練資料集、以及服務整合在一起，為其服務的市場創造獨特價值 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。其運算解決方案涵蓋 AI 伺服器中的三種主要處理單元——GPU、CPU 與 DPU [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。

在 Blackwell 架構中，NVIDIA 導入了「極致協同設計」（extreme co-design），將基礎設施的晶片、網路、系統、軟體與演算法進行整體架構與最佳化，以最大化效能與規模 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。來源指出，成千上萬顆 GPU 可以互連，作為一台巨型電腦運作，而這種資料中心架構與規模正是現代 AI 開發與部署所必需的 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。

## 2. CUDA 軟體生態系——最核心的護城河

NVIDIA 的 CUDA 開發平台是其技術堆疊的基礎，運行於所有 NVIDIA GPU 之上，搭配數百個特定領域的軟體函式庫、框架、演算法、SDK 與 API [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。這套深厚且廣泛的軟體堆疊能加速運算效能並促進 NVIDIA 加速運算的部署 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。

全球有超過 750 萬名開發者使用 CUDA 及其他軟體工具 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。龐大且持續成長的開發者數量與安裝基礎強化了 NVIDIA 的生態系，並提升了其平台對客戶的價值 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。NVIDIA 超過一半的工程師從事軟體工作 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]，過去 5 年更建構了完整的軟體堆疊，將 AI 帶入全球最大產業 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]。

## 3. 企業級 AI 軟體套件

NVIDIA 提供 NVIDIA AI Enterprise——一套完整的軟體套件，旨在簡化生產級、端到端生成式 AI 應用程式的開發與部署 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。其中包含：

- **NVIDIA NIM**：使用業界領先的開源與專有模型來提升 token 吞吐量 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]
- **NVIDIA NeMo**：用於策展、微調、強化學習、評估與保護領域適配模型的完整解決方案 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]
- **AI Blueprints**：預建的可執行範本，協助企業建構、最佳化與部署 AI 代理，同時保護隱私 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]

## 4. 持續的架構創新與產品節奏

NVIDIA 自成立以來已投入超過 767 億美元於研發 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。其產品演進展現了快速的創新節奏：

- 2006 年推出 CUDA，開放 GPU 的平行處理能力 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]
- 2017 年推出首款 Tensor Core GPU [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]
- 2020 年收購 Mellanox，擴展至網路領域並引入 DPU 處理器類別 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]
- 2023 年推出首款資料中心 CPU Grace [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]
- 2024 年推出 NVIDIA Blackwell 架構，連接 36 顆 Grace CPU 與 72 顆 Blackwell GPU，實現即時兆參數推論與訓練 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]
- 在 2026 會計年度，推出並擴展 NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra 平台，針對 agentic AI、reasoning AI 與 physical AI 進行最佳化，搭配 Dynamo 推論軟體，相較於 Hopper generation 帶來 token 吞吐量的顯著提升與每 token 成本的降低 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]

## 5. 橫跨多元終端市場的統一架構

NVIDIA 以統一的可程式化底層架構，透過內部或第三方開發的各種軟體堆疊，支援多個價值數十億美元的終端市場 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。其技術支援 6,000 種應用程式 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #22]，涵蓋：

- **雲端服務提供商（CSP）與 AI 模型開發者**：所有主要 CSP、AI 模型開發者與企業都使用 NVIDIA 的資料中心規模基礎設施 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]
- **遊戲**：GeForce RTX GPU 搭載光線追蹤與 DLSS 技術 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]
- **專業視覺化**：RTX PRO GPU 應用於設計、工程與數位內容創作 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]
- **汽車**：DRIVE Hyperion 平台提供從雲端到車輛的自動駕駛全端解決方案 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]
- **實體 AI/機器人**：提供涵蓋資料中心基礎設施、開放模型、系統、嵌入式運算模組與軟體堆疊的端到端平台 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]

## 6. 超級電腦市場的主導地位

包含 GPU 與網路在內，NVIDIA 驅動了全球 TOP500 榜單中超過 78% 的超級電腦，包括 Green500 榜單前 10 名中的 9 套系統 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #22]。

## 7. 生態系擴展與人才培育

NVIDIA 透過與數百所大學的合作以及 Inception 計畫中與數萬家新創公司的合作來推廣 AI [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。此外，其 Deep Learning Institute 提供關於如何設計、訓練與部署神經網路應用程式的最新技術教學 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。NVIDIA 也是加速與發布開源 AI 模型的領導者，企業、主權國家與新創公司都可利用這些模型在其平台上開發與執行應用程式 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。

---

**總結來說**，NVIDIA 的難以複製性來自於：硬體層面的資料中心規模協同設計與持續架構創新、軟體層面以 CUDA 為核心的龐大開發者生態系、以及將這兩者整合為橫跨多產業的統一平台策略。競爭對手即使能在單一晶片規格上追趕，也難以在短期內複製這套從晶片到應用的完整堆疊與其背後的生態系網路效應。

records.query: 微軟是怎麼把 AI 塞進 Office 那些軟體裡的？
records.answer:
微軟主要是透過一個叫做 **Microsoft 365 Copilot** 的 AI 助理，把 AI 功能直接整合進 Office 系列的生產力與協作工具中，並以此推動商用雲端訂閱的營收成長。

以下是根據參考資料的具體說明：

**一、AI 整合的核心載體：Microsoft 365 Copilot**

微軟將 Microsoft 365 Commercial 定位為一個「AI 驅動的商業與生產力解決方案平台」，把 Office、Windows 以及 **Microsoft 365 Copilot** 整合在一起，協助企業提升員工能力 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。在產品組合的定義上，Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端服務明確包含了 Microsoft 365 Copilot，與 Exchange、SharePoint、Microsoft Teams 等核心通訊與協作工具並列 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #103]。

**二、AI 功能的具體應用場景**

微軟在 Office 等核心產品與服務中，持續加入 AI 工具、功能以及「代理型（agentic）」應用場景，涵蓋了通訊、協作、分析、安全與合規等類別 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。同樣地，在消費端產品，微軟也透過加入包含 AI 工具在內的新功能來提升核心產品組合的價值 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。此外，微軟在 Dynamics 365 的企業資源規劃（ERP）與客戶關係管理（CRM）等商業應用中，也加入了代理型 AI 與低程式碼應用開發平台 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。

**三、AI 整合對營收與成長策略的影響**

微軟將 AI 整合進軟體的策略，直接帶動了商用雲端訂閱的成長。在截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的三個月期間，微軟總營收增加 116 億美元（成長 17%），其中 Productivity and Business Processes（生產力與業務流程）部門的營收成長，正是受到 Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端服務的帶動 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #105]。在截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的九個月期間，微軟總營收成長 18%（增加 365 億美元），此成長受到 Microsoft Cloud 整體成長的帶動，而 Productivity and Business Processes 部門的營收同樣受到 Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端服務驅動 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #103]。

不過，將 AI 大規模塞入軟體產品也帶來了成本壓力。微軟的毛利率百分比在多個期間均略微下降，主因是持續投資於 AI 基礎設施以及 AI 產品使用量的增長，所幸部分被 Azure 與 Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端的效率提升所抵銷 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #105] [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #103]。此外，微軟的營運費用也因研發算力、AI 人才以及 Copilot 廣告支出的增加而上升 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #103]。

•Microsoft 365 Commercial products and cloud services, including Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud, comprising Microsoft 365 Commercial, Enterprise Mobility + Security, the cloud portion of Windows Commercial, the per-user portion of Power BI, Exchange, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 Security and Compliance, and Microsoft 365 Copilot; and Microsoft 365 Commercial products, comprising Windows Commercial on-premises and Office licensed on-premises. •Microsoft 365 Consumer products and cloud services, including Microsoft 365 Consumer subscriptions, Office licensed on-premises, and other consumer services. •LinkedIn, including Talent Solutions, Marketing Solutions, Premium Subscriptions, and Sales Solutions. •Dynamics products and cloud services, including Dynamics 365, comprising a set of intelligent, cloud-based applications across ERP, CRM, Power Apps, and Power Automate; and on-premises ERP and CRM applications. Microsoft 365 Commercial Products and Cloud Services

Microsoft 365 Commercial is an AI-powered business and productivity solutions platform that brings together Office, Windows, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Enterprise Mobility + Security to help organizations empower their employees. Growth depends on our ability to reach new users in new markets such as frontline workers, small and medium businesses, and growth markets, as well as add AI-enabled tools, features, and agentic scenarios to our core product and service offerings across communication, collaboration, analytics, security, compliance, and other AI business productivity categories. Microsoft 365 Commercial revenue is mainly affected by a combination of continued installed base growth and average revenue per user expansion, as well as the continued shift from Office licensed on-premises to Microsoft 365. Microsoft 365 Consumer Products and Cloud Services

Microsoft 365 Consumer is designed to increase personal productivity and creativity through a range of products and services. Growth depends on our ability to reach new users, add value to our core product set with new features including AI tools, and continue to expand our product and service offerings into new markets. Microsoft 365 Consumer cloud revenue and Office Consumer products revenue is mainly affected by the percentage of customers that buy Office with their new devices and the continued shift from Office licensed on-premises to Microsoft 365 Consumer subscriptions. Microsoft 365 Consumer cloud revenue is also affected by the demand for communication and storage through Outlook.com and OneDrive, which is largely driven by subscriptions and advertising. LinkedIn

LinkedIn connects the world’s professionals to make them more productive and successful and transforms the way companies hire, market, sell, and learn. In addition to LinkedIn’s free services, LinkedIn offers monetized solutions designed to offer AI-enabled insights and productivity: Talent Solutions, Marketing Solutions, Premium Subscriptions, and Sales Solutions. Growth will depend on our ability to increase LinkedIn member engagement on the platform and our ability to continue offering insight and AI-enabled services that provide value for our members and customers. LinkedIn revenue is mainly affected by demand from enterprises and professionals for subscriptions to Talent Solutions, Sales Solutions, and Premium Subscriptions offerings, as well as member engagement and the quality of the sponsored content delivered to those members to drive Marketing Solutions. Dynamics Products and Cloud Services

Dynamics provides cloud-based and on-premises business solutions for financial management, enterprise resource planning (“ERP”), customer relationship management (“CRM”), and supply chain management, as well as agentic AI and other low code application development platforms, for small and medium businesses, large organizations, and divisions of global enterprises. Dynamics revenue is driven by the number of users licensed and applications consumed, expansion of average revenue per user, and the continued shift to Dynamics 365, a unified set of cloud-based intelligent business applications, including our low code development platforms, such as Power Apps and Power Automate. Competition

Competitors to Office include software and global application vendors, web-based and mobile application companies, AI-first application companies, as well as local application developers.

records.query: 亞馬遜最近在 AI 這塊砸錢做了什麼？跟哪家 AI 公司搭上線？
records.answer:
亞馬遜在 2026 年第一季砸下 **150 億美元**投資 OpenAI 的 C 輪優先股，並承諾未來再加碼 **350 億美元**，同時也對 Anthropic 持有約 320 億美元的優先股部位，並提供最高 200 億美元的融資額度 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68][AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40]。

## 與 OpenAI 的合作

- **股權投資**：2026 年第一季，亞馬遜投入 150 億美元購買 OpenAI 的 Series C 優先股，並簽署股權承諾函，承諾在特定條件下再購買 350 億美元的 Series C 優先股，使總承諾金額達 500 億美元 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68][AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40]。
- **承諾期限**：若亞馬遜未在 2028 年 12 月 31 日前完成 350 億美元的承諾投資，雙方義務將終止，該日期可能在某些情況下加速 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40]。
- **商業合作**：亞馬遜與 OpenAI 的關聯方簽訂了兩項協議——(1) 一項以提供 AWS 雲端服務為主的商業安排，包括使用 AWS 晶片；(2) 一項聯合合作協議，根據該協議，使用 OpenAI 模型的某些服務將提供給亞馬遜並在 AWS 上提供 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40]。

## 與 Anthropic 的合作

- **現有持股**：截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，亞馬遜持有的非投票表決權優先股（主要涉及 Anthropic 和 OpenAI）帳面價值從 2025 年 12 月 31 日的 162 億美元增至 481 億美元 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40]。
- **第一季估值調整**：2026 年第一季，亞馬遜對其非投票優先股錄得約 123 億美元的向上調整，以反映可觀察的價格變化，截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，非投票優先股的帳面金額約為 320 億美元 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40]。
- **後續投資**：2026 年 3 月 31 日之後，亞馬遜再投資 50 億美元於 Anthropic 的非投票優先股 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40]。
- **融資額度**：亞馬遜向 Anthropic 提供了一項不超過 200 億美元的融資安排，該額度將在 Anthropic IPO 或直接上市等流動性事件後 30 個月到期。隨著亞馬遜在修訂後的商業安排下達到某些運算能力交付里程碑，該額度將逐步開放供 Anthropic 提取 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40]。
- **額外選擇權**：亞馬遜還擁有在 Anthropic 未來股權融資中投資最高 50 億美元的選擇權，若行使將等額減少融資額度 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40]。
- **商業安排**：亞馬遜與 Anthropic 之間有以提供 AWS 雲端服務為主的商業安排，其中包括與 AWS 晶片效能相關的合約義務 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40]。

## 整體 AI 基礎設施投入

- 亞馬遜預期技術與基礎設施支出將隨時間增加，以支援其人工智慧和機器學習計畫 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78]。
- 2026 年第一季的技術與基礎設施成本較去年同期上升，主要原因是基礎設施支出增加，包括折舊與攤銷 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78]。
- AWS 段落的物業與設備淨額從 2024 年 12 月 31 日的 1,107 億美元增至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的 1,901 億美元，AWS 的物業與設備淨增加額在 2025 年達 965 億美元 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #121]。

[AMZN 10-Q period 202603] We regularly evaluate our facility requirements. Technology and Infrastructure

Technology and infrastructure costs include payroll and related expenses for employees involved in the research and development of new and existing products and services, development, design, and maintenance of our stores, curation and display of products and services made available in our online stores, and infrastructure costs. Infrastructure costs include servers, networking equipment, and data center related depreciation and amortization, rent, utilities, and other expenses necessary to support AWS and other Amazon businesses. Collectively, these costs reflect the investments we make in order to offer a wide variety of products and services to our customers, including expenditures related to initiatives to build and deploy innovative and efficient software and electronic devices and the development of a satellite network for global broadband service and autonomous vehicles for ride-hailing services. We seek to invest efficiently in numerous areas of technology and infrastructure so we may continue to enhance the customer experience and improve our process efficiency through rapid technology developments, while operating at an ever increasing scale. Our technology and infrastructure investment and capital spending projects often support a variety of product and service offerings due to geographic expansion and the cross-functionality of our systems and operations. We expect spending in technology and infrastructure to increase over time as we continue to add infrastructure and employees, including to support our artificial intelligence and machine learning initiatives. These costs are allocated to segments based on usage. The increase in technology and infrastructure costs in Q1 2026, compared to the comparable prior year period, is primarily due to an increase in spending on infrastructure, including depreciation and amortization. Changes in foreign exchange rates increased technology and infrastructure costs by $374 million for Q1 2026. We currently expense the majority of the costs associated with the development of our satellite network for global broadband service (including production, launch, and payroll costs, and launch services deposits upon launch). We will capitalize certain of these costs once the service achieves commercial viability, including sales to customers.

records.query: Google 的 AI 助手現在有整合進搜尋引擎裡嗎？
records.answer:
是的，Google 已將 AI 技術整合進搜尋引擎中，讓使用者能用更自然的語言提問並獲得 AI 生成的回覆。Google 搜尋已從靜態的「十個藍色連結」轉變為動態的多模態體驗，其中 **AI Overviews** 功能讓使用者更容易向 Google 提問並獲得有用的回覆，而 **AI Mode** 則允許使用者提出過去需要多次搜尋才能解答的更細緻問題 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。

在技術層面，AI Mode 運用了 Gemini 的先進推理、思考及多模態能力來處理這些更複雜的查詢 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。更廣泛而言，Google 正將生成式 AI 與 Gemini 嵌入其產品和平台中，目前所有 15 個擁有五億使用者的產品（其中 7 個擁有二十億使用者）都在使用 Gemini 模型，而搜尋引擎正是這些產品之一 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。此外，Google 最新的 AI 模型 Gemini 3 也整合了增強的推理能力，以支援跨產品生態系統的視覺化與互動式使用者體驗，其中包括搜尋與 Gemini 應用程式 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

Note 1. Summary of Significant Accounting Policies

Nature of Operations

Google was incorporated in California in September 1998 and re-incorporated in the State of Delaware in August 2003. In 2015, we implemented a holding company reorganization, and as a result, Alphabet Inc. ("Alphabet") became the successor issuer to Google. We generate revenues by delivering relevant, cost-effective online advertising; cloud-based solutions that provide enterprise customers of all sizes with infrastructure, platform services, and applications; and sales of other products and services, such as fees received for subscription-based products, apps and in-app purchases, and devices. Basis of Consolidation

The consolidated financial statements of Alphabet include the accounts of Alphabet and entities consolidated under the variable interest and voting models. Intercompany balances and transactions have been eliminated. Use of Estimates

Preparation of consolidated financial statements in conformity with GAAP requires us to make estimates and assumptions that affect the amounts reported and disclosed in the financial statements and the accompanying notes. Actual results could differ materially from these estimates due to uncertainties. On an ongoing basis, we evaluate our estimates, including those related to the allowance for credit losses; contingent liabilities; fair values of financial instruments and goodwill; income taxes; inventory; and useful lives of property and equipment, among others. We base our estimates on assumptions, both historical and forward looking, that are believed to be reasonable, and the results of which form the basis for making judgments about the carrying values of assets and liabilities. Revenue Recognition

Revenues are recognized when control of the promised goods or services is transferred to our customers, and the collectibility of an amount that we expect in exchange for those goods or services is probable. Sales and other similar taxes are excluded from revenues. Google Advertising

Google advertising revenues consist of revenues from:

•Google Search and other properties, including revenues from traffic generated by search distribution partners who use Google.com as their default search in browsers, toolbars, etc. and other Google owned and operated properties like Gmail, Google Maps, and Google Play;

•YouTube properties; and

•Google Network properties, including revenues from Google Network properties participating in AdMob, AdSense, and Google Ad Manager. Our customers generally purchase advertising inventory through Google Ads, Google Ad Manager, Google Display & Video 360, and Google Marketing Platform, among others. We offer advertising by delivering both performance and brand advertising. We recognize revenues for performance advertising when a user engages with the advertisement. For brand advertising, we recognize revenues when the ad is displayed, or a user views the ad. For ads placed on Google Network properties, we evaluate whether we are the principal (i.e., report revenues on a gross basis) or agent (i.e., report revenues on a net basis). Generally, we report advertising revenues for ads placed on Google Network properties on a gross basis, that is, the amounts billed to our customers are recorded as revenues, and amounts paid to Google Network partners are recorded as cost of revenues. Where we are the principal, we control the advertising inventory before it is transferred to our customers. Our control is evidenced by our sole ability to monetize the advertising inventory before it is transferred to our customers and is further supported by us being primarily responsible to our customers and having a level of discretion in establishing pricing. records.query: Meta 搞的那些 VR 眼鏡跟 AI，到底想往哪個方向發展？
records.answer:
Meta 的 VR 眼鏡與 AI 發展方向，是打造一個超越 2D 螢幕的沉浸式「下一個運算平台」，將 AI 貫穿於現有應用生態系與新硬體裝置中，最終目標是實現「為每個人提供個人超級智慧」[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

以下從幾個面向說明具體發展方向：

**一、AI 發展方向**

Meta 正在 AI 領域進行廣泛創新，其 AI 投資支援多項產品與服務的系統，包括應用中的內容排序、推薦相關內容的探索引擎、廣告客戶觸及消費者的工具，以及開發新的生成式 AI 體驗 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。Meta 同時正在開發下一代 AI 模型，推進其建構「超級智慧」（Meta 將其定義為超越人類智慧的 AI）的願景 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。在產品層面，Meta AI 是一個可跨應用程式、獨立 App、AI 眼鏡及網頁使用的助理，旨在協助人們學習、完成任務、創建內容及與他人聯繫 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

**二、VR 與沉浸式體驗方向**

Meta 認為元宇宙（metaverse）將成為下一個運算平台與社交互動的未來，目前雖處於發展早期階段，但公司正將產品從 2D 螢幕推向沉浸式體驗 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。在 VR 方面，Meta 的產品包括 Meta Quest 裝置以及透過 Meta Horizon Store 提供的軟體與內容，涵蓋遊戲、健身、娛樂等社交體驗 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。為推動 VR 的普及，Meta 引入了透視（passthrough）功能，讓使用者在體驗 VR 沉浸感的同時仍能與物理世界保持連結 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。

**三、穿戴式裝置與 AR 方向**

Meta 的穿戴式裝置 effort 包括 AI 眼鏡與長期的 AR 計畫 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。目前的 AI 眼鏡產品包括 Ray-Ban Meta 與 Oakley Meta 眼鏡，具備 Meta AI 對話助理及免手持互動等功能 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。在長期 AR 方面，Meta 於 2024 年發表了 Orion 原型——一副能在眼鏡形式中將內容疊加於物理世界之上的真正 AR 眼鏡 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。2025 年，Meta 推出 Meta Ray-Ban Display，將 AI 眼鏡與內建於鏡片的顯示器結合，並搭配 Meta Neural Band 腕帶裝置，利用肌電圖讓使用者以神經肌肉訊號控制 AI 眼鏡 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。

**四、資源分配方向**

Meta 預期在 2026 年將約 70% 的 Reality Labs 營運支出投入穿戴式裝置計畫，剩餘 30% 則投入 VR 與 Horizon 計畫 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。這項支出分配顯示穿戴式裝置（AI 眼鏡與 AR）是 Meta 近期投入的重點方向。

**五、戰略風險與挑戰**

Meta 的 Reality Labs 策略面臨多項風險。元宇宙可能不會如預期發展，市場對其產品與服務的接受度存在不確定性 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]。Meta 在消費硬體產品及 VR/AR 技術方面的經驗相對有限，可能使其他公司更具競爭力 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]。部分消費硬體產品依賴第三方行動平台的互操作性，而這些平台不一定提供與其自身競爭產品相同程度的互操作性 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]。Reality Labs 的努力也可能從其他業務領域轉移資源與管理注意力，且其持續投資的能力取決於其他業務領域能否產生足夠利潤 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]。在 AI 方面，Meta 的計畫依賴取得資料以訓練模型、吸引並留住專業人才，以及取得第三方設備與運算基礎設施，這些資源的可用性與定價在高度競爭環境中無法完全控制 [META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #69]。

records.query: 特斯拉的自動駕駛跟別家車廠比，厲害在哪裡？
records.answer:
特斯拉的自動駕駛技術核心競爭力在於其採用視覺基礎技術（vision-based technologies）訓練人工神經網路，並搭配自家客製化設計的推理晶片，同時將此技術應用從車輛擴展至人形機器人與無人計程車服務 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。

以下是特斯拉在自動駕駛領域的具體技術與商業模式特點：

**1. 視覺技術與自研晶片整合**
特斯拉利用視覺基礎技術、系統與軟體來訓練其人工神經網路，且這些網路是由特斯拉自家內部客製化設計的推理晶片進行加速 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。特斯拉相信其在人工智慧領域的能力與進展能使其與競爭對手產生差異化 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。

**2. 無人計程車（Robotaxi）服務與車隊營運**
特斯拉已於 2025 年 6 月推出 Robotaxi 服務，這是一個運用其技術與車輛的自動叫車平台 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。目前該服務使用 Model Y 車輛營運，未來將納入專為自動駕駛設計的 Cybercab 車輛 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。特斯拉預期此服務將開拓更廣泛的客戶群，並結合 FSD (Supervised) 訂閱制，推動基於 AI、軟體與車隊利潤的服務導向商業模式 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。

**3. AI 技術跨領域應用**
特斯拉將自駕技術中的人工智慧學習成果應用於「Bots」機器人，例如正在開發中的通用型自主人形機器人 Optimus [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。這顯示其 AI 技術的應用範圍不僅限於車輛 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。

**4. 軟體控制與遠端更新能力**
特斯拉幾乎在內部開發所有車輛控制與資訊娛樂軟體，並透過無線軟體更新（over-the-air updates）定期更新車輛軟體以改善功能 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。每一台交付的特斯拉車輛在設計時皆以自動駕駛為目標 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。

**與 NVIDIA 的自動駕駛策略差異：**
NVIDIA 在自駕車領域提供的是名為 DRIVE 品牌的 AI 硬體與軟體解決方案，並透過與汽車 OEM、一級供應商（tier-1 suppliers）、叫車服務商與新創公司等運輸產業夥伴合作來推向市場 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #29]。NVIDIA 的解決方案包含用於訓練神經網路的 GPU 硬體，以及在車輛部署前重新模擬其運作所需的硬體 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #29]。相較之下，特斯拉則是自行設計推理晶片、開發軟體、製造車輛並直接營運 Robotaxi 叫車服務 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。
